name: Voter Action Project Team
subject: The culmination of all the attacks on mail-in voting
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Trump’s order is the culmination of years of attacks on absentee ballots and vote-by-mail. In the months before the 2020 election, Trump repeatedly spread disinformation and conspiracy theories about the legitimacy of mail-in ballots as he campaigned for reelection. With MAGA angling for total control, Trump wants to end their use forever.
Fuel our work with $35 or more right now to help defend the use of mail-in ballots across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=041426_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=041426_3&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail .
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs the Attorney General to “ take all necessary action ” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We've got to keep fighting and work to protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=041426_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=041426_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=041426_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=041426_3&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=041426_3&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=041426_3&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=041426_3&amount=35]
We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure , mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”
Opponents of voting rights have proven they'll go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and make sure that they stay in power. Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can to fight their unending desire for control and protect mail-in voting? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=041426_3&amount=35]
https://voteractionproject.org/ [https://voteractionproject.org/]
https://www.facebook.com/voteraction [https://www.facebook.com/voteraction] https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org [https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org] https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/ [https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/] https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/ [https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/]
Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=041426_3&amount=20]

subject: AI is officially racist against White People
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
body:
Help me fight back against the war on Whiteness |
---

Peter, thank you for opening this email! You may or may not have heard of me, but my name is Bernie Moreno. I'm a father, an immigrant, a conservative, and a proud American!
I have lived the American Dream, Peter. I'd like to share my story with you today. I hope by the end you'll understand why I've made it my mission in life to save and defend the American Dream.
Please take a moment to read this message so I can share my story with you. I wrote this from the heart, so I'd really appreciate it if you read this all the way through![](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/_Z3Z83--bN5XKt3hnM4K6IBQwLxO0J2bYnJNFyA9d6zdaP-Eylv8X-UqDwYihRg0QCN3V1O_9pBaOlUdFfGJ8vnvtnuILX0CELls5G1_fMIl1325y3b--Qmt0-a3N_iMrXxa_dLusbryfMNKBt20sggNWCqHiAIxHOnEDsEfpVEOWSzjVuimRMp-WXkRWl2-rDd7RfISgbegYdvMLMzFAqp0pImvVlcT1bwU1P3MAWqmEyih4tw45QXssJb6IolTWfmgaiAUFThH4IN7H7ftGldh3A6XIy8ikjQG4jk0lRuTgUYurkoF3UaW-trvXgQaZAsZYP-b2mngbYBV80P_52Z34rPCSQ_xYc--Hnqyrbliv9cv9UTNebnpCBWrMUGzjtW2ISx2PD_MMN1T08TXzLuXRFL9g_dPYnYPuKGcHoEeABlVxfwgMm9nXN7fl7eC7a2Qkv-5pryLJHT2SYHgIFTpItJWmvFNk1zQZrokW2OdXX4_BWzNnu_GArs1p6Wj8r05tIY5RCamlSCqBIuIuGM-2m0i6V2yCLrQVs5X3HsWfaV_cUtha7HDY2ZJ-_Y0VOPfRqITEtTh2y-XM2CulxPdhePfjMVkvZFtORCQOOt1dGMyXvorO_tMJstgtke0nBcqs6PuTQAMRtEYwlyHO_0AhZY6oCw9IqAcOnSAqLjUnrRhm-CYRmtDA0UuylTh5U-uvjQ9QdK8BzcZj5gwJg-Bv13c8APEHrs5zZOncr1bn8lArBAvsZx4-L1XmJDntATf4zWKLGa1XFSSXXRev3truvSqTWQlSkcTSdMkitmB0brocmhVm8RR8WWBW8bwiaw7HQ1sdsQTyDobVNZ5709JjDWg3CqJNj3TjE8kwY0_5iJ51moH4yWuRzQ1cAJj7BfC3ChALFnQ/AIL_OB68cnxpjg_wFB1d6Lc0Ns0LZz-j/19)I was born in Bogota, Colombia. As unrest began to stir, my parents decided to seek a better life for me and my siblings. When I was five, my mom and dad made one of their best decisions ever and we moved to America. And when I was 18, I became an American citizen!
Some people ask me, "Bernie, how I could love our country as much as I do when I wasn't even born here?" To that I say, how could I not love America! This is my home; our nation is the greatest country in history. America has given me - and every one of her citizens - every opportunity to succeed in this life with the promise of the American Dream!
During my career, I used every penny I had to my name to buy a car dealership. With hard work and uncompromising determination, I built that small start into one of the largest car dealership groups in the country!
I know that none of it would be possible without the promise of the American Dream! When I saw the Dream that I achieved was under threat, I knew I had the knowhow and the responsibility to stand up and protect the American Dream for another generation to come.
During COVID, I saw government bureaucrats mistreat American workers, strip citizens of their rights, and failed to hold the Chinese Communist Party accountable for unleashing a manmade virus on the world. I knew something had to be done to turn things around. So I ran for Senate in my home state of Ohio. With a fantastic team in my corner and the incredible support of grassroots conservatives, we WON and helped flip the Senate in 2024![](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/wfi4JvzYNhGqyjilLCpA-nnhpoD9lD2o7PLvIXyZMjXEvqmoLcwGH81FJ3pTq2RM7wlLzYqu0C94smLv32yAchuFXEoVGI4fJI7148s6ndhLAUXugn200XS3UU9g1dcEcjzCU_MkkavZi6GFrmPpg7RXGef0UWIyqNDi5tTw46Gr9LfeAeCARS-fJwZ2pL2-kFjL1cFrPMTungbvesLGkG5yrWIk5Ra2QUdCTN9PxKLZ8gz29Ce6upoWDUxef_cZXdnNHE4sjxxm43rN-OKHqPdTcoxIjn_wXf0tn2fXrE8kcM5n2YYwXW-tTMpQT7aRSFUuAcR_wBZSm3F6RBTHHldwuTnJcWY8Ir7qIVScPLmk5LvWMRaNMOT1u3mSzzLSnAz3NGnS-GRHWwMdvL7tAbSONRXMph_4jHhukpjGXry4WtmEqiv2J7hDkIlUTxNRNJu5HKsRmEGODxHXflj0mk79OcnSZK1dgXcE3F-SYcUTaKQ2pwZL9zJ6UF5eFUpe0TG-BesCMj8Iz_iZ1lAxQhY732nowqlr-ed6KYBg4ZQXTPp6jmwNTsNNkBhZGurd3JZ85Al75_lOkle5UKHL3oVOeOQJiqR47MtSLezLsGgyy-cQJa-oq4WSRwlQJ6HY6ZRiSSl5W-FAN1beeA8KM1MgqKOC_7Ibzx7QKWJ6pNz-ALTjQxTvDCaQjL8E7ax5Oo2Kpv6snOggG9VlSK0ALi6St03L6-_8K3fQq994qmIA6Y2Cko_wThWHVov-6czstZiSItpA7G5uO9kshFjtTUUn7fdlNsBvtj98Ro3nH48tSR_MrInd2PEg-MqjjscS6dC8WFDp3bKj42QGah2mI1dReODxrhtEsIg2yHHE-oA6xENGMhjGBP1EOYgj3YWWTpECx6BpJ3Sw/nO27CfRh6noQ2FMVttVpQArHkRR_5-Hd/19)Every day since winning, I've been working hard to save the American Dream and defend our shared values. I will NEVER stop fighting for you, Peter.
I'm so grateful for every opportunity and success I've had on my road to the American Dream. I've relied on my own grit and perseverance throughout my life, but I've also had the support of my amazing family along the way.
I've had the joy of building a family with my wife, Bridget. We raised four amazing kids together and have watched them grow up and reach their full potential. clean_body: Peter, thank you for opening this email! You may or may not have heard of me, but my name is Bernie Moreno. I'm a father, an immigrant, a conservative, and a proud American! I have lived the American Dream, Peter. I'd like to share my story with you today. I hope by the end you'll understand why I've made it my mission in life to save and defend the American Dream. Please take a moment to read this message so I can share my story with you. I wrote this from the heart, so I'd really appreciate it if you read this all the way throughI was born in Bogota, Colombia. As unrest began to stir, my parents decided to seek a better life for me and my siblings. When I was five, my mom and dad made one of their best decisions ever and we moved to America. And when I was 18, I became an American citizen! Some people ask me, "Bernie, how I could love our country as much as I do when I wasn't even born here?" To that I say, how could I not love America! This is my home; our nation is the greatest country in history. America has given me - and every one of her citizens - every opportunity to succeed in this life with the promise of the American Dream! During my career, I used every penny I had to my name to buy a car dealership. With hard work and uncompromising determination, I built that small start into one of the largest car dealership groups in the country! I know that none of it would be possible without the promise of the American Dream! When I saw the Dream that I achieved was under threat, I knew I had the knowhow and the responsibility to stand up and protect the American Dream for another generation to come. During COVID, I saw government bureaucrats mistreat American workers, strip citizens of their rights, and failed to hold the Chinese Communist Party accountable for unleashing a manmade virus on the world. I knew something had to be done to turn things around. So I ran for Senate in my home state of Ohio. With a fantastic team in my corner and the incredible support of grassroots conservatives, we WON and helped flip the Senate in 2024Every day since winning, I've been working hard to save the American Dream and defend our shared values. I will NEVER stop fighting for you, Peter. I'm so grateful for every opportunity and success I've had on my road to the American Dream. I've relied on my own grit and perseverance throughout my life, but I've also had the support of my amazing family along the way. I've had the joy of building a family with my wife, Bridget. We raised four amazing kids together and have watched them grow up and reach their full potential. I'm so proud of my family and I couldn't have done any of this without their love and support!| | ---|--- Here's a picture of Bridget and I on our wedding day!| Here's one of Bridget and I at one of President Trump's rallies! ---|--- America has given so much to me; I've built a family here, found success in business, and lived out my American Dream. I hope you now can see why I've made my life's work to defend the American Dream! Without it, our country would cease to be the greatest nation in the history of the world! : If you don't think you can spare even just $1 right now, that's totally fine! Dear Peter,
I grew up in a working-class family in Estes Park. There were times when my family relied on food stamps to get by. So when politicians talk about cutting programs families depend on, I know exactly what that means for people trying to put food on the table.
And right now, we’re seeing more of those attacks — on working families, on basic protections, and on Coloradans’ rights.
That’s why this race for Attorney General matters.
As Secretary of State, I’ve stood up to extremists, defended our elections, and protected your right to vote — even when it made me a target. As Attorney General, I’ll take that fight further: taking on illegal corporate greed, protecting working people, and standing up to anyone who tries to take advantage of Coloradans.
But building a campaign that can win statewide takes resources.
We have less than 24 hours to meet our mid-month goal of 100 new donors.
Will you help us reach more voters and build the kind of campaign it takes to win — from Denver to the Western Slope to the Eastern Plains? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2604-q2-jg?]

subject: Help J6 veterans find justice
body:
I recently came across a striking statistic... 72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.

| | | [View this email in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm6a8ss913iv1djod4v0q4nh25kgrjhlg6gbcd1o_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c9im2ob0c3h2bs)

Friend,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I’ve always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven’t received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That’s why I’m proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you’ll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zial5ek6jneo4a1u7hlhgeh65k7gsfh817v0dmd0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c9im2ob0c3h2bs)
[Donate](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1nqbqrvs41kkfpp672b6t3upramno2n9jdu4jf0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c9im2ob0c3h2bs)
Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten.

[Will you help J6 defendants get back on their feet by donating $10, $35, $50, or even $100 to Stand in the Gap today? >>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6jh0c5jits683vrnjp96shrriu4avmkh045bj00_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c9im2ob0c3h2bs)

This isn’t about politics. It’s about justice.

These are real Americans — veterans, first responders, fathers, mothers, hard-working citizens — who exercised their First Amendment rights and were persecuted for their political beliefs.

_**If we don’t fight for our fellow patriots now, who will?**_

When you donate to Stand in the Gap, you’re not just defending individuals. _You are defending the soul of our country_.

**As long as there’s breath in my lungs and truth in my heart, I’ll be singing to honor veterans and first responders. I hope you’ll join me by taking action right now.**

name: Dave McCormick
subject: How an early morning church service strengthened my faith
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick
body:
This is a deeply personal story

| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkvtchl3q5vnkgvc8g5r1uogkn88lti3ptvp1640_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c9imapj6cjh2bs)
---
| | I want to take a moment today to share a personal story with you, Friend.
It’s a story about how an early morning church service and a sermon referencing Psalm 121 left an imprint on my soul and strengthened my faith.
When I arrived at West Point as a new cadet, I had no idea how much it would transform my life.
During my first plebe summer, I attended an early morning church service. The sermon referenced Psalm 121:
**“I lift my eyes to the mountains- where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.” Psalm 121**
**That psalm and my time at West Point have been a touchstone ever since, sustaining me during difficult moments in my life.**
When I decided to run for U.S. Senate, I made a promise to come to Washington and work with fellow political outsiders like President Trump to shake up business as usual. Now I’m working to fulfill that promise every single day.
We need leaders in DC with the strength, the will, and the moral clarity to meet the challenges we face. **So, if you’re looking to continue the status quo, I’m not your guy.**
But if you want to help me continue my fight to change the way things are done in DC, I need your support. Our average online donation is $21.38, and **_[I would be so grateful if you would generously give that amount today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4lrpvg79e593e5i1ocdjdi039pe965ll23qvkdo_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c9imapj6cjh2bs)_**
I’m no stranger to fighting for what is right, and ****if we don’t continue pushing every single day to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it!****
There are too many pressing issues we must solve to hold back now. Whether it’s illegal immigration and the fentanyl crisis or inflation and the cost of living, we cannot afford to lose ground.
Here’s where I need your help, Friend. I hate asking for money — I’m not a career politician, and it’s not in my nature — but I have no choice but to ask if we’re going to continue fighting to advance our cause to change how things are done.
Democrats from all over the country are panicking and pulling out all the stops to attack Republicans who are shaking up Washington. They’ve even gone as far as shutting down the government and refusing to come to the table to work with us to reopen it. That’s why I’m hoping you can spare **_[$25, $50, or even $100 to help me fight back.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjq7luac3fvn27o31mv79huocs9g4k674muqrcm0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c9imapj6cjh2bs)_**
---

| | Please, join me today to fix our broken government and save what makes America worth fighting for.
Thank you,Senator Dave McCormickArmy Veteran, USMA'87
---

---
| | I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat veteran who served in the 82nd Airbornet, a 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, **and I defeated an entrenched career politician in the #1 swing state of the 2024 election.**
I’ve seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I’ve seen that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others first.
That’s why I made a promise to come to the Senate and work with fellow political outsiders like President Trump to shake up Washington, and I’m working to do that every single day.
Whether it’s securing the border, reducing crime in our cities, ending the fentanyl epidemic, or bringing down the cost of living–**I’m committed to delivering concrete solutions to the biggest issues we face.**
But in order to get the job done, it’s going to take all hands on deck. I need every freedom-loving American to help me shake up Washington. I promise I won't let you down.
_Senator Dave McCormick_

| Peter,
MILLIONS of dollars are flooding into Louisiana's Republican Senate primary right now. Attack ads everywhere. Dark money groups with names like "MAGA Energy" and "The Accountability Project" are covering the airwaves.

| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001N5ReCYMNmN7vSH-tS6mffJXYPHoOYlLu_6r5Qv16oJJu3Z8qBxSHp-jS22WfzAxcnYhesa0ALQR_1ujhkLqgzpA9aN2gDnA3kq5_YnkC5erzBtJkygaxsE3XZZnIRWNvi4At8JJgcaCD_XpWnh5gJNslTqd1IbzhzjCRulhUV0N-kT05meBP4BwoTMhWMaGWIDq0WfdZhFZ5pE6C2ka9WTUTWCiGxJdW&c=qKvmqN5sxqoPg8u1luV6a14z1ZrhmUa8TY-bsA2CvRmTD1Ac2x-1zg==&ch=wFGNaHXzhXrsUpTLjfg9iQL5mWqH0DWrvJq_o_bVMaLf6ZPm73wExQ==)

But here's what nobody's talking about: Where is that money actually coming from?
Not Louisiana.
Out-of-state billionaires. Dark money super PACs with anonymous donors. Corporate interests from New York, California, Texas -- anywhere but here.
They're not Louisiana money. They're not Louisiana values. They're trying to buy our Senate seat from the outside.
And the beautiful part?
They're so busy destroying each other in their civil war that my campaign is flying completely under the radar.
While MAGA billionaires burn through millions attacking each other, we're quietly building a Democratic, grassroots movement powered by the people.
Farmers. Teachers. Small business owners. Working families who give $10, $25, $50 because they believe this state deserves better.
THAT'S who is powering my campaign.
What we have is something MAGA couldn't buy with a trillion dollars: Authentic support from people who actually live here and care about what happens to this state.
These MAGA billionaires are about to learn a powerful lesson: You can't buy Louisiana.
And I'm going to prove it in November.
But only if we have the resources to compete when they finally turn their attention to us. Right now, while they're distracted, is the perfect time to build our war chest.
I'm Jamie Davis, a Democrat, grandson of a sharecropper, farmer, and fighter who is going to do whatever it takes to flip this seat blue.
Will it be a walk in the park? Hell no. But it IS possible. In fact, this is a once-in-a-generation type of opportunity to flip this seat and shock the world. But ONLY with the support of donors like you.
[Will you chip in $25, $10, or $5 to help us capitalize on the MAGA chaos?](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001N5ReCYMNmN7vSH-tS6mffJXYPHoOYlLu_6r5Qv16oJJu3Z8qBxSHp-jS22WfzAxcw4B9LWoLl_p7XaM9IGkyMOFULxRqAnNDU-4igqij-E525vSQGvIv6CxIUwKeuXklgZj-lpah2MefbXzHQy77XdmlM6cvj8-1k79QAkrt03edwCcwWYcejc1N5SF2mPSex5yQHE0023CoPKulV4WK8DqJlZp_GStnTSuWtYPmm35WCLaDsXMxbA==&c=qKvmqN5sxqoPg8u1luV6a14z1ZrhmUa8TY-bsA2CvRmTD1Ac2x-1zg==&ch=wFGNaHXzhXrsUpTLjfg9iQL5mWqH0DWrvJq_o_bVMaLf6ZPm73wExQ==)

## More Expulsions Loom in Congress
Congress shifted its ethic focus today [to two Florida lawmakers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL9utDAQxJ_G7jiZtc2fwsXX0N3XpkQLXrCTBZ-wc-jy9BH3CilGGmk0P2nm4z7eMXLc1_-4kStLGnc6M1MpdIxz2teDco5pR6YS4pzPEAuFERQ0lTJVbUePkV-jkd4tREBakqvbtgFzSQanp36GtkeqoQfvFU7eowbrW9AKdS2ju2jK1LZWqlXm1uhO60V11lozzx6EUeRjScftM8W9BFr4lZ503Oa0SXahlEcW-p-AQcBQAoXIfGUChpA2uga97XcmAYPtoO9UU-UT-STmak37DzLlirYJS2HyFeO54RcdV08ezj_OyBxz0wqj1g3jGy_Ln_56OvgNAAD__-4Gf5M) in the wake of Monday's announcements that embattled Reps. Eric Swalwell and Tony Gonzales, both facing sexual misconduct charges, would leave the House. Next to face possible [expulsion from the House](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFutDAQhJ8GOpAxNj4KF39Dd3-bEvmW9XmTNT7ZziHePiKvkGKkkUYazXwf9_XuiGl__ncRbfVp3fEojLViXiHtz4ylUNodYw0E5QhUMaxSyKkTqhv0ujnic1XtZj2ixLFFOxgzSXWpDdajEga8cELPRozmMc83cOjnyT-GGaEle7UJNehBCCNUP423cfTiprVWAJtslMCNasr9Z6K9BvR8pjfmHlJs2YZaX6UZ_zVyaeRyHEd_upDSlTZyue40cnG5EjBe1nPKtLnSQcpnF4m5dBAwe-Lv0kWAlCPBVzeoUUqpJ92HGrnNdnsdxExlMo0Sz-iIfxfUP2F7W_kTAAD__wDJgnI) over ethics issues are Florida Reps. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick, a Democrat, and Cory Mills, a Republican. A House Ethics subcommittee found Cherfilus-McCormick [guilty of funneling $5 million](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u3SAUhFeDO64w5uemoEjj7qVNaWE4tk90DBaQh5zVR46UFbxiqpFG830_P5YPj4Rp_-FPcG3LS4JeCVqDsoSc9gK1Yk6eoB0Yaj-wwbFIIQ0Xio96iR7pXtQQ3QYgYRrAjdYaqZ4Mh4va-3W1q_XjG7QVoOJqPJi4ftvEKsyA7lkTatSjEFaol5ne07SJt9ZahRAlUwIitlxevzKmdsBGd_6E8gr5HMgdrV2VTd-ZnJmce--vtIaH4umZnK9M2DBUJuf_QEzOBa7KW04333P64wkqh4KB1-6pAxHP24YBPdHNC1TcEz-xhpzi79B4II9n5SUkP02jNXooLl4dibAay5TYT4_072D7ktVPJ_8GAAD__zFVj_A) in COVID relief funds to her campaign. The panel is set to announce recommended sanctions at an April 21 hearing. Mills is under ethics investigation on allegations including a variety of misconduct, all of which he denies. His case timeline remains unclear.
## New Iran Talks Could Come This Week
A new round of in-person peace talks between the U.S. and Iran could happen as early as this week, according to [sources familiar with the negotiations](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUL2O5CAYe5qkI-IvJFdQXJNurr0yIvBl-HYJREAGzT79KvsKW1iybMmy_f-xPgwGjM9_5gBd97RGaCVArZBXm-IzQymYoglQPdrSPFbwK6dcESoJG1dnMLxX2Tu9A3AQPWg2TYrLG73X0yYVVxswp5QwjANVM8zObWazzI20R32nUclGRulE5aDELMRO53EcpbWOd5KCw5ry8JEwVg97eKcX5MGmow_a13qWTvzt-NLxpbU2xM3eK27_VlIOruMLZhM7vlyF3IxEaOQEY4FUEz4Lqfk6TvIy0QLxKR_XF4mXDWAygZjR-gNiJdlGIwRT6k-ftTsbhoBFTZ2kz8Ng-KlUf_XjS_PvAAAA__8c3ok8). Iran's nuclear program and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz remain the key sticking points. President Trump told reporters that Iran had called and suggested talks could resume in Pakistan within days. The [two-week ceasefire expires April 21](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtu9CAUhJ8Gd1jcfPkLir9xt2lTWiw-NifCsIKzizZPHzmvkGKmGekb6fu8rTeHEdPx4U6wtOc1QasRiKCsPqejQK2Yk4tAAX1tAQnCqoQauTBcDuvmML5X0212B1CgO7BymkZlrnTBOjFJr50Uo5thkMqrf07fYd79JvSspw7tRRNGDlKISZh-1LPWu5iHYTDeb4oZARtSLv1XxkQB9vjOLyi9z2cXbSB6VKb_M7UwtbTWep_u_hqZWi40U4swTC3yKirP88GxuMSbK7xScUg87zzkcj6_eYIjEzrCnGof6IxdsdujYYxYx4kZcZwO4-81_cnXy6qfAAAA__8Bq36C), adding urgency to the diplomatic push. Meanwhile, the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports continued, with Central Command saying no ships made it past in the first 24 hours, and six merchant vessels turned back. Separately, Israeli and Lebanese ambassadors held their [first direct talks since 1993](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAMhp-GdERAgGQKimvS7bVXRgw4iW8JjMBaNG9_ykr3BFtYnyxZ1v_9fz62D48J8_HbX-BoL1uG3hIQQd1CyUeF1rBkn4BODK2fSHBuSijLhebSbNFjem96iG4HUDAN4OQ8W6XvGU6n5WweMSxgrfDGWr08pIxPYfzyCNbLAd39TWhppBCz0KOdlmnaxWKM0SFExbSAiFTq-LdgphP29C5fUMdQriG5k-jV2PSLqZWptfc-5mfI0N-lft4nTK230w1P3yocM0H9vzG1Jnj6XDLHVj0kvmNtxCNWCDdeqVyeMHDy6bPx7tuJ-aCSmVpvHWtmptahuvjqmBI2OzMtjstj-o5IP-r1y6l_AQAA__9Gz45N) at the State Department on Tuesday, with Secretary of State Rubio calling it a "historic opportunity" toward ending Hezbollah's influence.
## Husband Released in Bahamas Disappearance
Bahamian police released Michigan man Brian Hooker on Monday without charges after [questioning him for days](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O5CAUhE9jZ1gY8E8HBJs46003tJ7h2bwVhhbQjXz7kUdzgwlK-qSSSlX177k-gTyF4y-cqMse14A1eywF02piOBLmTDGAx-LI5OqooFsFFyPjivXDaoH8tarW6h1RoGxR99M0CnWrdRoGKcYNH73YZynn0UphNiP2UUG_PaRtSd9pXPVDz_nEVTfKWcqdz8MwKGOsaBRHSyWm7n-kUBzu_oofTJ2JZ-u1K-WVG_mnEUsjllprFzZzr7j9Riw3NmJ5Z_ZDFsF6Csh8jGdmxkE6kLl33iBYVuMJgZ2UM4WDbeDghMw81AsTy3BllkwAKXs1z23S9lXJe8rj1Ch-nED-u1b51ZcfLb4CAAD___NmimY) about the disappearance of his wife, Lynette Hooker, during a sailing trip in the Bahamas. Hooker told authorities his wife fell from an 8-foot dinghy near Elbow Cay on April 4 as the couple headed back to their sailboat. He says she was [wearing an engine safety lanyard](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uxCAQhJ_G7rAwBv8UFGncXdqU1h5em00wWIAO3dtH5BVSrLTSaGb0zddjewA58ucnXKjzETaPJTnMGeNmgj8jpkTBg8NsyaRiKaPdBBcj45L1atuB3HuT7a4PRIFDi7qfplHIeq3VBidQKNS09MOihFiMmnBe-uFAPsvxaEnXNC571XM-cdmNwzwMB5-VUtKYXTSS4045xO47kM8WD_cOL4ydCVfrtM35Ts3w0Yi1EWsppTPPVCmq3oi1vo1Yn5HAMxvCD0bm3r4iskIHsp0S3DdCBG-QPcHCBYldmBKcWK1t1PtdyDlK49RIfl5A7q89_2uylxa_AQAA__-qDYGP) that shut off the engine when she went overboard, leaving him to paddle to shore for seven hours before reaching a marina and alerting police. Lynette's daughter has publicly questioned her stepfather's account, calling her mother an experienced swimmer and [suggesting the incident was preplanned](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupCAYhZ8GOwwCihYUm2xMtphttzQIP_JvECbAHTNvf-O8wi1OdZIv5zv_HtvDYMR0_DUn6ObzluCqEVqDstmcjgK1Yk4mQgto6xWwQdg44xNlkg7j5gzG9yY7pz0AB9GBHpSauLzTBe397OS-W6HAOCuUFZZPduF-8ODFPneobxqTwzgwppjsJzEL4dk8jqO01nEiGThsufT_M6YWwMd3fkHpbT67qENrz0rEL8JXwlez29ugP_JdE77-SQ1KMu0jQfgavupukqNXPk2iBZ65NHD0xFoxHdT4BoXe-D2b4uhugjlNpXhjXggXOMLX2nJ5E7GiI-L3IIZlUWxRXdHueWGMWCdFJDtOg_Gzsv3o2pfm3wEAAP__sOKQbg). The U.S. Coast Guard has [opened a criminal investigation,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O5CAUhE-DMyzA-KcDgk2c9aYbWs_m0bwdDBagRn37kecKE5RUUklV-urfc3sCBYqvv3CiqS5tEVsJWCvm7UjxlbEUShECVk9HaZ4q-k0JNXGhuRw3CxQ-m-6scYgKhw6NnOdJ6VudNzDjPAIMj11Ki1I_HnIRzjm7LHJ2YurI3G1Cy1EKMQvdT8MyDE4s4zjq47CKaYGWasr9_0SxenThk96Y-yOdXTC-1quw4Q9TK1Nra60_9nJT3DlT622ZWvdMELlP6QszzxgQClreyCEPn3gD8x08nFC4pQLXhZAhHsjU2mVjr0YhUJlmpsXrBAo_6_VXl72N-g4AAP__KTqB_g) and Bahamian police say Hooker remains a suspect.

I was born in 1979. Officially I'm Gen X. But, I also sit in a weird transition generation people now call Xennials. We grew up analog and then lived through the transition into digital, and now we are living through the transition into AI in real time.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pmJwxTJc2CWHYA26tz0LKzraPUjX8SVSQzLjopo_SQU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193920232)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pmJwxTJc2CWHYA26tz0LKzraPUjX8SVSQzLjopo_SQU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193920232)
We had maps in the back seat, corded phones, street lights telling us when to come home, and suitcases without wheels. We also watched America move from being a manufacturing and industrial powerhouse into the internet age, the smartphone age, and now whatever this next AI era is going to become. That is why this moment feels familiar to me. We have seen this kind of economic and technological shift before.
When manufacturing jobs left the United States, people were told to "learn to code" like that was some serious answer to a huge national problem. It was not a serious answer. It was unrealistic, dismissive, and pretty damn offensive. You had people in their forties and fifties, people raising families, paying mortgages, and trying to make it to retirement, being told to just go learn a completely different technical skill and rebuild their lives. Everybody knew that was bullshit. It sounded clean as a slogan, but it did not match the reality of people's lives.
I think we are back in that same moment again. The difference is that this time it is not factory workers being told to learn to code. This time, it is the people who already learned to code who are watching their jobs change.
## The Job Already Changed
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pmJwxTJc2CWHYA26tz0LKzraPUjX8SVSQzLjopo_SQU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193920232)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pmJwxTJc2CWHYA26tz0LKzraPUjX8SVSQzLjopo_SQU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193920232)
Over the weekend I was at a wedding, and I ended up talking to a lot of people who are software developers and engineers. Every single one of them told me some version of the same thing. A year ago, their job was writing code. They sat down in front of their computer, solved problems, debugged, and wrote code all day. Now, their job is much more about prompting AI to write code, checking AI's work, correcting it, and guiding it toward the result they want. They are not doing the same job the same way. That shift did not take ten years. It took about a year.
That is the part I think people are missing. This is not some far-off theory about the future. It is already happening in the sectors closest to the technology. That does not mean all those jobs are gone, and I am not saying every layoff is directly tied to AI. But the work itself has changed, and once the work changes, the next question is obvious. How many people do you actually need to do it?
That is where we have to start asking questions. Some research says AI could displace or significantly change around 6 to 7 percent of the U.S. workforce over time, while broader estimates range from 3 to 14 percent depending on how adoption unfolds. That is millions of jobs. However, ["Predictions that technology will reduce the need for human labor have a long history but a poor track record," Briggs and Dong](https://substack.com/redirect/2f8e8cda-f38d-4dde-8188-e20e663a4f85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Roughly 60 percent of U.S. workers today are in jobs that did not exist in 1940, and about 85 percent of employment growth since then has come from technology-driven change. So yes, jobs will be created too. That is how these transitions usually work. But that does not mean the transition is painless, and it definitely does not mean it is evenly distributed.
The people I worry about the most are not even the developers I talked to, because at least for now, they still have jobs and are adapting. I worry more about the next group coming up. The sixteen-year-old deciding what to study. The eighteen-year-old heading into college. The twenty-two-year-old taking on massive debt for a profession they think is stable. Entry-level legal work, paralegals, marketing, graphic design, admin work, call centers, software support, and a lot of basic knowledge work all look vulnerable to some degree.
Even in health care, I think a lot of non-specialty or general practice work could get compressed through telehealth and AI tools. The issue is not that AI replaces every human being. The issue is that it reduces the amount of labor needed, and when that happens, the entry point usually disappears first.
## The Warning Signs Are Already Here
Now, I am not saying that every big layoff is AI. But when you start seeing tech layoffs pile up while companies are simultaneously making huge investments in AI infrastructure, you would have to be asleep not to at least ask the question. As of April 11, 2026, TrueUp's tracker shows more than 91,000 tech layoffs this year across more than 200 companies.
That is why I think we are entering "learn to code 2.0." The first version hit manufacturing towns and industrial workers. This version is likely to hit white-collar and entry-level knowledge work much harder. And if that happens, it becomes a regional problem, a tax base problem, a housing problem, and a social problem. We saw what happened when manufacturing left places like Cleveland, Pittsburgh, and Detroit. We know what dislocation looks like. The only difference this time is that the geography could be different and the workers being hit might wear business casual instead of steel-toed boots.
What really hit me after that wedding was not that the sky is falling tomorrow. It was that the public conversation still feels behind where reality already is. The people closest to the technology are telling you their jobs changed fast. The market data is showing tens of thousands of layoffs in the sectors closest to AI. The research is telling you millions of jobs are at least exposed to change. And yet most of the conversation is still either hype or denial.

Friend,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I’ve always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven’t received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That’s why I’m proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you’ll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL0OmzAUhZ_GbCD_4YTBQ6WILV07oot9DU6NsexL-vpVIvUFup5zdPTp-_VcnhBTzNtPONBWCktty46pvMwbCSvkFmL2r6tRdLhILk3PdS_GpdSzFXS0iM5b7zwI16EVt5uReuJCdbu9G8UlmFEoz4Fzp7mCsN7DtAJqENBF-znkWoyCKy7EEMwUtF65mu7GjFIxzSFhpaFiudYUHWSC9juc1eHgzqNLdicqjakfTM5Mzg3dVXGAjP6kz-KTEWTfx9zTjv0Ghcm5QA-O4pmZmi86FgdHgbhlph7_iJg03-bMhJmYelQKXbW-_IkpxWZuTPPtgJi-HPS_7t5W_g0AAP__85d_4Q)

Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten.

What happens when there are too many college grads?
This week on the podcast I interview Noam Scheiber, the author of "Mutiny: The Rise and Revolt of the College-Educated Working Class." Noam painstakingly interviewed and followed college-educated employees who tried to unionize stores and warehouses at Starbucks, Apple and Amazon for several years. He also followed a young Hollywood writer who was part of the 2023 strike.
"I showed up at one of the first Starbucks stores that tried to unionize in 2021 in Buffalo," Noam relates. "I noticed that a lot of the unionizing workers were college graduates who had showed up to Starbucks as an interim gig but then found themselves there for years. I thought there was something to dig into." He wound up following one Starbucks employee, Teddy Hoffman, for three years who had been working at a Chicago Starbucks location after graduating from Grinnell College as Teddy's store voted to unionize.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4d823084-3655-48ad-875c-3f4fb0bfa3e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"Underemployment of college graduates is all over the news today because of AI," Noam says, "but the truth is that it's a trend that has been building for years. A lot of college grads went to work at Starbucks or Apple as a waystation job before the pandemic until they could get the kind of job they got a degree for, but instead found themselves semi-permanently part of the retail workforce." Indeed, Teddy had already been working at Starbucks for seven years with his degrees in Theatre and English before unionizing, though he eventually became a teacher. "Because they're college-educated, they have a certain worldview and confidence about them. I was impressed when they would just look up the details of the National Labor Relations Act, for example, to see what employers could and couldn't do."
Where there were fewer college graduates, there were more social and cultural barriers to organizing. "Each Starbucks store was kind of the same in terms of the makeup of their employees," Noam observes. "This is one reason why unionization at Starbuck stores spread to 650 locations, while at Amazon, it hasn't translated to multiple fulfillment centers." The 650 Starbucks stores in the U.S. represent about 6.5% of Starbucks' 10,000 locations in the U.S.
One of the admirable aspects of Noam's book is that it doesn't sugarcoat how hard it is to unionize in these environments. "Technically, employers aren't allowed to discriminate against workers who are looking to unionize. But any grievance with the National Labor Relations Board can take years, during which a lot of these employees might have already moved on. And employers can all of a sudden start enforcing rules that were always on the books that can make an environment very unpleasant or increase benefits for non-unionized stores." For example, a worker could get fired or disciplined for being 5 minutes late because there's a rule against tardiness that ordinarily doesn't get enforced, or non-union employees could get a new benefit that unionizing stores don't get because any new benefit has to be collectively bargained.
Indeed, the human aspect of "Mutiny" is its most compelling aspect; seeing Teddy and other retail workers try to organize over months and years makes you feel for them. Teddy becomes a father for the first time, and he and his wife apply for government benefits because money is short and Starbucks has reduced his hours. But he continues on because he wants to see the campaign through.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b3a0ce33-9113-4fbd-a2a4-a9846dd43c2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So what lies ahead? Noam says, "One thing I can say with confidence is that this population is going to change our politics. Young college graduates voted for Zohran Mamdani, for example, at a rate of 84%. When do you see a number that high?" Indeed, one of Peter Turchin's conditions for revolution is an oversupply of elites. The ambitions of young people can go dark pretty quickly when the future they were promised fails to materialize, which is unfortunately going to be the case for more and more of them as 42% are currently underemployed - and rising.
When I ran for President I was more likely to talk about truckers or retail workers than I was college grads being displaced by AI. But every 23-year old who returns home to their parents' house with stifled ambitions and deferred dreams represents a big lost opportunity. As that becomes the new normal, the costs to both the individuals concerned and the country will be profound.

The person I had deported was the far-right murderer of Victor Jara.
Victor Jara, was a beloved folk singer murdered by the fascist Pinochet regime. For Chileans he is what Bruce Springsteen is to Americans.
Because of his reputation as an advocate for poor Chileans and for social justice, when the Pinochet government took control in a violent coup in 1973, Jara was abducted, tortured in front of a packed soccer stadium, executed, and his body was publicly displayed as an example.

Peter, tonight at midnight, our mid-month deadline will come to a close.
Before that happens, I’m hoping there’s something I can say to convince you to make your first donation to help us hit our $250,000 goal.
What if I told you that, according to National Journal, North Carolina is the #1 Senate race in the country _and_ the Senate seat most likely to flip?
What if I told you that a recent poll shows me statistically tied with my MAGA opponent?
And what if I told you that far-right Republicans are already pouring millions into this race to defeat me – including making a seven-figure ad buy – and **the only way I can fight back is with grassroots support from people like you?**
**[A contribution of $5 or even just a few bucks would go a long way toward helping us reach our $250,000 goal before tonight’s deadline and win this toss-up race. So please, can I count on you to chip in?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/9233?t=8&akid=1037%2E124072%2EurHo0Z)**

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

| | I want to take a moment today to share a personal story with you, Friend.
It’s a story about how an early morning church service and a sermon referencing Psalm 121 left an imprint on my soul and strengthened my faith.
When I arrived at West Point as a new cadet, I had no idea how much it would transform my life.
During my first plebe summer, I attended an early morning church service. The sermon referenced Psalm 121:
**“I lift my eyes to the mountains- where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.” Psalm 121**
**That psalm and my time at West Point have been a touchstone ever since, sustaining me during difficult moments in my life.**
When I decided to run for U.S. Senate, I made a promise to come to Washington and work with fellow political outsiders like President Trump to shake up business as usual. Now I’m working to fulfill that promise every single day.
We need leaders in DC with the strength, the will, and the moral clarity to meet the challenges we face. **So, if you’re looking to continue the status quo, I’m not your guy.**
But if you want to help me continue my fight to change the way things are done in DC, I need your support. Our average online donation is $21.38, and **_[I would be so grateful if you would generously give that amount today.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbGu3CAQRb8Gd17BALa3oIi0cvdSRJFSIjzMrskDGwHOKn8febXpUqU992pGR_fHh_1wIYbt8dUlMqXdbal23Z9uI1fi77SXLWwPXI-CayULHIaeq15om8teM2GzovPGo3cCOzJiHAfQ1-kqu9UILwegScFVqmWCZVFc34E4Xcdh8l50wZwHuRJaSCkkvwzoSU9cL5qD1KNiirtIpV0K5WOJAd3WXP287wXpgnvqollby5XJLwxmBnMlPApdnmEr5M8Ggzkh7iUF_OyzYzDn6mLqBYj-ZUPJhdj_zI7J-WjJ1v0oSEzeTgTDiRL5cCQmb_lVftOGTN6-fZ-h_yvxDtCl7MJjY_L2Trj919OuGJ-fIcZQh5Ep_jjhy6r97xK_DPwJAAD__zVFl0k)_**
I’m no stranger to fighting for what is right, and ****if we don’t continue pushing every single day to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it!****
There are too many pressing issues we must solve to hold back now. Whether it’s illegal immigration and the fentanyl crisis or inflation and the cost of living, we cannot afford to lose ground.
Here’s where I need your help, Friend. I hate asking for money — I’m not a career politician, and it’s not in my nature — but I have no choice but to ask if we’re going to continue fighting to advance our cause to change how things are done.
Democrats from all over the country are panicking and pulling out all the stops to attack Republicans who are shaking up Washington. They’ve even gone as far as shutting down the government and refusing to come to the table to work with us to reopen it. That’s why I’m hoping you can spare **_[$25, $50, or even $100 to help me fight back.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbGu3CAQRb8Gd17BALa3oIi0cvdSRJFSIjzMrskDGwHOKn8febXpUqU992pGR_fHh_1wIYbt8dUlMqXdbal23Z9uI1fi77SXLWwPXI-CayULHIaeq15om8teM2GzovPGo3cCOzJiHAfQ1-kqu9UILwegScFVqmWCZVFc34E4Xcdh8l50wZwHuRJaSCkkvwzoSU9cL5qD1KNiirtIpV0K5WOJAd3WXP287wXpgnvqollby5XJLwxmBnMlPApdnmEr5M8Ggzkh7iUF_OyzYzDn6mLqBYj-ZUPJhdj_zI7J-WjJ1v0oSEzeTgTDiRL5cCQmb_lVftOGTN6-fZ-h_yvxDtCl7MJjY_L2Trj919OuGJ-fIcZQh5Ep_jjhy6r97xK_DPwJAAD__zVFl0k)_**

**But a judge may have just SAVED the future of public media, declaring Trump’s attacks a direct violation of the First Amendment!**

[**This is proof that our fight is WORKING. So we’re gathering 15,000 signatures to celebrate this incredible victory and THANK public broadcasters for refusing to back down »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/107023?t=7&akid=23656%2E878179%2EcU5ZjA) | [**Stand with Public Broadcasters: Chip in $3 to sign now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/107023?t=8&akid=23656%2E878179%2EcU5ZjA)

FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you! To all public broadcasters,

Thank you. Thank you for enriching all of our lives — in rural and urban areas, and everywhere in between — with your various news and educational programs.

I couldn’t be more THRILLED to see Trump’s disgusting executive order blocked. _His authoritarian power grab didn’t stand a chance against our fight._

**I also know that Trump’s attacks on the free press don’t end here — he wants to shut down MS NOW, CNN, and anyone else who holds him accountable.**

It’s not just upsetting, _it’s a dangerous step towards an**outright dictatorship!**_ That’s why I’m not getting complacent.

**Can you step up today and help us fund this critical mailer?**

Just the other day, I met with my friend, **Tim Tebow** , in Tulsa and we caught up on life, our kids and everyday life. But the conversation took a _very dark turn_ when my run for Congress was brought up. Timmy shared about how recently, he went and shared before Congress about the GREATEST evil our nation faces: **CHILD S*X TRAFFICKING**. The amount of abuse and trafficking of children taking place in America is actually hard to believe. I was blown away with how bad it is... Timmy shared this reality with Congress and the result has been NOTHING... Therefore, Tim shared with me about what needs to be done if I am fortunate enough to represent the people of **Oklahoma's 1st Congressional District** in DC to END this atrocisty. I am making **YOU** a promise: if I am in Congress, you can count on me addressing this issue with everything I have and shouting from the rooftops, "**PROTECT OUR CHILDREN!** " I believe it is shameful that Congress has refused to act in order to protect our most vulnerable in America. If you want someone in Congress who will address this EVIL head on then I need your help. I have two opponents who are trying to buy this election and if elected unfortauently will do nothing more than **go along to get along** in DC. If we are going to win this then I need you to step up and help fund our message. It is vital that right now that we have the money necessary to reach the voters in CD-1 before June 16th. **I believe the children in America are worth protecting**. I am asking you to sacrifice a Starbucks coffee this week and make a donation of $10 to help protect America's children. Maybe you can do more but this is an election that we MUST win. I want to thank the over **600 individual donors** who partnered with us so far. You can help us win this election and protect America's children by donating at [www.jacksonlahmeyer.com](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=28922585.14563.1.5d83d6d33aa00495aacef04bba96a30b) Your help allows us to be on TV, radio and send out mailers. Also, please consider posting on social media that you support #[LahmeyerForCongress](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=28922585.14564.1.c3f7e97df139b32839795ae24b702056) this makes a BIG difference. I promise that if you will help me get elected that I will do my very best to make you proud. Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer

I want to take a moment and share with you the **pathway of VICTORY** for #[LahmeyerForCongress](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=28922585.14567.1.e3f8793d1e35254cbdfc04f685a65f03). In 2018, there was a very crowded field of Republican candidates running for CD1. **Kevin Hern** got into the runoff with **22.7% of the vote** and then went on to win the runoff and general election. His path to victory is also our path to victory. The race I am in is a very crowded field (12 candidates!) but this crowded field helps us. When I ran for Senate in 2022, we **over performed** beyond everyone's expectations. All the polls and experts said we would be lucky to break 10%. Across the state of Oklahoma we actually got 26% of the vote but that's not as exciting as what I am about to share with you. In 2022, I received around **32% of the vote in Congressional District 1**. That means, if I can hold the base of voters that already voted for me once then we could find ourselves in the runoff which positions us for victory like **Congressman Kevin Hern** in 2018. Here are the advantages that #[LahmeyerForCongress](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=28922585.14568.1.146a42f939098737eeb355f90e6fadeb) has against all the other candidates that are running. **First** , my name has appeared already on a ballot across CD1 (name ID is a major factor in primary elections). **Second** , there are only 64 days until the election on June 16 which helps us tremendously because it will be very difficult for all the candidates to introduce themselves to the voters across the entire district. **Third** , I have already received enough votes in this district to position me for the runoff if we can hold our base. I truly believe that we are positioned to win this election. In order to do so, we need to make sure our base of voters know that I am in it and what I will do if I was fortunate enough to be elected. I am running for Congress in Oklahoma's 1st District to do several things: **-Keep Our Borders Secure** **-Remove Illegal Criminals From Our Streets** **-Help Make Living In America Affordable For Americans** **-Not Allowing The Chinese Communist Party To Own American Farmland** **-Ensuring That Sharia Law Never Takes Root In Our Nation** I promise that if you will help me get elected that I will do my very best to make you proud. Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer

The redistricting amendment passing in Virginia would be a real national victory.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260415-503&t=1&akid=503%2E12592%2E_3kdTc)

It’s Tim Walz. Trump has been on a months-long national power grab where he has urged Republicans to stack the deck for the 2026 midterm elections.
This is the moment that we’re in, and it demands urgency from all of us if we want to fight back.
This is exactly where Virginia comes in. **Virginia is our opportunity to stop Trump’s MAGA power grab in its tracks.**
[**Can you join me in supporting the YES campaign for redistricting in Virginia by donating $3 or more today? I’d really love to have you beside me**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260414_2.qQZktJ&amount=3&refcode=20260415-503&t=3&akid=503%2E12592%2E_3kdTc)**[.](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260414_2.qQZktJ&amount=3&refcode=20260415-503&t=4&akid=503%2E12592%2E_3kdTc) **

Unfortunately, Trump and his far-right opponents like Peter Thiel have billions of dollars at their disposal to flood the Commonwealth with misinformation. YES campaign opponents have already used over **_$30 million_** to lie and deceive voters.
Early voting is underway, and Republican voters are turning out in greater numbers right now. Although the YES campaign is narrowly leading the opposition in the polls, we don’t have time to slow down.

Tim Walz

April 15, 2026

Unless you are a political junkie, you may never have heard of California Congressman Eric Swalwell. But he was a darling of the Left and liberal media for leading the Russian hoax investigation against President Trump and for serving as the manager (prosecutor) during President Trump's second impeachment trial.
Feted at fundraisers and a regular on MSNOW and CNN, Swalwell was an A-List political star. Celebrities such as Robert De Niro and Sean Penn contributed large sums to his campaigns. He even appeared on Jimmy Kimmel's show.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69d649db-f5ea-47a5-98dd-779ff9f947b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Congressman Eric Swalwell

Then suddenly, [an article](https://substack.com/redirect/6be71f77-7337-4e46-b037-377c68594cf4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the San Francisco Chronicle, accused him of sexually abusing some of his staff members. Swalwell vociferously denied this but immediately, leading fellow Democrats, Senator Adam Schiff (California), Nancy Pelosi (former House Speaker from San Francisco), Democratic House Leader Hakeem Jeffries along with other Democratic Party luminaries were calling for his head.

Within twenty-four hours, Swalwell changed from being the favorite to become the next California Governor to someone who will now have a hard time finding a job bagging groceries.

But how is this possible? Even hard-core Republicans like me when first reading the attacks on Swalwell believed he had a right to defend himself and not have his career destroyed in twenty-four hours.

Why did this happen?

The answer is obvious. Everyone, including the Democratic Party insiders along with liberal media hypocritical feminists already knew that Swalwell was abusing women but looked the other way because he was a leader in attacking President Trump. He was even sending pictures of his private parts to women. A true class act.

But what changed?
What happened was Swalwell's presence in the California jungle primary for the Governor's Mansion increased the chance of a Republican victory in this Deep Blue state.

In order to destroy the Republican Party, California [created a primary system](https://substack.com/redirect/dd6e7a99-17b5-4a8b-b0b8-e3a3996c0103?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that doesn't recognize party lines. In other states, there are specific rules for what qualifies as a political party. For example, in my home state of Connecticut, Democrats and Republicans are recognized as a political party along with some minor parties such as the Green Party and the Working Families Party. Each of these parties has mechanisms for nominating their candidates. In Connecticut, this is done by a combination of conventions, signature gathering and if necessary, a primary for each party. The nominees then appear on the ballot in the general election in early November.

But California jettisoned this system into what is now referred to as "[the jungle primary"](https://substack.com/redirect/dd6e7a99-17b5-4a8b-b0b8-e3a3996c0103?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in which there is only one primary for a given election for all the political parties. The two candidates who get the most votes are then on the ballot in general election. The result is that in many instances, the two top candidates are both Democrats.
But this election cycle, there were so many Democrats running for Governor that the two Republicans running were neck and neck with Swalwell meaning that it was possible that the two winners would both be Republicans, locking the Republicans to take over the Governorship in the November election.

This could not be tolerated and odds are that one of Swalwell's Democratic opponents leaked this story to the San Francisco Chronicle and the press dutifully did the Democratic Party's bidding to prevent a Republican victory.
And to add insult to injury, it became known that Swalwell was paying his nanny, an illegal immigrant from Brazil, under the table to watch his three children while his extremely tolerant wife pursued her career.

Not only is Swalwell now dead in the water, but he had to resign his House seat also. But the Democratic strategy appears to be working. With Swalwell out, one of the other prominent Democrats running - Katie Porter or Tom Steyer - will emerge as one of the top two candidates. Maybe even both. The result will be that the Democrats will easily hold the Governor's mansion.
Degenerate behavior is not unique to Democrats. Texas Republican Congressman Tony Gonzalez cheated on his wife and mother of his five children with one of his staff members. When the relationship soured, the poor woman committed suicide. He has chosen not to run for reelection. Florida Republican Matt Gaetz reported paid an underaged women for sexual access and his career is now toast. And President Trump was [cavorting with a Playboy bunny](https://substack.com/redirect/7a3fc51f-0a38-4e9a-85be-edf94f66a672?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when his present wife Melania was pregnant with his son Barron.

If you want saints, go to church. But stay away from politics.

| | Friends,

As we head into the general election, I want to take a moment to clearly explain what sets me apart in this race and why it matters for the future of Michigan.
This Sunday, April 19, Democrats will endorse either Oakland County Prosecutor Karen McDonald or Washtenaw County Prosecutor Eli Savit. While they come from different backgrounds, they share a similar approach to the role of Attorney General.
Both first became prosecutors after being elected in 2020. Both have aligned themselves with the agenda of the current Attorney General, an approach that has too often prioritized politics over public safety and used taxpayer dollars on politically driven cases. And both have demonstrated a willingness to act as political advocates rather than impartial prosecutors.
My path has been very different.
I began my career as an Assistant Prosecutor in 1996 and was elected Eaton County Prosecutor in 2013. I did not enter this profession through politics. I worked my way up, case by case, earning the trust of my colleagues and the people I serve. My focus has always been on applying the law fairly and doing the job the right way.
Eli Savit has built a reputation as a far-left activist. Early in his tenure, he issued policies declining to prosecute certain offenses, including prostitution, minor drug crimes, and some felony gun cases. Prior to taking office, he served as Senior Legal Counsel to the Mayor of Detroit. His record reflects a philosophy of selectively enforcing the law.
Karen McDonald has built her career with a clear focus on political advancement. While she has experience as a prosecutor, private practice attorney, and circuit court judge, her path has consistently aligned with positioning herself for higher office rather than a sustained commitment to impartial prosecution.
Her tenure as prosecutor has included controversial and highly debated decisions, most notably in the Oxford High School shooting case involving charges against the shooter's parents.
While some viewed those charges as groundbreaking, others raised serious concerns about the legal theory and its broader implications. At the same time, questions have been raised about the ethics surrounding the handling of the case, including the level of media access granted during an ongoing prosecution and whether the pursuit of national attention overshadowed the responsibility to handle the case with the utmost care and focus on the victims and their families.
Despite their differences, both candidates have made it clear they intend to continue the same approach we have seen from the current administration.
I offer a clear alternative.
I entered this race to restore focus to what the Attorney General's office is supposed to be: a place where the law is applied fairly, consistently, and without political influence.
As Attorney General, I will make decisions based on the law and the facts, not politics. I will ensure taxpayer dollars are used responsibly. And I will work every day to deliver equal justice under the law for all Michiganders.
When you ask what sets me apart, the answer is simple:
I am a prosecutor, not a political activist.
Thank you for your continued support. Now let's get to work.
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

Peter,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

clean_body: Why this Memorial Day matters more than ever| | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. name: Matt Ortega
subject: I'm focused on the June 2 primary
body:
I will not run in the special election for the remainder of Eric Swalwell's term. | | | Friend— I wanted to reach out to you about the last few days. The allegations of sexual harassment and sexual assault against Eric Swalwell were deeply disturbing. The bravery of those who came forward and the depth of the reporting compelled me to call for his resignation. On Monday, he made it official. It's the first step toward healing. Governor Gavin Newsom, however, announced a special election to fill the seat for the remainder of the term. Here's the situation. A special election primary will be held in June. If no candidate secures a clear majority, a run-off will follow in August. These elections are wholly separate from the June 2 primary for which we've striven these last few months. To be clear: **I will not be a candidate in the special election.** The winner will serve only weeks in D.C. while Congress is in session. I am not interested in a four-month vanity term. Instead, I'm focused on securing one of the top two general election spots in the June 2 primary for the full two-year term. These last few days, however, are a reminder. The broken system that allowed this man to reach the heights he did is the same broken system that allowed housing, health care, and child care to be out of reach for working families. clean_body: I will not run in the special election for the remainder of Eric Swalwell's term. | | | Friend— I wanted to reach out to you about the last few days. The allegations of sexual harassment and sexual assault against Eric Swalwell were deeply disturbing. The bravery of those who came forward and the depth of the reporting compelled me to call for his resignation. On Monday, he made it official. It's the first step toward healing. Governor Gavin Newsom, however, announced a special election to fill the seat for the remainder of the term. Here's the situation. A special election primary will be held in June. If no candidate secures a clear majority, a run-off will follow in August. These elections are wholly separate from the June 2 primary for which we've striven these last few months. To be clear: I will not be a candidate in the special election. The winner will serve only weeks in D.C. while Congress is in session. I am not interested in a four-month vanity term. Instead, I'm focused on securing one of the top two general election spots in the June 2 primary for the full two-year term. These last few days, however, are a reminder. The broken system that allowed this man to reach the heights he did is the same broken system that allowed housing, health care, and child care to be out of reach for working families. What if your next vacation could also help power climate action here in Oregon?
With OLCV’s Annual Celebration raffle, that’s exactly what your $100 ticket does. You’ll be entered to win a choose-your-own-adventure dream getaway, and whether or not you win, your ticket will help us do something powerful: recruit and mobilize volunteers to protect Oregon’s environment. In fact, one ticket can help us recruit up to three volunteers to take action for climate and conservation. [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
Here’s what you could win:
🌴 Coastal Cabo Oceanfront Escape ( click here to see more! [https://youtu.be/8feUF78fa7s] )
A 4-night stay for two at a luxury beachfront resort in Cabo San Lucas: think infinity pools, ocean views, and total relaxation.
🏔️ Jackson Hole Winter Adventure ( click here to see more! [https://youtu.be/YkLQx7DhD6M] )
A 3-night alpine getaway with lift tickets, breathtaking mountain scenery, and your choice of a wildlife sleigh ride or distillery experience.
🌌 Grand Canyon Luxury Glamping ( click here to see more! [https://youtu.be/ldXeaK1CK2I] )
A 3-night stay in a panoramic Sky Dome near the Grand Canyon, complete with stargazing, live music, and unforgettable desert sunsets.
Buy your raffle ticket [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
No matter which trip you’d choose, every ticket purchased fuels OLCV’s work to fight climate change, protect Oregon’s natural places, and build a stronger environmental movement.
So yes, you might find yourself sipping a margarita in Cabo, skiing fresh powder in Jackson Hole, or stargazing at the Grand Canyon...
But even if you don’t, your $100 will still go a long way in helping us organize, advocate, and win for Oregon’s future.
Tickets are $100 and limited. Get yours now! [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
Thank you for being part of this work. And good luck, you just might be packing your bags soon!

# **Oklahoma principal tackles Columbine-obsessed shooter after being shot in the leg**
Kirk Moore, 60, **[charged at 20-year-old Victor Lee Hawkins](https://substack.com/redirect/23c18a34-95fc-4753-adad-b7ff68e1a1e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --armed with two loaded semi-automatic pistols--in the lobby of Pauls Valley High School last Tuesday, according to surveillance footage. Heart-stopping video shows Hawkins pointing his weapon at Moore's head and firing a shot that struck the principal's right leg before Moore tackled him onto a bench, pinned down his gun hand until the weapon dropped, while another staffer in a red shirt rushed in to help kick the gun away.

Hawkins admitted to stealing the guns from his dad and said he "wanted to conduct his own school shooting like the Columbine shooters did," referring to the 1999 massacre that left 14 victims dead.
* **More** : Moore, who has worked in the school district for more than 35 years, was the only person injured and is "healthy and recovering" after hospitalization. Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation's Hunter McKee said "The actions of the staff and the principal stepping in as soon as they saw a subject with a firearm saved lives today." Hawkins faces shooting with intent to kill and other firearm-related charges, with a court appearance scheduled for May 8.

# **Biden creates awkward moment at Syracuse portrait unveiling, telling Black trustee he looks like Obama**
Former President Joe Biden, 83, spotted Syracuse University Board of Trustees Chairman Jeffrey Scruggs during his portrait unveiling at his alma mater Tuesday and said "I always want to turn around to one guy and say ... **['Barack, what are you doing?'"](https://substack.com/redirect/570149d4-1893-4a04-b99d-326996b8c7e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Biden repeatedly demanded Scruggs come to the podium--"Come here, come here, come here"--despite the chairman's apparent reluctance, then asked the audience "Doesn't he look like Barack?" as Scruggs shook his head disagreeing.

* **The backstory** : Scruggs reportedly told Biden backstage that his daughter wanted him to ask if he looked like Obama, and the onstage moment was meant to show the daughter that Biden believed her dad resembled his ex-boss, according to the Daily Mail.

# **Virginia Gov. Spanberger expands assault weapons ban despite DOJ lawsuit threat**
Democratic Gov. Abigail Spanberger signed gun-control bills Tuesday and toughened a proposed **[assault-firearms ban by removing the word"fixed"](https://substack.com/redirect/9007c600-d77a-4ad2-b390-b2f641860f54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from the definition--a change Republicans say could "sharply expand the range of semi-automatic rifles and pistols swept into the ban" to include "any firearm that can accept a magazine of more than 15 rounds."
House Minority Leader Terry Kilgore said the amendment "appears to create a ban on the vast majority of firearms in Virginia that are in common use for legal purposes."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9007c600-d77a-4ad2-b390-b2f641860f54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **DOJ warned of constitutional challenge** : The Justice Department warned in a Friday letter that the measure "raises constitutional concerns" and threatened legal action, with Assistant AG for Civil Rights Harmeet Dhillon writing "This letter provides formal notice that the Civil Rights Division will commence litigation in the event the Commonwealth of Virginia enacts certain bills that unconstitutionally limit law-abiding Americans' individual right to bear arms." Dhillon cited unanimous Supreme Court opinion that the AR-15 is "both widely legal and bought by many ordinary consumers" and tweeted "@SpanbergerForVA is on notice: 2A rights SHALL NOT BE infringed."
* **What the bills do** : The assault weapons ban would prohibit future sale, transfer, manufacture and importation of covered firearms and magazines over 15 rounds starting July 1, 2026, creating a Class 1 misdemeanor for violations while grandfathering legally owned firearms. Spanberger also signed bills requiring firearm industry members to adopt "reasonable controls" to prevent illegal sales, banning leaving guns in plain view in unattended vehicles, and prohibiting ghost guns.
