Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on me right now.
After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.

subject: LETLOW ENTITIES TO REPORT MASSIVE HAUL FOR Q1
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
Trump-Endorsed Conservative Builds Massive Financial Momentum as Cassidy Collapses

| | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=21f6696aca&e=95355a072c)
| | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** April 15, 2026
**LETLOW ENTITIES TO REPORT MASSIVE HAUL FOR Q1
** _Trump-Endorsed Conservative Builds Massive Financial Momentum as Cassidy Collapses_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** – Congresswoman Julia Letlow and aligned entities will report approximately **$8 million** for the first quarter of 2026, a major show of financial strength for the Trump-endorsed conservative as she builds momentum heading into the final stretch of Louisiana’s U.S. Senate race.
Letlow will report over **$4.3 million directly to campaign entities** , including nearly **$1.9 million raised in 70 days** and a $2.4m transfer from her congressional account. Pro-Letlow outside groups [are reported](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=49ae613416&e=95355a072c) to have raised **$3.8 million** , bringing total resources for the quarter to approximately **$8 million**.
Letlow for Louisiana will report more than **$2,275,000 cash on hand** , giving the campaign substantial resources for the final stretch before the May 16 Republican primary.
_“I am humbled by the support pouring in from every corner of our state,”_**said** **Congresswoman Julia Letlow.** _“Louisianans are ready for a senator who stands with President Trump and fights for our families, our values, and the future we owe our children. I am grateful for every supporter who has stepped up, and I will keep working to earn every vote between now and May 16.”_
Bill Cassidy and his allies have spent more than $10 million attacking Letlow since she entered the race, but those attacks have failed to stop her momentum. [Multiple independent polls](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=ac8b56614b&e=95355a072c) now show Letlow leading the race while Cassidy has fallen to third place.
“ _Bill Cassidy and his never-Trump allies lit ten million dollars on fire trying to stop Julia, and they have nothing to show for it,”_**said Parker Carey, Campaign Manager for Letlow for Louisiana.**_“Louisiana Republicans have made clear they want the Trump-endorsed conservative, not the senator who voted to convict President Trump.”_
_###_

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

**Our actual field launch list 👇**

Your donation will be put to work immediately to help us shape the future of voting rights in America. If you’re skeptical about how your donation can do this, please let me explain:

This isn’t the time for fear, though, Derek, it’s the time for action. I want to tell you directly that the DNC won’t let this happen. We’ll defend your right to vote. We’ll protect your right to a free and fair election. clean_body: Derek, Earlier this month, Trump signed an executive order to restrict mail-in voting and give the Department of Homeland Security direct oversight over who can vote. The DNC is filing a new lawsuit to stop him immediately, and Derek, the unfortunate truth here is that we have a narrow window to act here, which is why we need your help right now. Your donation will be put to work immediately to help us shape the future of voting rights in America. If you’re skeptical about how your donation can do this, please let me explain: Last year, Trump signed an executive order that could have disenfranchised married women who changed their names and members of our armed services. We sued, this grassroots team rallied behind us, and we won in court. Since then, Trump has sought to “take over” state-run elections, he’s used the FBI to seize ballots from election offices in Georgia, and he’s tried to coerce states into giving him access to their voter rolls. Now, he’s taking it to a new level: His new executive order directs the federal government to build a voter list for each state to decide who can and cannot vote — and he’s told the Postal Service to refuse to carry ballots for anyone not on its new list of eligible voters. This isn’t the time for fear, though, Derek, it’s the time for action. I want to tell you directly that the DNC won’t let this happen. we’ll block his order from going into effect. We’ll defend your right to vote. We’ll protect your right to a free and fair election. And, when November rolls around, we’ll make sure Democrats can kick these right-wing authoritarians out of office. body:
It’s serious, which is why I’m bringing this up again

| | | | | | | | | It's come down to this, Peter...

I'll be honest, I was counting on a bigger response to my last message. But I'm not one to give up easily. As a former Navy helicopter pilot and a nurse practitioner, I know what it means to persevere in the face of adversity.

But the reality is, I can't keep going without your support. The Radical Left has made me their number one target, and they'll stop at nothing to take me down. They've vandalized my office, spread lies about me on TV, and spent millions to try and defeat me.

_**I didn't get into politics to get rich or famous.**_ I did it because I couldn't sit idly by while the Democrats pushed our country further and further to the left. As a mom and a patriot, I knew I had to act.

So, I'm taking a leap of faith and asking for your help. I know it's a lot to ask, but I need your support to keep fighting. [**Can you chip in just a few dollars today to help me prepare for the battles ahead?**](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)

subject: With Honor Action Joins Allied Leaders in London ✈️🇬🇧
body:
Plus, upcoming events.

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=1e00ad314a&e=33f53a5b1a)
| | | | |
---
| | Hi Peter,
This past weekend, With Honor Action joined heads of government, senior military leaders, policymakers, industry executives, and media at the 2026 [London Defence Conference](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=56022d62e5&e=33f53a5b1a) (LDC). This annual gathering of allied nations focuses on elevating the importance of defense and security in an increasingly complex global landscape.
Held at the historic Old War Office in Whitehall, LDC convenes allied leadership to confront the defining questions in defense and security. Our participation reflects the strong relationships that With Honor Action has cultivated across government and allied defense communities to advance our shared, bipartisan priorities with the veterans in the [For Country Caucus](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=7ec023c351&e=33f53a5b1a).
This year's conference centered on a single, urgent theme: **warfighting readiness**. Senior officials delivered frank assessments, warning that current capabilities may be insufficient for sustained large-scale conflict. They called for accelerated rearmament across the U.K. and NATO, reinforced by major procurement announcements. LDC 2026 marked a clear shift from strategic dialogue to coordinated action, as allied nations respond to a more volatile global environment.
---
|
---
| | On day two of LDC, With Honor Action sponsored a roundtable with the [National Security Commission on Emerging Biotechnology](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=6ecc791351&e=33f53a5b1a)[ (NSCEB), placing American biotechnology policy at the center of an allied defense forum.](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=e0148d94dd&e=33f53a5b1a)
Conducted under the Chatham House Rule, the private session brought together senior representatives from allied governments, industry, and research institutions across three continents. Participants explored the growing role of biotechnology as a cornerstone of national security and economic strength.
This discussion builds on a landmark year for American biotechnology. In December 2025, Congress passed a significant package of biotechnology provisions informed by the [NSCEB's Final Report](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=dd1d55251a&e=33f53a5b1a), including [17 With Honor Action-supported measures](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=c221a9a374&e=33f53a5b1a) to strengthen biotechnology across the defense and intelligence communities. Those provisions addressed national security coordination, defense-focused development and manufacturing, supply chain resilience, and expanded allied collaboration.
---
|
---
| | The conference concluded with remarks from Al Carns, a Member of Parliament, Minister for the Armed Forces, Royal Marines veteran, and a partner within With Honor Action’s network. On the transatlantic alliance, he was unambiguous: the UK-US relationship "is not measured in commentary. It is measured in what we do and what we have done."
Last October in Washington, Minister Carns joined us for the With Honor Action’s [Strength in Democracy Forum](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=ecd17ce25c&e=33f53a5b1a) and toasted the transatlantic alliance at our [Gala](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=6938ba1431&e=33f53a5b1a), a relationship that reflects the kind of allied engagement LDC exists to deepen.
With Honor Action remains committed to advancing bipartisan veteran leadership and strengthening the alliances that underpin global security.
---

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=41153%2E3422442%2EXFxPbB)
Peter,
**Actor Edward Norton joined Katie Porter** to check out California’s innovative emission-capturing technology in action.
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260415_1_ak.XaUVJ1&refcode=em20260415-41153&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41153%2E3422442%2EXFxPbB)
The STAX team captures emissions coming off cargo ships in Los Angeles, eliminating harmful pollutants that hurt our environment and our lungs.
For too long, port communities have borne a $6.5 billion healthcare burden because of pollution like this.
But by investing in technology that cuts emissions at the source, we can save more than we spend—protecting both public health and California’s environment, and creating good-paying jobs.
**As governor, Katie will fight to reduce emissions across California—so more communities can breathe clean air and avoid the high costs of pollution.**
That’s the kind of leadership Californians deserve. But winning this race won’t be easy, and we need your support. Environmental leaders are standing with Katie. Can she count on you too, Peter?

What we're doing about it
Early voting is underway in Virginia's April 21 referendum on the most gerrymandered congressional map in American history.
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e15350246/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvcEFtdTlmTTZCZA/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0MTU/LbmNsN3laUzY5cQ/qP2hpZHM9bmN6MUJ0VzBFczV5dlBscw/gad-7WA/s0kc15deba1)
| Patriot, Early voting is underway in Virginia's April 21 referendum on the most gerrymandered congressional map in American history. And Hakeem Jeffries is spending $20 million to make sure it passes. For every $1 we have on the air showing Virginia voters the truth about this map, Hakeem Jeffries and George Soros have $10. Their ads are running in every media market in the state during every single commercial break, but we are still beating them. However, we need more resources ASAP. **Here's what I know: when Virginia voters learn the facts, they vote NO.** **[What your contribution does today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e15350246/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS92aXJnaW5pYW5zLWZvci1mYWlyLW1hcHMtcmMvc2ItZDQxY2IyZmI5OTMyN2FhYi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0MTU/LbmNsN3laUzY5cQ/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImbW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjI4MThfd3IxK3RhcmdldCUzRA/gad-7WA/scvdc3af117)**
---
| | • | $50 puts our ad in front of 500 Virginia voters who haven’t seen the truth yet.
---|---
• | $250 funds a full day of digital outreach to low propensity voters.
• | $1,000 helps us match Jeffries dollar-for-dollar in a single media market for 24 hours.
If this map passes, here is what happens: **Four Republican congressional seats could be eliminated before a single vote is cast in November.** Putting us in a dangerous spot heading into November’s midterm elections. Hakeem Jeffries made a calculation: if he spent enough money in Virginia fast enough, he could win before Republicans could respond. He is now at $20 million. Twenty million dollars in television, digital, and direct mail — all of it pushing a single message based on lies to Virginia voters: vote yes. Voters are not falling for the lies claiming this map is ‘fair.’ Nonpartisan political scientists (read: Liberals) have called it the most lopsided gerrymander in United States history. But Jeffries isn’t buying fairness. He’s buying repetition. And repetition, at $20 million worth of frequency, starts to sound like truth. If we don’t have the resources to respond at scale, he’s going to get away with it. **[That’s why we need you to step up - right now.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e15350246/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS92aXJnaW5pYW5zLWZvci1mYWlyLW1hcHMtcmMvc2ItZDQxY2IyZmI5OTMyN2FhYi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0MTU/LbmNsN3laUzY5cQ/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImbW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjI4MThfd3Ix/gad-7WA/sfp93dc90b1)**

Gas prices are through the roof. Grocery costs keep climbing. Family budgets are getting crushed. And when asked how much this war is costing American taxpayers, Trump's own budget director basically shrugged.
I couldn't believe my ears when I heard Vought say it, and I had to write to you right away.
THIS IS WHAT WE'RE FIGHTING AGAINST!
An administration so reckless, so irresponsible, so disconnected from reality that they can't even tell you what their failed war costs. They just keep spending, keep escalating, keep making promises they can't keep -- and working families foot the bill.
Meanwhile, Louisiana farms are going under. Small businesses are struggling. Good people are choosing between filling their gas tank and buying groceries.
But Trump can't give you a ballpark estimate on his war spending? That's not leadership. That's incompetence.

body:
As governor, I will put Texans first
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**It’s Tax Day, Peter.** Today, millions of Americans are doing what we’re supposed to do, filing on time and paying our share.
But while everyday Texans are doing the right thing, Greg Abbott has spent the last 12 years using his power to reward his billionaire donors and political allies instead of serving the people who actually pay the bills.
**That’s why Texans are stuck paying what I call the _Greg Abbott Corruption Tax._**
While Abbott hands out tax breaks and sweetheart deals to his corporate buddies, regular families are priced out of buying a home. While he puts profits over patients, Texans struggle to get the healthcare they need. And while he funnels _billions_ into his private school voucher scam, our neighborhood public schools are being drained, and teachers are being asked to do more with less.
At every turn, Abbott has chosen corruption over Texans.
As governor, I will put Texans first. I will fight to lower costs, protect public schools, and make sure our state government works for working Texans, not the wealthy few.
**But we have an important mid-month fundraising goal of raising $75,000 by midnight tonight. Goals like this are critical in building the resources we need to compete with Abbott’s $106 million war chest.**

body:
[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
It’s
Jocelyn.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/4057?t=1001&akid=1596%2E181023%2ENhpfz4 ]Before I continue, will you please step up today
and make your first contribution to our campaign ahead of
our mid-month deadline at midnight?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/4057?t=1002&akid=1596%2E181023%2ENhpfz4 ]Donate

I’m
running for governor because I learned early on that doing the right thing
even when it’s hard is what makes a good leader.

And right now, with the chaos and confusion coming out of Washington, we
need strong leaders at the state level who are willing and ready to do the
right thing.

As Secretary of State, I’ve learned that standing up to powerful people
often comes with pressure, criticism, and even threats. When people tried
to interfere in our elections and overturn the will of the voters, I stood
firm. Not because it was easy — but because it was right.

I stood up. I told the truth. I protected your vote.

And I'm ready to do that as your governor.

Because that's who we are as Michiganders. We stand up to bullies. We
don't back down. And we don't let anyone take our voices away.

Because leadership isn’t about what’s easy — it’s about doing what’s
right, even when there’s pressure not to. That’s especially true right
now.

Michigan needs a governor who will stand up for people and won’t back down
when it matters most.

But I’ll be honest, this race is already
competitive. Outside money is pouring in, and the attacks are only going
to grow. The only way we can keep up is if we build a campaign strong
enough to compete from the start.

Jocelyn

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Friends, as you know, Democrats across the country are working on all fronts to fight Trump’s midterm power grab and regain control of the House this November.
Here in CA, we did our part passing new maps through Prop 50 in November — and coming up this Tuesday, Virginia will vote on a referendum to redraw their congressional districts and combat Trump’s attempts to skew the map in the GOP’s favor.
This is such an important part of our efforts, so I’m reaching out to some of my closest supporters for help: will you volunteer to call Virginia voters before Tuesday’s Election Day?
You can sign up to phone bank with Virginians for Fair Elections on weekdays here [https://www.mobilize.us/virginiansforfairelections/event/899732/?referring_vol=12585038&share_context=dashboard-event-details&sharer_role=2] or over the weekend right here [https://www.mobilize.us/virginiansforfairelections/event/899736/?referring_vol=12585038&share_context=dashboard-event-details&sharer_role=2] .
This amendment gives voters the ability to level the playing field, and it’s a critical step in our work to protect democracy and win a Democratic House majority.
The polls show Virginians strongly support this referendum, but there’s a ton of right-wing misinformation out there trying to confuse voters, so volunteer outreach is so valuable in these final days before the election.
Sign up now:
* Make calls during the week [https://www.mobilize.us/virginiansforfairelections/event/899732/]
* Make calls over the weekend [https://www.mobilize.us/virginiansforfairelections/event/899736/]
* Send text messages [https://www.mobilize.us/virginiansforfairelections/event/899762/]
California has been leading the way on this issue, and we have another opportunity to make a difference right now by helping Virginia voters get the information they need ahead of Election Day.
Thank you for stepping up to help!
—Sara

My old boss Howie Carr talked a lot about the Kinsley Gaffe.
The Kinsley gaffe is not like Joe Biden on stage last night claiming that a random black guy [looks like Barack Obama](https://substack.com/redirect/f555860f-cf68-4f2d-a05c-0d6283d3c00b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Nor is it like Biden, at the same event, quipping, "[Theyaigotmarrediscanus](https://substack.com/redirect/3af123f2-21cb-46b5-b14e-27bbfc18bf47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after my first year in law school."
The Kinsley Gaffe is a special kind of gaffe that is only a political error because what was said was true.
Such is the case with the Kinsley Gaffe committed by Secretary of State Shenna Bellows, a Democrat candidate for governor, on Facebook yesterday.
In a painful straight-to-camera video that none of these politicians do as well as the team at the _[Maine Wire](https://substack.com/redirect/6f402219-7c41-4721-8146-229ec864c74f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , Bellows began with the following: "When I was a kid, our schools were ranked as some of the best in our the (sic) country. Now they're ranked as some of the worst."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1615ed7e-11ad-43ec-b166-3cb96b65c9b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
According to Facebook's edit history, which unfortunately for Bellows is a thing that exists, the post was edited to remove the factually accurate claim that Maine's public schools, relative to other American public schools, are among the worst.

Indisputably, the claim is true. But even worse than that, Maine's schools have experienced this precipitous collapse in quality and student performance even as all taxes in Maine have skyrocketed.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/48024c1c-8c77-4995-9970-e4af42f6e88b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The drop in school quality has come even as Maine Gov. Janet Mills and Democrat-controlled legislatures have poured money into public school administrations.
Which is part of the reason why Bellows need to clean up the Kinsley Gaffe here: By saying a true thing about the quality of Maine's schools, Bellows was accidentally admitting that eight years of progressive policies -- the same policies that she would support as governor or even expand upon as governor -- have made Maine's public schools worse, not better.

In one little Facebook post, she just dropped a nuclear bomb on not only her own education platform, but all of the tax-and-spend policies and all of the "woke" left policies imposed under the Mills Administration.
Ouch.
Here's to hoping Bellows starts to make a habit out of telling the truth.

American football is arguably the greatest sport ever invented. As someone who has been a naturally gifted athlete, blessed with abilities I did not earn, but were merely given, I've had the opportunity to play multiple sports throughout my life. At the collegiate level, I competed in three different sports, yet none compared to the sheer brilliance of football. With the Super Bowl upon us, it's my pleasure to share my perspective on why there is no doubt in my mind that this game reigns supreme.
As a health and fitness expert, I am always in awe of the level of physical preparation, strategic complexity, and athletic diversity that football demands. It is a sport unlike any other, requiring unparalleled mental and physical fortitude. From the intricacies of game planning to the physical demands on the athletes, football is the ultimate test of human ability and endurance. Let's break down exactly why I feel this game is the pinnacle of sport.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=194214855&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk0MjE0ODU1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzYyNzI0MDgsImV4cCI6MTc3ODg2NDQwOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.3C8ux7N1AIXKjL_7XMCQe5j2bqQqWhjno03g8Zelzik)
**The Complexity of Football: A Mental Chess Match and a Physical Gauntlet**

Football is often compared to chess, and for good reason. It is a game of extreme mental complexity--every play requires split-second decision-making, with players needing to read defenses, anticipate movements, and execute precise actions under immense pressure. Quarterbacks must dissect defensive schemes in real time, linebackers must anticipate play calls, and offensive linemen engage in a battle of angles, leverage, and timing.
Yet, unlike chess, football is not played in a calm, calculated environment--it is played at full speed, under the pressure of bone-crushing physicality. The sheer combination of speed, agility, and strength that unfolds on every play is unparalleled. No other sport demands this level of mental processing, while simultaneously requiring explosive athleticism. Each snap is a collision of strategy and raw power, where intelligence meets instinct in a high-stakes battle for dominance.
Adding to the complexity is the structure of the game itself--four quarters of play, multiple ways to score, and the constant momentum shifts that can change the outcome in an instant. A single play can swing the game in favor of one team, making every snap a high-stakes moment. This level of unpredictability keeps both players and fans engaged, as the pressure of the game builds to a climactic finish.

**The Diversity of Athletes: A Sport for Every Body Type and Background**

Unlike many other sports that favor a specific body type, football is a game that welcomes all shapes and sizes. From the massive offensive linemen to the lightning-fast wide receivers, every position has a unique physical requirement, creating a sport where diverse body types and genetic predispositions can shine. Some athletes are built for brute strength, others for finesse and agility, yet all play crucial roles in the game's grand design.
Moreover, football has become a global phenomenon, attracting talent from around the world. Players from every ethnicity, background, and socioeconomic status have found a home in this sport, making it one of the most inclusive athletic competitions on Earth. The diversity of skill sets, and backgrounds is part of what makes football so special--every player brings their unique abilities to the field, working together in pursuit of a common goal.
At any given moment, both teams have 11 players on the field, facing each other in opposition on every play. The sport thrives on the constant battle between the favored team or athlete and the underdog, an ongoing storyline that plays out in every game. The excitement of watching the momentum shift, the thrill of the unexpected, and the drama of individual matchups make football one of the most riveting sports in existence. Fans not only root for their favorite teams but also engage in friendly wagers and strategic bets, further deepening their connection to the game.
A trend that brings me great joy is the rise of national girls' flag football tournaments. This growing segment of the sport showcases the athleticism and competitiveness of young female athletes and paves the way for further expansion. As a proud father of two young girls, I hope to see this trend continue to develop into high school, collegiate, and even professional women's football leagues. The inclusion of women in football strengthens the sport as a whole and inspires the next generation to take the field with confidence.

**The Revenue and Popularity: A Global Juggernaut**

Football isn't just a sport; it is an economic powerhouse. The NFL alone generates billions of dollars annually, and its influence extends far beyond the field. From television contracts to merchandise sales, football fuels multiple industries, creating countless jobs and business opportunities. The Super Bowl is the most-watched sporting event in America, attracting millions of viewers worldwide and generating record-breaking advertising revenues.
The sheer size and scope of the production surrounding each game are astonishing. Hundreds of companies and multimillion-dollar industries exist solely to support football--whether through sportswear, nutrition, training equipment, analytics, or broadcasting. Few sports can claim the level of economic impact and cultural significance that football has achieved.

**The Uniqueness of the Sport: Born and Bred in America**

Unlike sports that have evolved from others, football is uniquely American. It was not borrowed from another nation, nor does it resemble any other sport in its structure. From the number of players and coaches to the gridiron field itself, football stands apart. The field, with its meticulously marked yard lines, hash marks, and end zones, was built for football's fast-paced action and strategic plays.
One of the most fascinating discussions on this topic can be found in the article _Football Red, Baseball Green_ , which explores the fundamental differences in how these two sports operate. Football is structured around controlled chaos--organized violence where order must be imposed through strategy and teamwork. The rules, the field, and even the way time is managed within the game create a distinct experience, separate from any other sport in history.

**The Playoff Structure: A Grand Spectacle Leading to the Super Bowl**

Unlike other major sports with long, drawn-out playoff series, football operates on a high-stakes, single-elimination format. Every playoff game is a do-or-die battle, adding to the intensity and unpredictability of the postseason. This structure leads to the grandest spectacle in American sports: the Super Bowl.
The Super Bowl is more than just a championship game--it is a cultural phenomenon. It is designed for television, with high-budget commercials, extravagant halftime shows featuring the world's biggest music stars, and an economic boom for the host city. Each year, cities compete fiercely for the honor of hosting, as the influx of visitors brings hundreds of millions of dollars in tourism revenue. No other championship event creates this level of impact.

**The Science of Football: Nutrition and Training at the Highest Level**

Football players are modern-day gladiators, and the level of science behind their training and nutrition is staggering. These athletes must optimize their diets to fuel peak performance, carefully balancing macronutrients, hydration, and recovery. Strength and conditioning programs are built around maximizing explosiveness, speed, and injury prevention, incorporating cutting-edge sports science and recovery techniques.

**My Personal Connection: A Lifelong Love for the Game**

As a young kid, I always dreamed of playing in the NFL. Football wasn't just a game to me. It was a path to discipline, teamwork, and self-improvement. The sport taught me how to set goals, push my body beyond its limits, and sharpen my mind, like a warrior preparing for battle. It also taught me how to work with others under pressure, just as in life, where adversity and challenges often arise. The ability to perform under high-stakes situations carries over into business, family, and leadership.
For all these reasons, I firmly believe football is the greatest sport ever invented. It is a game of complexity, diversity, strategy, and raw physicality. As we celebrate another Super Bowl, let's take a moment to appreciate the beauty of this incredible sport and the dedication of those who play it at the highest level.
Football isn't just a game--it's a testament to human will, determination, and excellence.

As a proud father of two young girls, I hope to see this trend continue to develop into high school, collegiate, and even professional women's football leagues. The inclusion of women in football strengthens the sport as a whole and inspires the next generation to take the field with confidence. The Revenue and Popularity: A Global Juggernaut Football isn't just a sport; it is an economic powerhouse. The NFL alone generates billions of dollars annually, and its influence extends far beyond the field. From television contracts to merchandise sales, football fuels multiple industries, creating countless jobs and business opportunities. The Super Bowl is the most-watched sporting event in America, attracting millions of viewers worldwide and generating record-breaking advertising revenues. The sheer size and scope of the production surrounding each game are astonishing. Hundreds of companies and multimillion-dollar industries exist solely to support football--whether through sportswear, nutrition, training equipment, analytics, or broadcasting. Few sports can claim the level of economic impact and cultural significance that football has achieved. The Uniqueness of the Sport: Born and Bred in America Unlike sports that have evolved from others, football is uniquely American. It was not borrowed from another nation, nor does it resemble any other sport in its structure. From the number of players and coaches to the gridiron field itself, football stands apart. The field, with its meticulously marked yard lines, hash marks, and end zones, was built for football's fast-paced action and strategic plays. One of the most fascinating discussions on this topic can be found in the article Football Red, Baseball Green , which explores the fundamental differences in how these two sports operate. Football is structured around controlled chaos--organized violence where order must be imposed through strategy and teamwork. The rules, the field, and even the way time is managed within the game create a distinct experience, separate from any other sport in history. The Playoff Structure: A Grand Spectacle Leading to the Super Bowl Unlike other major sports with long, drawn-out playoff series, football operates on a high-stakes, single-elimination format. Every playoff game is a do-or-die battle, adding to the intensity and unpredictability of the postseason. This structure leads to the grandest spectacle in American sports: the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl is more than just a championship game--it is a cultural phenomenon. It is designed for television, with high-budget commercials, extravagant halftime shows featuring the world's biggest music stars, and an economic boom for the host city. Each year, cities compete fiercely for the honor of hosting, as the influx of visitors brings hundreds of millions of dollars in tourism revenue. No other championship event creates this level of impact. The Science of Football: Nutrition and Training at the Highest Level Football players are modern-day gladiators, and the level of science behind their training and nutrition is staggering. These athletes must optimize their diets to fuel peak performance, carefully balancing macronutrients, hydration, and recovery. Strength and conditioning programs are built around maximizing explosiveness, speed, and injury prevention, incorporating cutting-edge sports science and recovery techniques. My Personal Connection: A Lifelong Love for the Game As a young kid, I always dreamed of playing in the NFL. Football wasn't just a game to me. It was a path to discipline, teamwork, and self-improvement. The sport taught me how to set goals, push my body beyond its limits, and sharpen my mind, like a warrior preparing for battle. It also taught me how to work with others under pressure, just as in life, where adversity and challenges often arise. The ability to perform under high-stakes situations carries over into business, family, and leadership. For all these reasons, I firmly believe football is the greatest sport ever invented. It is a game of complexity, diversity, strategy, and raw physicality. As we celebrate another Super Bowl, let's take a moment to appreciate the beauty of this incredible sport and the dedication of those who play it at the highest level. Football isn't just a game--it's a testament to human will, determination, and excellence. Editorial comments expressed in this column are the sole opinion of the writer. Thanks for reading! | | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/votebraun/release-john-braun-announces-run-for-congress-in-washingtons-3rd-district-10101247?e=90b300faf9)

| | | | | |
Today is Tax Day.For families and small businesses across Southwest Washington, and everywhere in America, it’s a reminder of how much of your hard-earned money gets taken before you ever have a chance to use it for your family, your business, or your future.As a business owner, I’ve lived this firsthand. I’ve handed out paychecks to employees and put my names on the back of tax bills. I know how frustrating it is to watch more and more of what you earn get taken away. I know what it means to balance the books, make payroll, and still deal with a tax system that makes it harder to grow and succeed right here at home.That’s why I want you to know: I see it, I understand it and I’m grateful you’re in this fight with me.Your generous support of my campaign means we’re building a team rooted in Southwest Washington values...hard work, personal responsibility, and the belief that government should live within its means, just like you do.That’s exactly why I’m running for Congress.When I go to Washington, DC, I’ll take the priorities of Southwest Washington with me and fight to make Tax Day less expensive and less burdensome for hardworking Americans. That means pushing for lower taxes, simpler rules, and a government that respects the people who fund it.But none of that happens without you.Campaigns like ours are powered by people who are willing to stand up, speak out, and say: enough is enough.So on this Tax Day, **I want to say thank you**.Thank you for being on this team.
Thank you for believing in this mission.
And thank you for helping us build something that can actually make a difference for Southwest Washington and for the country.We’ve got a lot of work ahead, but I’m glad we’re doing it together.Sincerely,
John BraunP.S. If you’re able to chip in today, it would be a meaningful way to mark Tax Day and help us keep fighting for a future with lower taxes and more opportunity for Southwest Washington families and all Americans. | Peter,

Today is Tax Day, and for many Montgomery County families, it is not just a reminder. It is a reality check.

At the exact moment families are feeling the intense pressure of higher gas prices, groceries, and housing, county leaders are proposing even higher taxes.

**A 6.3 property tax rate increase — which is closer to 12% with assessment increases. An income tax increase. New fees on residents and small businesses.**

_You cannot make Montgomery County more affordable by making it more expensive._ [_**And if you agree with me that more affordable solutions are possible**_**,**_**I hope you will stand with me by chipping in to the campaign so I can make this County work better for everyone**_**.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129524469/614642283/-1721553747?refcode=BLU_EM_AFMC_2026-04-15_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmM4M2NkYy1mMDM4LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cEyEsB3rP5qsFowhYOPzKcGI_xgxa2UggMF688osRZ0=)

clean_body: Today is Tax Day, and for many Montgomery County families, it is not just a reminder. It is a reality check. | = | Peter, Today is Tax Day, and for many Montgomery County families, it is not just a reminder. It is a reality check. At the exact moment families are feeling the intense pressure of higher gas prices, groceries, and housing, county leaders are proposing even higher taxes. A 6.3 property tax rate increase — which is closer to 12% with assessment increases. An income tax increase. New fees on residents and small businesses. You cannot make Montgomery County more affordable by making it more expensive. = | = Earlier, I asked Montgomery residents if they could afford the new tax increases being proposed. The response made one thing clear:families are struggling and cannot afford another hit. On the County Council, I’ve worked hard to oppose repeated tax hikes and to lower taxes and deliver relief to low-income residents and seniors on fixed incomes while still protecting our schools and services. With serious fiscal leadership, we can manage the county responsibly without asking families to pay more. That is the approach I will take as County Executive. Families deserve a County Executive who understands what they are going through and acts on it. If you’re sick of endless tax increases every year being proposed as the only solution to our problems, I am asking you to stand with me. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Gratefully, = * | | = By Authority: Friends of Andrew Friedson, Rose Hacking, Treasurer Friends of Andrew Friedson PO Box 2562 Rockville, MD 20847 United States | =

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. name: Wes Moore
subject: Leave no one behind
body:
[1]LeftNet

It’s
Governor Wes Moore.

Five years ago, I had never run for political office. I was a former Army
Captain, a dad to two young kids, and I ran one of the largest
poverty-fighting organizations in the country.

But I knew more had to be done. While career politicians were saying that
everything was great, I was hearing from folks all across Maryland who
were feeling left behind. So I ran for Governor with a mission to make
Maryland a state that serves all our people — and won. (And I’m not done
yet!)

Our mission must continue this year. I’m running for re-election so we can
keep building on the progress we’ve made on jobs, education, public
safety, and more. There are tough fights on the horizon, and there’s so
much more for us to accomplish together.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=leftnet_em20260415_partner_ms_wes_em_leftnet.Zhc2v-&refcode=em20260415-1611&t=1001&akid=1611%2E2118727%2EA6KRM- ]I’m asking you to join our team by chipping in $5 or $10 right now.
Every dollar we raise helps defend this seat and build a campaign that’s
ready for the challenges ahead.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260415_partner_ms_wes_em_leftnet.c1m_8H&refcode=em20260415-1611&amount=5&t=1002&akid=1611%2E2118727%2EA6KRM- ]DONATE ››

We’re making real progress — investing historic amounts in public
education, bringing down costs for working families, and making our
communities safer.

But we’re still in the federal government’s line of sight. Donald Trump
has attacked me before, and he and his powerful GOP allies are going to do
everything possible to flip our state back to red come November. This
election could be an uphill battle.

This powerful team has never backed down from a fight, and I know you are
not about to start now. We have to hit the ground running because our
momentum now determines how we’re able to run the rest of this campaign.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22593?c0=leftnet_em20260415_partner_ms_wes_em_leftnet.eSjgFE&refcode=em20260415-1611&amount=5&t=1003&akid=1611%2E2118727%2EA6KRM- ]Please, chip in $5 right now so we can defend this seat.
Every donation helps us start the next phase of our campaign strong and
fight back against Republicans’ advantage.

It’s time
for us to come together again, across regions and party lines, to prove to
a dysfunctional Washington that there’s a better way forward.

Elevate,

Wes

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=leftnet_em20260415_partner_ms_wes_em_leftnet.Zhc2v-&refcode=em20260415-1611&t=1004&akid=1611%2E2118727%2EA6KRM- ][IMG]

| | Dear Friend,
I apologize. The email I sent yesterday had a non-functional link embedded. I have updated the link, and resending to you today. Please read the short email, and consider helping, if you are able. -Rick

I see how much work there is to be done in the state, and how much farther we need to go before we have ensured the security and well-being for future generations of North Dakotans.
I was a state legislator for District 7 from 2012-2022. I thought I was done, but I can’t just sit here - especially when I know I can do so much more!
**My plan is straightforward** : When I am re-elected, I have bill drafts ready to go that will provide much greater accountability and transparency of where our tax dollars really go. I will continue to protect your free speech, your 2nd Amendment right, and your private property rights. I will never stop trying to reign in needless and wasteful spending.

**I’ll be honest with you;** in the past I stuck to my principles.... **and** I openly held other elected officials accountable. Let me tell you, that is a **big** job, and it’s one that doesn’t make many friends. I will always do whatever is right, friends or no friends, but I now realize holding other legislators accountable **cannot** be my responsibility.

body:
This is why our mission is so important.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260415-1&t=1&akid=3373%2E587540%2EKchFnx)
Peter,
As of April 1, _68 voting members of Congress_ have announced their retirements.
**Leaders We Deserve was built for this exact moment.** When I was in college part of what I studied was the history of the Cold War and in particular I remember learning about the end of the Soviet Union. One of the reasons for its rapid collapse was that they had three leaders die one after another within 2.5 years. When I looked at Congress, it was clear soon we would have a power vacuum ourselves brought on by leaders either retiring very soon or sadly dying in office. Now, that hypothesis is coming true with 68 members retiring, and we have the opportunity of a lifetime to build a better Congress.
Every time an older member retires, we have an opportunity to elect someone from the next generation who is ready to lead and not just be a younger version of the same corrupt people we have there now. That's why our candidates reject corporate PAC money. But because of that it takes real resources to compete in races across the country. That’s why your support matters so much.

clean_body: This is why our mission is so important. Peter, As of April 1, 68 voting members of Congress have announced their retirements. Leaders We Deserve was built for this exact moment. When I was in college part of what I studied was the history of the Cold War and in particular I remember learning about the end of the Soviet Union. One of the reasons for its rapid collapse was that they had three leaders die one after another within 2.5 years. When I looked at Congress, it was clear soon we would have a power vacuum ourselves brought on by leaders either retiring very soon or sadly dying in office. Now, that hypothesis is coming true with 68 members retiring, and we have the opportunity of a lifetime to build a better Congress. Every time an older member retires, we have an opportunity to elect someone from the next generation who is ready to lead and not just be a younger version of the same corrupt people we have there now. # [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2170%2E791427%2EPUvN1e)
I’m going to be real with you, our campaign saw a huge outpouring of support during the first three months of 2026, but since then, our fundraising has dropped off quite a bit.
Since you’re a trusted part of this campaign, I want to share this chart from behind the scenes:
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-apr26.yEIO3a&refcode=em260415-1-180&t=2&akid=2170%2E791427%2EPUvN1e)
This chart shows the amount of donations coming into our ActBlue over the last three weeks. We had a strong finish at the end of March, but now we are **_way, way_** behind our goals for April.
Maybe it’s just the cost of gas and groceries going up, the focus on Trump’s reckless actions on the world stage, or the way the media has moved on from the important stories coming out of Minnesota. I can’t say.
But here’s the thing: Our fundraising goals are not arbitrary. We are working to win reelection, organize our neighbors in Minneapolis, and advance our agenda of accountability for Trump and affordability for the working class.
When we miss our goals, it hinders our ability to afford to do all of that. It makes it hard to stay competitive in the face of corporate mega-donors, billionaires, and Super PACs.
So please: [**Make a contribution of whatever you can to my campaign today and help us get back on track. This movement is powered by grassroots donations, which means we rely on everyone to do their part when they can.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-apr26.yEIO3a&refcode=em260415-1-180&t=3&akid=2170%2E791427%2EPUvN1e)

name: Eric Burlison for Congress
subject: ICE told me what Biden did to them
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Eric Burlison for Congress]()
body:
And they're still trying to defund them.

| | | | | [|
---](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=5ab8e94b8d&e=5f9dc01b8c)
| | Peter ,
Last week I sat down with ICE officials. What they told me should make every American furious.
For four years under the Biden-Harris administration, they were told to do nothing.
Do nothing while violent criminal aliens roamed free in our communities. Do nothing while prosecutorial discretion was turned into a get-out-of-jail-free card for thousands of criminals. Do nothing while catch-and-release flooded towns across America with people who should never have been here.
That policy had consequences. Real consequences. Families across this country are mourning people they should not have had to lose.
And now, instead of fixing it, some in Congress want to reward it. There are members pushing amnesty as the answer. Let me be clear: I am a hard no. You do not solve a crime crisis by legalizing the people who broke the law to get here. Amnesty is not compassion. It is an invitation for more of the same.
When President Trump took office, we got to work. The results speak for themselves:● Illegal border crossings are at the lowest level since the 1970s● Zero illegal aliens released into the interior for 10 straight months● The Laken Riley Act is now law, mandating detention of illegal aliens charged with violent crimes● Over $170 billion in border security funding delivered through the One Big Beautiful Bill● Thousands of new ICE agents, expanded detention capacity, and real deportation operations
I have visited our local ICE facility. They are busting at the seams, operating with limited resources to do an enormous job. They are doing heroic work, and they need more support, not less.
**But here is what keeps me up at night.** Even after everything we have seen, Democrats are STILL blocking full funding for DHS and are the cause of a partial government shutdown. They want to carve out the parts of the DHS funding bill they do not like and leave the agents who protect your family out in the cold.
That has never happened before in the history of appropriations battles in Washington.
I am doing everything I can to end this. I am pushing for a reconciliation vote to fully fund ICE and Border Patrol. I am urging local law enforcement across Missouri to join the federal 287G program, which provides up to $60,000 per officer per year for agencies that partner with ICE. I am calling on Missouri to start collecting accurate data on crimes committed by illegal aliens, because right now Texas is the only state doing it, and you cannot fix what you do not measure.
**I am not going to stop. But I need your help.** House members run every two years. The campaign never stops. And the people who want open borders and defunded law enforcement are already raising money to replace people like me with people who will look the other way.
If you believe that the agents who protect American families deserve to be funded, fully and without conditions, I am asking you to stand with me today.
[**> > STAND WITH ME — DONATE TODAY <<**](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=964a12fea9&e=5f9dc01b8c)
Even $10 or $25 makes a difference. It tells me you have my back, and it helps me keep this seat so I can keep holding them accountable.
Standing firm,

| | **A NOTE FROM CHRISSY**
---
Derek,

I know that one of my most important jobs is ensuring that our federal government actually works for all of us. While too many of my colleagues in Washington focus on partisan theater, my priority has always been delivering pragmatic, commonsense solutions that make life easier and safer for our families.

The last six weeks have been a testament to that mission. Despite the alarming headlines and the ongoing chaos that is our Republican-controlled Congress, my team and I are pushing on and have even secured some important wins for our community.
| | **New Federal Dollars Directly to PA-06**
---
A community is only as strong as its infrastructure and its critical nonprofit organizations, which is why I’m proud to have secured over $12 million in federal community project funding. These aren’t just abstract figures; these are direct investments in our daily lives. Here are just a few:
---
* $3.1 million to fix the bottlenecking on Route 30 in East Whiteland Township
* $850,000 to build a new station for the Goshen Fire Company, ensuring our first responders have the state-of-the-art facilities they need to keep us safe
* $2 million to the Reading Area Community College to expand their Schmidt Training and Technology Center

---
| | **Fighting for the Women Who Fight for Us**
---
As an Air Force veteran, I know that our national security is strongest when we utilize the full talents of our force. In response to Secretary Pete Hegseth’s dangerous and unfounded skepticism about the ability of women to effectively serve in combat, I introduced the WARRIOR Act. This bill protects the role of women in combat and ensures that every servicemember is judged by their ability to do the job. By maintaining true gender-neutral standards, we aren't just protecting the right to serve; we are ensuring our military remains the most capable and lethal fighting force in the world.

I also led the charge on a War Powers Resolution to reassert the constitutional authority of Congress. President Trump’s Iran war is unauthorized, unwise, and unpopular. We owe it to our military families to ensure that when we commit our nation to conflict, there is a clear mission and bipartisan oversight.
---
| | **Serving You**
---
In addition to the legislation that impacts everyone in the country, my team is also focused on the work that helps people one at a time. We recently reached a milestone, returning over $70 million in lost or backlogged funds to people in PA-06 since I was first elected. This includes appealing VA denials, resolving stalled or incorrect Social Security payments, recovering delayed or incorrect IRS refunds, and more.
---
| | **We Can’t Do This Alone**
---
The progress we’ve made is significant, but the road ahead is challenging. As we approach a pivotal election cycle, the stakes for our community couldn’t be higher. We need to keep a voice in Washington that prioritizes results over rhetoric and service over self-interest.

If you believe in the work we’re doing, I hope you’ll consider making a **[contribution](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129525941/614647175/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1245-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YzE3MzBlNy1mNDM4LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FQGfqk4DkmGkhzEG-D_x6ULc1-psNX7cBweM4zjv8YY=)** today. | [](https://substack.com/redirect/1096494f-ad86-415a-9131-c9b337c03c93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

I remember watching investors in 2008 hold their breath...Waiting for their portfolios to recover. Some never did.
Today, markets still swing wildly. Headlines change by the hour. And most retirement accounts are built on one hope:
"Eventually, it'll go back up."
But what if retirement wasn't about waiting? What if it was about building income?
Over the past 20+ years, I've refined a structured approach designed to pursue **consistent weekly cash flow** using options -- without day trading, without gambling, and without needing a massive account.
Inside my Free Guidebook, you'll discover:
• Why most investors focus on growth -- and ignore income
• How weekly options can be used strategically instead of speculatively
• A repeatable framework built around rules, risk control, and structure
• How many everyday investors aim for $500-$5,000 per month in supplemental income
You can't control the market. But you can control your strategy.
[Learn More Here](https://substack.com/redirect/1096494f-ad86-415a-9131-c9b337c03c93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Why does this matter so much? Because the modern world runs on software. Your bank account, the electricity in your home, the hospitals that treat your family, even the military systems that defend the country -- all of it depends on millions of lines of code that contain hidden weaknesses. For years, human experts have tried to find and fix those weaknesses before bad actors (hackers, criminal gangs, or foreign governments) can use them. **[Apple even has a bounty system that will pay you if you discover a hack and let them know.](https://substack.com/redirect/040a858e-bf94-442b-832d-097c236e9788?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/040a858e-bf94-442b-832d-097c236e9788?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Mythos changes the game: it can find those weaknesses at a speed and scale humans simply cannot match.
Project Glasswing, **[Anthropic's new cybersecurity initiative](https://substack.com/redirect/ff37d555-59e2-4610-b172-bfdb5af90a87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** built around Mythos, is already being tested with a small group of trusted partners including JPMorgan Chase, Apple, Google, Microsoft, and Nvidia. The goal is defensive: use the AI to scan and patch critical software before attackers can strike. But the same technology that defends can also be turned into a devastating offensive weapon.
That is **exactly why the highest levels of the U.S. government** are paying such close attention.
Last week, Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent held an urgent closed-door meeting with the CEOs of America's biggest banks. The topic? Claude Mythos and the serious cyber risks it poses to the financial system. **[The Trump administration is treating this as a national security issue.](https://substack.com/redirect/76662fe0-51ae-4e4a-95a7-bf75d0dea3f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Anthropic has been in ongoing discussions with senior officials about the model's "offensive and defensive cyber applications." The Pentagon has already used earlier versions of Claude in real operations, including during the recent Iran conflict, even while fighting a legal battle over whether Anthropic should be labelled a supply-chain risk.

The concern is straightforward and chilling. If a model this powerful falls into the wrong hands -- or is misused -- it could be used to launch automated, large-scale cyberattacks on critical infrastructure. Banks could be breached. Power grids could be crippled. Hospitals could be locked out of their own systems. The fallout would not be theoretical; it would be immediate and severe for economies, public safety, and national security.
And yet, the race is on. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others (including strategic adversaries like China) are all pushing the limits because the first company to build truly powerful AI tools like Mythos will have an enormous advantage. The problem is that the same breakthroughs that help defenders also lower the barrier for attackers. As one expert put it, **AI is supercharging the cybersecurity fight on both sides.**
The launch of Mythos highlights a broader inconvenient truth: we have entered an era where a single AI model can potentially threaten systems that took decades to build because in all honesty a large amount of pre AI "tech" (code, security, operating systems) are the equivalent of a horse and cart and Mythos is a stealth bomber.

* * *
* * *
Governments are right to be concerned. When the Fed Chair, the Treasury Secretary, and the heads of America's largest banks sit down together to discuss one specific AI model two days after launch, that tells you everything you need to know about the stakes!
The public needs to understand this is not science fiction or hype anymore. It is happening now and if not now, it will definitely be here in 18 months. Mythos is powerful enough that Anthropic has deliberately limited its release to a tiny group of vetted partners. They are not being overly cautious -- they are being responsible. The opportunity, if we get it right, is to create a fundamentally more secure internet and world. The dangers of getting this wrong are obvious.
But responsibility alone will not be enough. The U.S. government, banks, and critical infrastructure operators now face a new reality: they must move at the speed of AI. The old ways of slow, human-led security patching are no longer sufficient. The models are getting better, faster than our defenses can adapt.
Claude Mythos is a wake-up call. It shows both the promise and the peril of advanced AI. Used wisely, it can help us find and fix the hidden weaknesses that have lurked in our systems for decades. Used recklessly or by adversaries, it can turn those same weaknesses into weapons with consequences too horrific to comprehend.
The highest levels of government are paying attention for a very good reason. The rest of us are going to have to get up to speed on this, and fast!

[I hope this email finds you well. Admittedly, it’s a bit longer than my typical message to you, but I’m betting it’ll be worth your time if you can spare a minute or two.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=794f08c1521249869e61ca78922ddc99&_e=-r_n7b0KRTUOQg3wN-qBts950ObXF0Zhavavf1VUSIgd6lqhCMOkRnloXfDNlx-2tI_p6NL2DILuWu115qwkRNmOQYBk7nBvXTs-xOwBvsy7zXuRzYPUS6UaHVUnbbuJ7RD4ybK3p8ilsxEWgXfOP0FfZYrWUk3W8HYWsONjhtRwAmH9WtjEPKy-k8B55MakIqjb5NH0ODMjhNMLfxpu4clguIwbarHQgt7L2Z63twh7BmsmRwp4ZAjzI5mE_ucf2QbyycCgcGTurhWwePQ7kDPbqxa1zLydiA2YjBQ05OW0Cj6W-1HOfdXuw6STKVCCNRPyiCpU4Q8mDbw2WQyomtN1i5GDIrRUJE5gaZ_QII_sSm3osClTZV5Db01cQ-2yDCGkzkJH82nQbgkYCYVBmlHpeKlriHcCapEafPSLXDIt0y3v7nmX67RPjWNEByh8XjxH97vyBC12r187GBnjrEAtXMaphst1eOyvjv2alBI2F1MTgR_dWqroYACHeee-RffJ46uo99vAqWka29hyuReTjCcqP5u200ZzANI1K8xt82gRIp0Qq5IUpxFA9MwggyRAxyPNGb3L-C5VtUT6htO2h0lYVDOajVAAvMMzM6MfRS0CSKwTsKKAZr0NSbW3hKdRyxTIZUaHci06lYOh3ZIO49-7WSbRE9ogodcEfhlKB6gxcaIZvcIabpYiTD_vMuxrhK5a5SFIX1BK0H4cuWPM3DydPvdEKdrXc6X2T_xXn7u81vs4K9bGYA1yq9Ri8-Gq_dxkNmZgRKgEOU-cJpT1B1RZpiXOcM_eASLHXP5qjR9uxiLqgqqxonfUC_NadjAUl9jafa_QLU-uwDPIhZouU_isMp4n7h26JQkhKI2xnb2aN-yBBztXnL5Y9Jc2KSRN16gZdwstoki7oOrMdg0I-6g2PHsaS92o2tnTX98%3D)
Where else on the planet can a big-city real estate guy and a small-town hillbilly team up to bring down a political machine to become the leader of the free world and his right hand?
The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill.
But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction.
So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026.
That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT!
That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? Because the Democrats are...
- Unleashing swarms of attack ads in every swing district - just like 2024- Plastering the media with anti-Trump propaganda - just like all last year- Weaponizing the Deep State to undermine us - just par for the course- Suing us in court to hamstring our agenda - just like Joe Biden did- Tracking to rake in a billion (with a "b") dollars - just like Kamala Harris
They're throwing the kitchen sink at us because everyone knows they can't win on the issues. The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth.
It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too.
That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer.
And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels.
The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot.
I say they're full of it (as usual).
I believe in this movement. Even though it's early, I have faith that Conservatives who really get it will rise to the challenge and stand with us. subject: Why?
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=6130%2E582294%2EpnSZJq ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=6130%2E582294%2EpnSZJq ]Chris Pappas for Senate

Hi, I could
really use your help.

Our mid-month fundraising deadline is at midnight tonight – and hitting
this goal matters now more than ever.

Why? Because a new poll shows me tied with my GOP opponent.

Our race in New Hampshire could very well decide the Senate majority. The
GOP knows it – that’s why they’re planning to spend over $17 MILLION – the
most in a decade – to flip this seat.

This is not
the time for us to lose any momentum.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260415_1._e3nZY&refcode=em20260415-1&t=1003&akid=6130%2E582294%2EpnSZJq ]We need to raise $15,000 by our mid-month deadline in just 10 HOURS.
Will you be one of the grassroots supporters I need to step up right now?
Please chip in any amount to help us reach our mid-April goal.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260415_1._e3nZY&amount=5&refcode=em20260415-1&t=1022&akid=6130%2E582294%2EpnSZJq ]Donate $5 »

Donald Trump, corporate super PACs, and my GOP opponents are counting on
us to come up short. I’m counting on supporters like you to help us close
the gap.

Every dollar you chip in and even every email you read matter more than I
can put into words. This is one of the most competitive races in the
country, and I don’t take a single supporter for granted. I know from many
competitive elections that a strong grassroots movement is how you win, so
that’s why I’m asking again:

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260415_1._e3nZY&refcode=em20260415-1&t=1023&akid=6130%2E582294%2EpnSZJq ]If
you’re able, will you chip in $5 today? Your donation will
help us hit our mid-month goal, keep us in the fight for the Senate
majority, and help stop Republicans from flipping the Granite State.

Thank you,

Chris

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=6130%2E582294%2EpnSZJq

subject: Elon Musk’s wealth vs. the Average American’s
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2861%2E4032634%2Eb9gbs1

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ultrawealth/?source=EW_EMZ30T_TAX_ENG_20260415_F&t=1006&akid=2861%2E4032634%2Eb9gbs1 ]Its tax day, and there is no better day to talk about how our tax code
is rigged for those at the top.[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ultrawealth/?source=EW_EMZ30T_TAX_ENG_20260415_F&t=1007&akid=2861%2E4032634%2Eb9gbs1 ]Lets take a look at wealth inequality in
America and compare the net worth of the average American to Elon Musks.
$124k is the wealth of the average American. How does that compare to Elon
Musk? Keep scrolling down.[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ultrawealth/?source=EW_EMZ30T_TAX_ENG_20260415_F&t=1008&akid=2861%2E4032634%2Eb9gbs1 ]Are we there yet?[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ultrawealth/?source=EW_EMZ30T_TAX_ENG_20260415_F&t=1009&akid=2861%2E4032634%2Eb9gbs1 ]Keep going...Chart ends
at $827,000,000,000

Yep, Elon Musk has 6.5 MILLION times more wealth than the typical
American.

Yet, our tax code has allowed billionaires like him to pay little to no
federal income tax — even while their wealth skyrockets.

We’re fighting to change that.

My wealth tax plan would place a two-cent per dollar tax on people with a
net worth above $50 million — and an additional cent on net worths over a
billion.

This small tax on America’s richest would generate huge amounts of revenue
totaling at least $6 trillion — revenue that we can invest in lowering
costs for working families.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ultrawealth/?source=EW_EMZ30T_TAX_ENG_20260415_F&t=1010&akid=2861%2E4032634%2Eb9gbs1 ]Add your name if you’re with us: It’s time for the ultra-wealthy to pay
their fair share in taxes.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ultrawealth/?source=EW_EMZ30T_TAX_ENG_20260415_F&t=1011&akid=2861%2E4032634%2Eb9gbs1 ]ADD YOUR NAME

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

body:
#

Folks, its Mark.
I know emails like this probably get on your nerves. I get a lot of them myself, so I can relate. But let me level with you for a minute, because they really are important.
When I write to ask for your help, I know you can’t always make a donation. That would be crazy. And, if you don’t chip in, the sky is not going to fall — _in spite of what a lot of people say._
I ask you to chip in because I really do need your help. I ask because I hope you really do have my back. Because when a ton of people chip in $5 or $10 bucks when they can, I don’t have to rely on stuff like corporate PACs, hours and hours of call time, or a bunch of fundraisers.
It means I get to focus on the work and on the people I serve. That’s how we do this, by building something huge, just a few dollars at a time.
I’m proud of that, and I hope you are, too.

body:
#
Peter —
If your inbox is anything like mine, it feels like a constant barrage of emails from campaigns — including my own!
It’s hard to separate the noise from the truth. What’s really worth investing your time and treasure in?
So I want to tell you something that a lot of other politicians probably wouldn’t today: There’s no such thing as a “mid-month deadline” for political campaigns. It was made up by DC consultants to create fake urgency and make a quick buck.
I refuse to play those games. I think you deserve better from your leaders. And I made the bet that people would be more willing to invest in a movement built on honesty and respect — not one trying to scam and scare you.
**[If this approach resonates with you, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution to our campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money. Grassroots donations are the backbone of this movement.](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-2026q2.t_pReT&refcode=em260415-1-ak&t=1&akid=579%2E1347274%2E-TCRFl)**

Peter,

America is turning 250 years old--a historic moment for our great nation.
