After a father’s warning, lawmakers block porn age-check measure
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s0neada21aa)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s2l300c64ab)**
| | Hi friends!
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s4q20bea474), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s3ra23cded4) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s1tbd0c701d). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Colorado’s $46.8 billion budget[ moves to the Senate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s2tcbc8ab5b) with a $1B+ deficit and ongoing partisan fights over spending, while Democrats push to [expand the governor-appointed Public Utilities Commission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s9k33d9b1eb), raising concerns about regulatory power. Lawmakers are also advancing a scaled-back [“extreme temperature” workplace bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/sat84ae14b9) and rejecting a proposal to let voters decide on [age verification for online pornography access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s8j0efca551).

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** School districts are weighing cuts as enrollment drops, with Adams 12 [down more than 6,000 students](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s8l0962aa62) over a decade, while new data shows Colorado [lost 11,000 jobs last year](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s5u800faf4b)—an unusual decline outside a recession—alongside slower growth, rising unemployment, and reduced workforce participation.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Pro-life groups are pressing the DOJ to support [state authority over abortion policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s1n7e305cb1), citing expanded mail access to abortion drugs after loosened FDA rules and raising concerns about safety as the federal-state divide over regulation continues.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[After a father’s warning, lawmakers block porn age-check measure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/sdm26fe03d1)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/sfu9e32f05b)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/sbq53ce80f8)
A Mesa County father didn’t show up to talk policy. He showed up to talk about kids.
“My heart breaks for this generation and the technology that they face today,” Mesa County Commissioner Cody Davis told lawmakers, describing a world where explicit material is “one click away” and often discovered long before children understand what they’re seeing.
He talked about foster children, smartphones, and the quiet moments when exposure happens before parents even know it.
“Right now, a 10-year-old boy is quietly absorbing scenes that teach him that women are objects,” Davis said. “Right now, a 12-year-old girl is comparing her natural developing body to the... performer she sees.”
No one in the hearing questioned the problem. Kids are running into explicit content earlier than most parents expect. That wasn’t where the disagreement was. It was over what to do next.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s8n05b8af67)**
|
---
**[Colorado Lawmakers Push Major Expansion Of Public Utilities Commission Authority](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s9p8b809a69)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s5j7230e4ef)
* **Lawmakers push major expansion of PUC authority:** House Bill 1326 would extend the governor-appointed Public Utilities Commission for 11 more years while significantly expanding its regulatory reach over industries like energy and rideshare services.
* **New regulations target rideshare and increase compliance costs:** The bill requires facial recognition for drivers, higher penalties, expanded background checks, and additional reporting and inspection requirements, adding new layers of oversight for companies like Uber and Lyft.
* **Critics warn of reduced transparency and local control:** Proposed changes would allow more closed-door discussions and give the PUC power to override local land-use decisions, raising concerns about unelected regulators gaining influence over major projects and business operations.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s9s7bc35227)**

* **$46.8B state budget advances to Senate review:** Colorado senators are taking up the next year’s $46.8 billion spending plan, continuing the legislative process after House changes.
* **Lawmakers face pressure to balance growing costs:** The budget comes as the state works to address a significant deficit, with spending pressures driven in part by rising programs like Medicaid.
* **Next steps could reshape final spending plan:** Senators may accept House revisions or propose their own, setting up negotiations between chambers before a final budget is approved.

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s5radc06308)****[Election Integrity and Cybersecurity Failures at the Colorado GOP Convention](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s3tfb75c5c1)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s5m47a71a92)****BY MARIA ORMS | COMMENTARY | APRIL 15** _I attended this past weekend’s Colorado Republican State Convention in Pueblo as a gubernatorial candidate seeking ballot access. I was there not only as a candidate, but as a cybersecurity professional. What I witnessed—and what was reported by multiple credible participants—was not simply disorganization. It was a series of failures that demand a full, independent investigation._
____
**[Heaven’s Battle Plan: You’re Not Alone](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s0p8365b635)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | APRIL 13** _In Colorado and especially across the Rocky Mountains, we deeply respect a trait we find truly admirable: rugged independence. It embodies the ability to stand firm on your own, work diligently, fulfill your responsibilities, and take control of your life. It’s important to recognize that this isn’t a weakness but a genuine strength._

__**[He Loved This City. Then It Nearly Killed Him.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s3u6e7bd8e5)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s3n194ec787)****BY SHAINA COLE | LOCAL | APRIL 13** _Colorado Republicans came to Pueblo to choose candidates. They left having done that—and still debating who should have a say in choosing them. What unfolded over the course of a long delayed and at times contentious assembly produced clear outcomes in major races while also setting in motion a legal step that could reshape how those candidates are selected in the future._ __**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._ghQ/s4u5c708c1b)**__

This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, April 15, 2026. – Team RMV | TODAY'S TOP STORIES BY JEN SCHUMANN, A Mesa County father didn’t show up to talk policy. He showed up to talk about kids. “My heart breaks for this generation and the technology that they face today,” Mesa County Commissioner Cody Davis told lawmakers, describing a world where explicit material is “one click away” and often discovered long before children understand what they’re seeing. He talked about foster children, smartphones, and the quiet moments when exposure happens before parents even know it. “Right now, a 10-year-old boy is quietly absorbing scenes that teach him that women are objects,” Davis said. “Right now, a 12-year-old girl is comparing her natural developing body to the... performer she sees.” No one in the hearing questioned the problem. Kids are running into explicit content earlier than most parents expect. That wasn’t where the disagreement was. It was over what to do next. | Lawmakers push major expansion of PUC authority: House Bill 1326 would extend the governor-appointed Public Utilities Commission for 11 more years while significantly expanding its regulatory reach over industries like energy and rideshare services. New regulations target rideshare and increase compliance costs: The bill requires facial recognition for drivers, higher penalties, expanded background checks, and additional reporting and inspection requirements, adding new layers of oversight for companies like Uber and Lyft. Critics warn of reduced transparency and local control: Proposed changes would allow more closed-door discussions and give the PUC power to override local land-use decisions, raising concerns about unelected regulators gaining influence over major projects and business operations. | The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support! | $46.8B state budget advances to Senate review: Colorado senators are taking up the next year’s $46.8 billion spending plan, continuing the legislative process after House changes. Lawmakers face pressure to balance growing costs: The budget comes as the state works to address a significant deficit, with spending pressures driven in part by rising programs like Medicaid. Next steps could reshape final spending plan: Senators may accept House revisions or propose their own, setting up negotiations between chambers before a final budget is approved. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ MARIA ORMS | COMMENTARY | APRIL 15 I attended this past weekend’s Colorado Republican State Convention in Pueblo as a gubernatorial candidate seeking ballot access. I was there not only as a candidate, but as a cybersecurity professional. What I witnessed—and what was reported by multiple credible participants—was not simply disorganization. It was a series of failures that demand a full, independent investigation. __ BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | APRIL 13 In Colorado and especially across the Rocky Mountains, we deeply respect a trait we find truly admirable: rugged independence. It embodies the ability to stand firm on your own, work diligently, fulfill your responsibilities, and take control of your life. It’s important to recognize that this isn’t a weakness but a genuine strength. SHAINA COLE | LOCAL | APRIL 13 Colorado Republicans came to Pueblo to choose candidates. They left having done that—and still debating who should have a say in choosing them. What unfolded over the course of a long delayed and at times contentious assembly produced clear outcomes in major races while also setting in motion a legal step that could reshape how those candidates are selected in the future. Democrats from across the country just came together at the DNC’s annual spring meeting and made something very clear: we are not going to let Donald Trump or his allies dismantle our democracy.
At that meeting, I helped co-author a resolution to defend vote-by-mail, automatic voter registration, and the freedom to vote — and it passed with overwhelming support.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
That matters. Because right now, the SAVE Act and other attacks on our elections aren’t theoretical — they’re a direct attempt to make it harder for people to vote and easier for politicians to hold onto power.
And here in Oregon, we know exactly what’s at stake. We’ve built one of the most secure, accessible, and trusted vote-by-mail systems in the country.
It works. It’s accurate. It ensures that every eligible voter can have their voice heard. And that’s exactly why it’s under attack.
I’ve spent my career improving the public’s trust in government and now I’m focused on protecting the integrity of our elections. I’m not about to stand by while politicians in Washington try to undermine both.
But here’s the truth: passing a resolution is just the beginning. Defending our democracy is going to take a sustained, grassroots effort—organizing, educating voters, pushing back against misinformation, and holding bad actors accountable.
That’s where you come in. This is a fight we can win. But only if we stand together and meet this moment with the urgency it demands. That’s why I’m asking you to chip in $5, $10, or more right now to help us keep up this fight for our democracy before it’s too late. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]

Thank you for being part of this.

Amazon tracks every second of a worker’s movement, but when a human heart stops, they suddenly lose their sense of urgency. At Amazon warehouses, it is common practice to prevent workers from calling 911. Instead, they are forced to wait for "Amcare" - the internal first-aid department that functions more like a PR shield than a medical unit. Reports show it can take over 20 minutes for help to arrive. In a crisis, those 20 minutes can be the difference between life and death. Statistics reveal the truth: a Senate investigation found Amazon warehouses are twice as dangerous as their competitors. At Amazon warehouses, it is common practice to prevent workers from calling 911. Instead, they are forced to wait for "Amcare" - the internal first-aid department that functions more like a PR shield than a medical unit. Reports show it can take over 20 minutes for help to arrive. In a crisis, those 20 minutes can be the difference between life and death. Statistics reveal the truth: a Senate investigation found Amazon warehouses are twice as dangerous as their competitors. By forcing workers through "Amcare," Amazon can suppress injury data and prioritize speed over survival. Local Democracy Project fights for People over Profits. | | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6e1e467288bb4223993a86ca70ebf26c&_e=C6ytW6O7rKe90aNqDOs97XKlff7vDQ31W4lthTMnjOu56Bp0dPAsGfIPtaiu0EmbyC1nDdKXV6o9i6y0AppqYQo06Jyu22lZg87x1nb0-TNbWKRV3nv3mU_v-bZD1kn2xiY8j180AK1QOF6Y04BfkOfzRGmAV1BOmouWnfR673vrZWaRO0j8pIMquLSZCoLDNmYTddzETSrLW5hXZNgPCj0hRXzABXCYNepdIUVnPVFT7R_qyakucgEZ5ncIB2xoylNnEtqXtGrw8QDqN4Q9nZHk-VAvJ1X7JX7nYNTpSJV2huoRkidaLx1PoMm4KqzA7NLztzQMEeSbbv9QXFME94m2W6T7PW4iXOa6KkWI585lADH0FpguasEE6JZjhbCMWZSww8Hbdkv0dVY2IWM1yP-DxNdllav9D0d2OcomuMDUkcg0cr5m9h9Okv13VjI5r5kSesdD-whPIRkY8JEiPox0zqxSBqKwKk9OkTLAohb2WpWSSvQo8XdbaW112QeGny3NgaMjE_toi5ycf448nfmn9m86_exrfx6cOhef7Hvsh7F4B_Ut1UP2zbI8EhljmUMHhY3PErGXsr5ApmZGV4E8pOVuoXBZOb30HuBnjcJ0FYmQj89kgV8JWsQaLH7qh7LL2XjkhMo4-QsC-fMcL86gI6MBbgOCuCwGFQawquhWfvIMrkbXxXy3BUSotJgZitFhZaSofUGTQVsdJj0v6g%3D%3D)

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6e1e467288bb4223993a86ca70ebf26c&_e=C6ytW6O7rKe90aNqDOs97XKlff7vDQ31W4lthTMnjOu56Bp0dPAsGfIPtaiu0EmbyC1nDdKXV6o9i6y0AppqYQo06Jyu22lZg87x1nb0-TNbWKRV3nv3mU_v-bZD1kn2xiY8j180AK1QOF6Y04BfkOfzRGmAV1BOmouWnfR673vrZWaRO0j8pIMquLSZCoLDNmYTddzETSrLW5hXZNgPCj0hRXzABXCYNepdIUVnPVFT7R_qyakucgEZ5ncIB2xo-atLqIKgkB82NH1LVVagGm0pdos8c1yDLXIbqRjYa7l8xRIQIKsl2MkHAt1M961B87zqZzXaXBd5GLwNKUlBBBZsmZGMR9ua36ALbzZbxiHx4mwO7wRbw0FRlLce4GtXKDolIcPAKqC1PZN2d_VAf-OOBlGuuOdFv7-k3Hk9LhLnhroP4EAb45WmUesbAd-9-ceUVT-FGh6ctNnHy0jeEcwXlZLhY9gU8c18DRME_PWVN4fz8dNf66e7DvRyBCjsF6VC7nG1fUWkAGZYLvHLiOQzQBFcHCiDuU1LEjN2jZBt26Og9s3ZxgNOTCI6eNDyY3dkFX25ygbCSSNuvaqken2HeJJSD_3-xjgH-FwG6sJi3TrqGHfZHN4e0hBaxetpzT8FzNXb7z-WuWLcinf1iGlrbSI5NEPQdZ-EMJzIFzeVIpr__mm22v346Rrzi4UQkUH35amcwR21Evp4RZ8Dxw%3D%3D)

_But now, Peter, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default.

Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.

**P.S.** There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out...

He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning.

When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. _**We don 't have time to wait.**_**" **

And he was right.

The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers.

We may be in 13% of our schools now...

_But in the other 87%? _

The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them.

And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous."

You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it.

He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses.

And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now.

**Peter, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- _this is it._ **

You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do.

But you can send them the tools to do it.

These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead.

All they're waiting on... is us.

**Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. **

You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back.

And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time.

clean_body: Before you give up on America — read this| | | | | Peter, If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left... If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good... If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, " Is it already too late?" You're not alone. A lot of good people have been asking the same question. But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That was no small feat. Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked. So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle. Then Charlie called me... He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster." I told him, "We are." Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said, "How many are there?" "About 27,000." Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!" I'll be honest -- I froze. We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet. But he wasn't fazed. He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together." That was Charlie. He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday." He believed in going now. And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself. He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality. That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place. That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: We're in 3,300. That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America. Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide. ✅ Florida ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee ✅ Oklahoma ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Arkansas ✅ Indiana And we're just getting started. Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country... That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom. That 's what Club America is about... Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. But now, Peter, the question is... What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? Because here's the truth: These students aren't just signing up. They 're stepping up. They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous. But that isn't stopping them. They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever. They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, but brave. Not just loud, but principled. Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses. Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship. Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth. And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default. Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country. It's up to us to finish what he started. One chapter. One student. One school at a time. Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Peter, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

subject: Have you noticed this too?
body:
It’s happening all over our district.

| | | | | [|

| | | | | | Dear Peter,
In the past few weeks, I’ve started noticing something more and more across CA-32.
Storefronts going dark.
“For Lease” signs sitting longer than they used to. Small businesses quietly cutting back, or closing altogether.
These aren’t just businesses.They’re the places that make our neighborhoods feel like home.
And too many are closing down.
**After decades in office, Brad Sherman has been part of a system that reacts too late, or not at all, to what’s happening on the ground.**
I am running for Congress because this shouldn’t be ignored.
I believe we need to support the people who keep our local economy alive, by cutting through the red tape and rising costs pushing them out.
By fighting for more investment in our communities, and by showing up, listening, and acting on what business owners are saying right now.
That’s what leadership should look like.
Not this endless silence with no action or real representation from Brad Sherman.
[**If you’ve noticed this too, and want leadership that won’t look the other way, help us build it.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=3af2ac6d8a&e=53c7d12fc7)

body:

---
| Hi friend, Juan here — I’ve been out and about across the district and I wanted to share a couple of highlights from the past few days!
---
| **💪🏼 We've Built a $3.8 Million War Chest** We just closed out the first quarter, and thanks to your support, our campaign raised **over $1.1 MILLION** and now has **$3.8 MILLION cash on hand** in one of the most competitive races in the country. That puts us **$1.4 MILLION ahead** of where we were at this point last cycle. This early momentum is HUGE for our campaign– THANK YOU! Southern Arizona is paying attention. They want leadership that shows up, listens, and delivers results, so that is what I will continue to do every single day in Congress. **ONWARD TO NOVEMBER.** 🇺🇸
---
|
---
|
---
| **💸 Delivering Tax Relief for Arizona Families** One of the things I'm most proud to fight for in Congress is making sure that hardworking families here in AZ-06 keep more of what they earn. I proudly **voted YES** on the Working Families Tax Cuts Act, and I've been working alongside the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and local business leaders to make sure our community knows exactly how these wins benefit them. Here's what we've delivered for AZ-06: **NO TAX ON TIPS** — Tipped workers can now deduct up to $25,000 in qualified tips from their federal income taxes. **NO TAX ON OVERTIME** — Hourly workers can now deduct their overtime pay up to $12,500 (or $25,000 for joint filers). _You put in the extra hours; you should see that on your paycheck._ **SOCIAL SECURITY TAX RELIEF FOR SENIORS** — Our seniors worked hard their whole lives, and they shouldn't be penalized for it. The new $6,000 senior deduction for taxpayers 65 and older means that **_88% of Social Security recipients now owe ZERO federal tax on their benefits_**. That's a massive win for the many retirees right here in Southern Arizona. These are real dollars back in the pockets of real people in our community. I'll never stop pushing for policies that put hardworking families first.
---
|
---
| **🇺🇸 Honoring Leadership in Saddlebrooke Ranch** We had an incredible crowd at Saddlebrooke Ranch, and I had the honor of recognizing someone truly special in our community. I presented a **Congressional Achievement Award to Onita Davis** for her tireless work supporting our Veteran community through efforts like **Wreaths Across America**. Onita represents the very best of Southern Arizona through her commitment to honoring those who served and supporting their families. Onita — thank you for all you are doing!
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=c29fa28807&e=659fba240e)
---
[ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=faae576133&e=659fba240e)
---
|
---
| **🔥 Strong Support at Pinal County Lincoln Day Lunch** We had a great turnout at the Pinal County GOP Lincoln Day Lunch, with more than 200 supporters coming together. I’m always encouraged by the energy and commitment I see across AZ-06. This is a competitive race, and it’s clear that people are engaged and ready to fight this incredible district. Thank you to everyone who came out, showed support, and continues to stand with us. It means a lot to Laura and me.
---
|
---
| **THANK YOU** , AZ-06, for your continued support. We couldn't do any of this without you! See you around the district!

– Juan

Worst-case scenario
| MAJOR HOUSE MAJORITY SHAKEUP
We could be headed toward a complete disaster in the Midterms based on these 3 critical updates:
1. Democrats are targeting 35 vulnerable GOP seats across the country, even in deep-red MAGA territory.
2. National Democrats have a $50+ MILLION warchest to target Conservatives in key battleground races.
3. President Trump himself warned all Conservatives: "If we don't win the midterms... they'll find a reason to impeach me."
We're pleading with you to take this seriously. Democrats are regrouping faster than anyone could've predicted, and they're working to obliterate our pro-Trump House Majority.
DON'T FORGET: In nearly every election since 2024, Democrats outperformed, outraised, and outmaneuvered Conservatives.
DON'T FORGET: The Generic Ballot has Democrats 4+ points over Republicans.
DON'T FORGET: If we lose the House, Democrats will immediately move to impeach President Trump and his entire Cabinet in one fell swoop.

Peter Willis,

Today, Americans are filing their taxes while the ultra-wealthy get yet
another free pass — and we have had ENOUGH.

Billionaires in America now collectively hold $8.2 trillion in wealth, yet
pay a lower tax rate than regular working people like you and me. Musk
paid 3.3% effective tax. The average truck driver? 8.4%. Jeff Bezos paid
less than 1%. The average firefighter paid 8.7%.

Bernie has introduced a bill to establish a 5% annual wealth tax on
America’s 938 billionaires. Just 0.000003% of the population would pay it,
but it would raise $4.4 TRILLION over ten years – enough to end
homelessness and the housing crisis, expand Medicare, pay for universal
child care, and more.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/37661?source=email-20220415&t=1012&akid=10545%2E5885482%2EckfYPk ]Let’s come together on Tax Day to demand Congress pass Bernie’s

wealth tax targeting billionaires

families. Right now, 60% of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck,
struggling to cover the basics: rent, health care, groceries, child care,
and prescription drugs – all while billionaires and CEOs dodge taxes and
get richer by the minute.

If we don’t speak out, Congress will just continue to listen to
billionaire lobbyists, not struggling families. But the American people
have had enough – and THIS is our moment to demand a system that works for
the many, not the few.

That's why our Endorsed Candidates - Chris Rabb, Liz Fiedler, and Izzy
Smith- Wade-El, along with members from Our Revolution – spoke at the Tax

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/37661?source=email-20220415&t=1016&akid=10545%2E5885482%2EckfYPk ]NOW is the time to show that we will not allow the rich to keep getting

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. I'm working with Senator Alsobrooks to take our Maryland-made success to Congress to protect the Chesapeake Bay. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129532647/614669286/-2051496126?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZThlYmQ2MC0wNDM5LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7JuSN5qQIyooHT9boEP4IFaHu1kNIfJyieBVBs_y-Gg=&emci=fa8dbd60-0439-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=0e8ebd60-0439-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=30237190)

| | Friend, I spent my six years in the Maryland Senate championing the Chesapeake Bay and my final year leading the Whole Watershed Act, an innovative approach to watershed restoration that ensures we move faster, bolder, and smarter through larger-scale projects and wholesale collaboration. And here is even better news: the Severn River, right here in the Third District, was selected as one of the five projects statewide to receive $20 million in funding and a whole lot of collaboration between nonprofits, Anne Arundel County, and state government. **Now, I’m taking that Maryland-made success to the halls of Congress. ** I’m happy to announce that I have officially introduced the**Maryland Whole Watershed Program Federal Partnership Act**. I’m collaborating with my friend and partner, Senator Angela Alsobrooks, to make sure the federal government is a full participant in vital environmental restoration work. This is a first-of-its-kind, science-based approach to restoring the Chesapeake Watershed. This legislation will add the EPA Chesapeake Bay Program to the State Management Team, providing support for the 37 projects targeting five watersheds. Together, this can effectively stop the cycle of random acts of restoration, leveraging existing funds to ensure that state and local partners have the support they need. It isn’t just another bill — it’s a pragmatic plan of action on how we can combine federal support and improve coordination across local, state, and federal organizations to become a national blueprint for watershed restoration. [_**The work to protect our Bay and our future is already underway, but I can’t keep the fight going without your support. Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. I’m collaborating with my friend and partner, Senator Angela Alsobrooks, to make sure the federal government is a full participant in vital environmental restoration work. This is a first-of-its-kind, science-based approach to restoring the Chesapeake Watershed. This legislation will add the EPA Chesapeake Bay Program to the State Management Team, providing support for the 37 projects targeting five watersheds. Together, this can effectively stop the cycle of random acts of restoration, leveraging existing funds to ensure that state and local partners have the support they need. It isn’t just another bill — it’s a pragmatic plan of action on how we can combine federal support and improve coordination across local, state, and federal organizations to become a national blueprint for watershed restoration. = | = I always envisioned a federal partnership with the Whole Watershed Program, and I’m so glad we can begin the road to true collaboration. Sincerely, Sarah Elfreth | * = | | | ---|---|---|--- Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. Sarah lives in Annapolis with her fiancé, Eric, and their dog, Ollie. To learn more about Sarah, visit: Emails like this are the most effective way to grow our campaign and reach supporters like you. A repudiation of the corrupt ruling class. A mandate to finally take back control of our country.

My wife Apoorva and I are raising our three kids in Ohio, and I want to make sure they inherit a state that is strong, proud, and free. ** ** But to do that, we need to shake things up. We need to tell the truth, even when it's hard. We need to support President Trump and his America First agenda. We need to overhaul our failing schools, restore our national identity, and reject the victimhood mentality that's holding us back. ** ** We need to secure our elections, prosecute voter fraud, and gut the bureaucratic red tape that's strangling our economy. And we need to do it all with courage, conviction, and a commitment to the values that made America great in the first place. ** ** That's why I'm asking for your support. Whether you live in Ohio or not, I need your help to build a grassroots army that can take on the Democrat machine and the Deep State.

name: Ashley Floyd
subject: What women really pay on Tax Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emerge America
body:
https://emergeamerica.org/ [https://emergeamerica.org/]
Dear Peter ,
On Tax Day, it’s easy to draw a simple conclusion: women often pay less in income taxes than men. But that’s not the full story.
Women pay less because they earn less—the result of persistent wage gaps that limit long-term financial security.
And beyond income taxes, the reality is even clearer. From the “pink tax” on everyday goods to higher costs on products marketed to women, and even taxes on essential items like menstrual products, women often pay more in the overall cost of living.
So while women may appear to pay less on paper, in practice they’re carrying a heavier financial burden every day.
These inequities are shaped by policy and by who is at the table making those decisions. That’s where Emerge comes in.
Emerge is building a pipeline of Democratic women leaders who are already influencing tax policy at every level. In Congress, Emerge alums have supported efforts to expand the Child Tax Credit, protect tax relief for working families, and oppose tax policies that disproportionately benefit the wealthy.
At the state level, that impact is even more direct. In New Mexico, Representative Cindy Nava has helped advance economic packages that include tax credits for low-income and working families—part of a broader shift toward one of the most equitable tax structures in the country. In Virginia, Delegate Adele McClure has been part of legislative efforts focused on tax fairness and on ensuring public investments are funded in ways that work for working families.
This is what it looks like when women lead: tax policy that reflects real lives—and real costs.
But building that kind of leadership pipeline takes investment.
This Tax Day, will you help us train and support the next generation of women leaders?

Because when women lead, policy changes—and so do outcomes.
Thank you for being part of this work,
Ashley

**Peter, President Trump and his Republican allies have been targeting one community after another in an effort to make voting harder. ** The list of groups they’ve attacked is vast and growing. People of color. Immigrants. People living with disabilities. The elderly. And now, high school and college students. Earlier this month, New Hampshire’s Republican Governor Kelly Ayotte signed a bill eliminating student IDs — even those issued by the state’s public schools and universities — from the list of acceptable forms of identification needed to vote. That makes New Hampshire the eighth state to disallow student IDs for voter identification. And they haven't stopped there. Republican lawmakers have also tried to eliminate polling places on campuses. One bill proposed in Texas last year would prohibit a polling place from being located on the campus of a public school or a university, unless the campus was closed during the voting period. It doesn’t take a rocket scientist to figure out what’s going on here. Republicans are increasingly terrified of young voters. One can imagine that the targeting of students is only going to increase, given the fact that Trump’s approval ratings with Gen Z and younger voters are plummeting, falling to just 20% in one recent poll. **The NDRC was built to stop attacks on voting rights like these — and we need your help to sustain our response.[Donate to help power our fight to protect the rights of every eligible voter and defend democracy this November and for years to come.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129534396/614674077/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StudentVote_email_20260415-NDRC-Tier1-StudentVote_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260415-NDRC-Tier1-StudentVote_&utm_campaign=StudentVote&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgxZWJkZmE0LTA2MzktZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qUeBhqp12uNYhZ9G9w3gXRs8ajEkjxtxIWj205I_RgM=)** Thank you for your support, National Democratic Redistricting Committee | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129534397/614674078/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StudentVote_email_20260415-NDRC-Tier1-StudentVote_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260415-NDRC-Tier1-StudentVote_&utm_campaign=StudentVote&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgxZWJkZmE0LTA2MzktZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qUeBhqp12uNYhZ9G9w3gXRs8ajEkjxtxIWj205I_RgM=)

body:
You might be wondering
| Hi friend, it’s Mandela Barnes. This is a longer email - but I hope you’ll stick around to hear more of my story. You may be wondering how this kid ended up running for Governor in one of the tightest races in the country. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6904?t=2&akid=6051%2E196590%2EHOwE1d) I grew up in Milwaukee, where my mom was a public school teacher. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6904?t=3&akid=6051%2E196590%2EHOwE1d)
And my dad worked 3rd shift at the General Motors plant. My parents taught me the value of hard work and service. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6904?t=4&akid=6051%2E196590%2EHOwE1d)
At 25, I put those lessons to practice when I was elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly, where I became a champion on issues like the environment, economy, education, racial justice, and health care. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6904?t=5&akid=6051%2E196590%2EHOwE1d)
Then I helped Governor Evers kick Scott Walker out of office and became the first Black Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin, and the youngest in the country at the time. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6904?t=6&akid=6051%2E196590%2EHOwE1d)
I ran for U.S. Senate against the incumbent, where tens of millions of dollars of dark money was only able to defeat me by just one point. Now I’m running for Governor to meet this unique moment where family farmers are being squeezed by tariffs. Healthcare costs keep rising. Too many families are just one emergency away from a financial disaster. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6904?t=7&akid=6051%2E196590%2EHOwE1d) I won’t stand idly by. This election is about cutting through the constant stream of chaos that continues to divide and distract us, so that Wisconsinites no longer pay the costs of the devastation from Washington under Trump. For the past three years, Vertical Harvest Maine L3C -- a project of Wyoming architect Nona Yehia -- has been the darling of the Maine political and media establishment.
Championed by Westbrook Mayor Mike Foley and blessed with a glowing September 2025 photo-op by Gov. Janet Mills (D), the $80 million taxpayer-funded indoor hydroponic farm was sold to the public as a miracle of "conscious capitalism."
The pitch, orchestrated by Yehia with slick websites and all the right green talking points, was intoxicating to Democrats: an urban farm built on a former municipal parking lot, powered by green energy, and staffed by individuals with disabilities.
The Portland Press Herald ran breathless puff pieces promising the facility would produce 6,850 pounds of salad greens a day.
But behind the glossy architectural renderings and the ribbon-cuttings, Vertical Harvest was already collapsing under the weight of its own debt at the time Mills made her appearance.
Shockingly -- the highly touted indoor farming startup has yet to exceed more than 3-4 percent of its operating capacity, a generous estimate, has just two employees, and public records show the company is facing mounting financial distress.
Despite massive infusions of government support--including the $48.7 million in USDA-backed guaranteed loans and an additional $1 million in Direct Loans from the Finance Authority of Maine (FAME)--the company is struggling to meet its basic operational and transactional obligations.
The most acute financial threat to Vertical Harvest Maine L3C comes from a lawsuit filed late last year in Cumberland County Superior Court by Waterside Commercial Finance, the Canadian broker that helped secure the company's massive USDA-backed loan.
In an interview Wednesday, Vertical Harvest Co-Founder and CEO Nona Yehia defended the company's position, confirming the facility is currently in a "ramp phase" and promising full production by the end of the year.
Yehia said the lawsuit -- in which Waterside accuses Vertical Harvest and its Canadian financial backers of fraud -- is a complicated and complex matter.
According to the complaint, Vertical Harvest was unable to pay Waterside's standard 2 percent brokerage fee--$975,000--when the nearly $49 million loan closed in April 2024. Instead, the company scraped together just $75,000 at closing and deferred the remaining $900,000 into a highly punitive subordinated note.
Under the terms of that agreement, the debt doubled to $1.8 million by month eight and continues to accrue a 25 percent annual default interest rate.
The lawsuit alleges more than just breach of contract. Waterside claims Vertical Harvest and its venture capital backer, Raiven Fund Management and founding partner Paul Dugsin, actively engaged in fraud to hide a cash infusion in September 2025 that should have triggered an immediate repayment clause.
When asked about the lawsuit, Yehia declined to go into specifics but contested the plaintiff's narrative.
"Obviously it's an ongoing dispute, and it's from a complex vendor relationship, broker relationship," Yehia said. "There are some things we don't agree with and we feel have been mischaracterized, and we'll address it through the appropriate channels."
A recent unannounced visit to the Westbrook facility revealed that the massive, multi-level building is currently producing what can fairly be estimated at four or five salads, with only two small troths of actively growing greens and two employees on site.
Yehia confirmed the two employees and the low capacity but disputed that the project is failing to launch.
"The facility is currently churning out salad at a limited capacity. Like I said, we are in our ramp phase," Yehia said. She noted they are currently distributing through Native Maine and have local commitments from Jordan's Farm and the Westbrook School District. She added that they expect to be at "close to full capacity by the end of the year."
But the slow ramp-up is creating immediate cash-flow problems at the local level. The company currently owes the City of Westbrook more than $45,000 in unpaid property taxes, resulting in a formal tax lien filed against the company.
"We have been working with the city of Westbrook, who has been patient in our ramp phase," Yehia said. "We were delayed in our production, and so we will be able to meet those obligations. It's just a matter of time."
Vertical Harvest, which operates a much smaller facility in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.
Yehia said the facility was one-twentieth the size of the Westbrook plant, but founded with a dual mission: growing food year-round in harsh climates and providing customized employment for people with disabilities.
While the company aims to have 40 percent of its workforce identify as having physical or intellectual disabilities, Yehia confirmed that during this current limited ramp-up phase, the Westbrook facility employs only two people who meet that criteria.
The two individuals at the facility on Tuesday declined interviews, so we didn't get a chance to learn about the disability with which they identify.
Yehia stressed that the employment mission remains "front and center" to why she leads the company.
When pressed on whether the state-subsidized, out-of-state enterprise, brokered by a Canadian company for the benefit of a Canadian venture cap firm presents unfair competition to local Maine farmers, Yehia pointed out that traditional farmers cannot produce the same crops during the harsh Maine winter.
"I'm not sure if I'm aware of any local producers that are able to grow greens in December or January or February," Yehia said.
"We're competing with produce that's imported from California," Yehia said, speaking as if the facility was actually producing product.
As Vertical Harvest attempts to scale up to full production over the next eight months, the central question is whether the company can generate enough cash to satisfy a growing line of creditors. When asked who gets paid first--the federal government, the city of Westbrook, the VC backers, or the broker--Yehia acknowledged the precarious juggling act.
"That's a very complex ongoing conversation," Yehia said. "And we're working that out right now with all of our stakeholders and partners."
Waterside declined to comment for this story.
According to the complaint, they don't see the conflict as complex.
The subordinate note Vertical Harvest agreed to as a desperate move to clinch the Biden Era USDA loan required the urban farm / social media hype company to immediately repay Waterside if they received any "Qualified Financing" over $500,000.
Waterside alleges Vertical Harvest received a massive cash infusion from Raiven in September 2025 -- the same month Gov. Mills visited -- but actively hid it to avoid paying the broker.
Waterside also claims Vertical Harvest and Raiven fraudulently induced them into the deferred fee arrangement by falsely claiming the senior lenders (likely the USDA) had pre-approved "leaking" funds to pay the broker, which wasn't true.
As for the fate of the most expensive salad shooter in Maine -- or perhaps in the country -- Yehia has promised a tour of the facility when the greens really start flying by the end of the year.

This extremist bill would:
* Criminalize the pregnant person for their abortions
* Classify providing an abortion as a felony, with penalties of up to 20 years in prison

The truth is, our fundraising isn’t where it should be at this point in the month. And with Donald Trump fighting tooth and nail to consolidate power and dismantle any progress we’ve made on climate, we wanted to try something a little different today. **We’ve set an ambitious $20,000 fundraising goal to hit by midnight, and we’re asking our most dedicated supporters to chip in just $1 toward that goal.** That’s it. One dollar. **[What do you say? Please use this link to add your very own donation of $1 today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129535493/614677411/2105508926?amount=1&refcode=ea.9bce643f-0a39-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.9bce643f-0a39-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliY2U2NDNmLTBhMzktZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EVKG_feloPU6QGTsYXnJY9hDtKSe09Qb1Q5dpoVo5bQ=)** It might not sound like much, but grassroots donations of $1 — not oily billionaire checks — are how we’ve built _everything_ we’ve accomplished. ✅ It’s how we helped elect **over 200 climate champions** in must-win districts across the country since 2022. 🏆 It’s how our Clean Energy Slate in Arizona went head-to-head with Turning Point and won 11 out of 13 races in the Salt River Project Board Election, securing a majority on the power board of one of the _largest public utilities in the United States_ for the first time. 🔥 And it’s how we’re going to **keep building local and state-level power** in a moment where our national politics feel like they’re barreling toward authoritarianism. If you’ve ever wondered if a single dollar can make a difference, here’s your answer: Yes. It already has. And with your help, it will again. Because it’s not just your $1 donation. It’s $1 from thousands of people just like you. State' The Turkish word for "Ottoman" Osmanlı originally referred to the tribal followers of Osman in the fourteenth century The word subsequently came to be used to refer to the empire's militaryadministrative elite In contrast the term "Turk" Türk was used to refer to the Anatolian peasant and tribal population and was seen as a disparaging term when applied to urban educated individuals28 26 29 In the early modern period an educated urbandwelling Turkishspeaker who was not a member of the militaryadministrative class typically referred to themselves neither as an Osmanlı nor as a Türk but rather as a Rūmī رومى or "Roman" meaning an inhabitant of the territory of the former Byzantine Empire in the Balkans and Anatolia The term Rūmī was also used to refer to Turkish speakers by the other Muslim peoples of the empire and beyond30 11 As applied to Ottoman Turkishspeakers this term began to fall out of use at the end of the seventeenth century and instead the word increasingly became associated with the Greek population of the empire a meaning that it still bears in Turkey today31 51 In Western Europe the names Ottoman Empire Turkish Empire and Turkey were often used interchangeably with Turkey being increasingly favoured both in formal and informal situations This dichotomy was officially ended in 19201923 when the newly established Ankarabased Turkish government chose Turkey as the sole official name At present most scholarly historians avoid the terms "Turkey" "Turks" and "Turkish" when referring to the Ottomans due to the empire's multinational character32 History Main article History of the Ottoman Empire See also Territorial evolution of the Ottoman Empire Part of a series on the History of the Ottoman Empire Coat of Arms of the Ottoman Empire Timeline Rise 12991453 Classical Age 14531566 Transformation 15661703 Old Regime 17031789 Decline Modernization 17891908 Dissolution 19081922 Historiography Ghaza Decline vte Rise c 12991453 Main article Rise of the Ottoman Empire Further information Osman I Ottoman dynasty and Gaza Thesis As the Rum Sultanate declined well into the 13th century Anatolia was divided into a patchwork of independent Turkish principalities known as the Anatolian Beyliks One of these beyliks in the region of Bithynia on the frontier of the Byzantine Empire was led by the Turkish33 tribal leader Osman I d 1323/434 a figure of obscure origins from whom the name Ottoman is derived35 444 Osman's early followers consisted both of Turkish tribal groups and Byzantine renegades with many but not all converts to Islam36 59 37 127 Osman extended the control of his principality by conquering Byzantine towns along the Sakarya River A Byzantine defeat at the Battle of Bapheus in 1302 contributed to Osman's rise as well It is not well understood how the early Ottomans came to dominate their neighbors due to the lack of sources surviving from this period The Ghaza thesis popular during the twentieth century credited their success to their rallying of religious warriors to fight for them in the name of Islam but it is no longer generally accepted No other hypothesis has attracted broad acceptance38 5 10 39 104 The Battle of Nicopolis in 1396 as depicted in an Ottoman miniature from 1523 In the century after the death of Osman I Ottoman rule had begun to extend over Anatolia and the Balkans The earliest conflicts began during the ByzantineOttoman wars waged in Anatolia in the late 13th century before entering Europe in the mid14th century followed by the BulgarianOttoman wars and the SerbianOttoman wars waged beginning in the mid 14th century Much of this period was characterised by Ottoman expansion into the Balkans Osman's son Orhan captured the northwestern Anatolian city of Bursa in 1326 making it the new capital of the Ottoman state and supplanting Byzantine control in the region The important port city of Thessaloniki was captured from the Venetians in 1387 and sacked The Ottoman victory in Kosovo in 1389 effectively marked the end of Serbian power in the region paving the way for Ottoman expansion into Europe40 9596 The Battle of Nicopolis for the Bulgarian Tsardom of Vidin in 1396 widely regarded as the last largescale crusade of the Middle Ages failed to stop the advance of the victorious Ottoman Turks41 As the Turks expanded into the Balkans the conquest of Constantinople became a crucial objective The Ottomans had already wrested control of nearly all former Byzantine lands surrounding the city but the strong defense of Constantinople's strategic position on the Bosporus Strait made it difficult to conquer In 1402 the Byzantines were temporarily relieved when the TurcoMongol leader Timur founder of the Timurid Empire invaded Ottoman Anatolia from the east In the Battle of Ankara in 1402 Timur defeated the Ottoman forces and took Sultan Bayezid I as a prisoner throwing the empire into disorder The ensuing civil war also known as the Fetret Devri lasted from 1402 to 1413 as Bayezid's sons fought over succession It ended when Mehmed I emerged as the sultan and restored Ottoman power42 363 Ottoman miniature of Osman I by Yahya Bustanzâde 18th Century The Balkan territories lost by the Ottomans after 1402 including Thessaloniki Macedonia and Kosovo were later recovered by Murad II between the 1430s and 1450s On 10 November 1444 Murad repelled the Crusade of Varna by defeating the Hungarian Polish and Wallachian armies under Władysław III of Poland also King of Hungary and John Hunyadi at the Battle of Varna although Albanians under Skanderbeg continued to resist Four years later John Hunyadi prepared another army of Hungarian and Wallachian forces to attack the Turks but was again defeated at the Second Battle of Kosovo in 144843 29 According to modern historiography there is a direct connection between the fast Ottoman military advance and the consequences of the Black Death from the midfourteenth century onwards Byzantine territories where the initial Ottoman conquests were carried out were exhausted demographically and militarily due to the plague outbreaks which facilitated the Ottoman expansion In addition the slave hunting — executed at first by akinci irregulars expediting before the Ottoman army — was the main economic driving force behind the Ottoman conquest Some 21stcentury authors reperiodize the Ottoman conquest of the Balkans into the akıncı phase which spanned 8 to 13 decades characterized by continuous slave hunting and destruction followed by the phase of administrative integration into the Ottoman Empire444546 where the bubonic plague pandemic occurred between 1347 and 1349454647 Expansion and peak 14531566 Main article Classical Age of the Ottoman Empire Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror's entry into Constantinople painting by Fausto Zonaro 18541929 The son of Murad II Mehmed the Conqueror reorganized both state and military and on 29 May 1453 conquered Constantinople ending the Byzantine Empire48 Mehmed allowed the Eastern Orthodox Church to maintain its autonomy and land in exchange for accepting Ottoman authority49 Due to tension between the states of western Europe and the later Byzantine Empire the majority of the Orthodox population accepted Ottoman rule as preferable to Venetian rule49 Albanian resistance was a major obstacle to Ottoman expansion on the Italian peninsula50 In the 15th and 16th centuries the Ottoman Empire entered a period of expansion The Empire prospered under the rule of a line of committed and effective Sultans It also flourished economically due to its control of the major overland trade routes between Europe and Asia51 111 m Sultan Selim I 15121520 dramatically expanded the Empire's eastern and southern frontiers by defeating Shah Ismail of Safavid Iran in the Battle of Chaldiran52 91105 Selim I established Ottoman rule in Egypt by defeating and annexing the Mamluk Sultanate of Egypt and created a naval presence on the Red Sea After this Ottoman expansion competition began between the Portuguese Empire and the Ottoman Empire to become the dominant power in the region53 5576

Peter, we don’t take a single donation for granted. We know that when you give, you’re trusting Wes to get the work done -- and that's why he's running for re-election.
He’s focused on delivering results to benefit Marylanders. Here’s just a little bit of what he got done alongside the General Assembly this session alone:
📉 **Bringing down costs for Maryland families.** As prices on everything from gas to utilities rise, Wes is taking action to lower energy costs and build more housing around public transit.
🏫 **Investing in public education for future generations.** We’re making historic levels of investments in our public schools so Maryland kids will continue to thrive.
👷 **Increasing job opportunities across Maryland.** Wes has partnered with businesses big and small to grow our economy, bring jobs to our state, and support federal workers.
Peter, our success is only possible with your support. Here’s the thing: **we only began fundraising again yesterday.** We’ve got a ways to go to catch up and continue our campaign at full speed.

| | It's Tax Day. Like hundreds of millions of other Americans, you've already filed or are preparing to file your returns for the year. You've likely spent several hours combing through your documents for the last year and painstakingly inputting your information into your filing service. Just to be met at the end of the slog with having to fork out 150 bucks to your tax filing service, like TurboTax. You're 150 dollars poorer this tax season because Donald Trump personally ended the free direct filing service that Democrats created through the IRS. It was a wildly popular program that allowed taxpayers to file their tax returns for free. So of course, one of Donald Trump's first orders of business after starting his second presidency was to end that service as a favor to the wealthy tax prep companies and their lobbyists, so they could rake in bigger profits at the expense of taxpayers. **Last year, Direct File helped save Americans nearly $6 million in tax preparation fees.** That's the Trump agenda in a nutshell: destroy anything good that serves hard-working people to benefit those at the very top. Our country's tax code is already rigged in favor of the ultra-wealthy. Each month, firefighters, teachers, and nurses pay taxes out of each paycheck. But there's a separate tax code for the wealthy and well-connected. One that allows them to get away without paying their fair share, and doesn't require them to pay monthly taxes like the rest of us. And Donald Trump is working overtime to keep it that way. With the help of his Republican underlings in Congress, he gave yet another round of tax breaks to corporations and the ultra-wealthy, while the rest of us pay for it. Trump's entire agenda begins and ends with helping make his rich friends richer at the expense of everyone else. When we send Trump packing in 2028, there's going to be one hell of a mess to clean up. Restoring the critical lifelines that Americans rely on, but also laying the groundwork for a bold new vision that puts the American people first, not corporate special interests, and not the Epstein class. **When we send Trump and Republicans packing, my agenda will be this: affordability for us, accountability for them.** The past year has shown that Americans need a bold new vision for the future. One that not only holds Trump and his underlings accountable for their corruption, but one that delivers for the people and helps **everyone** get ahead. That's the future I'm fighting for. clean_body: This tax filing season, a key program was lost — all thanks to Trump and Senate Republicans. | | | | It's Tax Day. Like hundreds of millions of other Americans, you've already filed or are preparing to file your returns for the year. You've likely spent several hours combing through your documents for the last year and painstakingly inputting your information into your filing service. Just to be met at the end of the slog with having to fork out 150 bucks to your tax filing service, like TurboTax. You're 150 dollars poorer this tax season because Donald Trump personally ended the free direct filing service that Democrats created through the IRS. It was a wildly popular program that allowed taxpayers to file their tax returns for free. So of course, one of Donald Trump's first orders of business after starting his second presidency was to end that service as a favor to the wealthy tax prep companies and their lobbyists, so they could rake in bigger profits at the expense of taxpayers. Last year, Direct File helped save Americans nearly $6 million in tax preparation fees. That's the Trump agenda in a nutshell: destroy anything good that serves hard-working people to benefit those at the very top. Our country's tax code is already rigged in favor of the ultra-wealthy. Each month, firefighters, teachers, and nurses pay taxes out of each paycheck. But there's a separate tax code for the wealthy and well-connected. One that allows them to get away without paying their fair share, and doesn't require them to pay monthly taxes like the rest of us. And Donald Trump is working overtime to keep it that way. With the help of his Republican underlings in Congress, he gave yet another round of tax breaks to corporations and the ultra-wealthy, while the rest of us pay for it. Trump's entire agenda begins and ends with helping make his rich friends richer at the expense of everyone else. When we send Trump packing in 2028, there's going to be one hell of a mess to clean up. Restoring the critical lifelines that Americans rely on, but also laying the groundwork for a bold new vision that puts the American people first, not corporate special interests, and not the Epstein class. When we send Trump and Republicans packing, my agenda will be this: affordability for us, accountability for them. The past year has shown that Americans need a bold new vision for the future. One that not only holds Trump and his underlings accountable for their corruption, but one that delivers for the people and helps everyone get ahead. That's the future I'm fighting for. And I hope to have your support as we fight for a better future for all. Making Tax Day a little easier

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Friends,Today is Tax Day.As we file our taxes, some people are getting bigger refunds this year thanks to the record tax cuts I voted for last year. If Democrats had their way, we would have been hit with the largest tax increase in American history.The standard deduction and child tax credit are both bigger, and employers should save enough to do more hiring.The bill I voted for also eliminated taxes on tips and overtime pay. We’ve also funded new baby accounts – putting $1,000 into an IRA-type savings account for every newborn. Maybe most important – the bill also eliminated taxes on Social Security for most seniors.Small businesses and farmers will especially benefit from a series of business tax reforms. And we’ve taken steps to reduce unnecessary regulations that act like hidden taxes which can drive up costs on everything from energy to groceries.Prices have gone up; it’s a difficult year for many farmers and households. Hopefully this tax season you saw one thing that didn’t go up – your federal taxes.There’s still more work to do. But we are making progress toward a system that’s fairer, simpler, and lets you keep more of your paycheck and business revenue.I carry the priorities of Eastern Washington with me every day in Congress—and I’ll keep fighting to make sure your hard-earned money is respected.Sincerely,
Michael Baumgartner

Peter,

As we approach the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, I’ve been thinking a lot about the courage of our Founding Fathers.

250 years ago, 56 patriots risked everything — their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor — to create the greatest country the world has ever seen. A nation founded on liberty, opportunity, and the God-given rights we still cherish today.

That same spirit of patriotism is what called me to service. **On my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps and later became a Navy SEAL.** I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the Constitution and the American way of life my parents taught me to love.

Today, as a proud Minnesotan running for the U.S. Senate, I’m fighting to protect that same legacy. But while Republicans continue standing for the core values that built Minnesota and America — strong families, secure borders, safe streets, free enterprise, and real opportunity — _**the Democratic Party has been overtaken by something completely unrecognizable.**_

That is not the Minnesota I grew up in — playing hockey in a working-class family and learning to love this country. **It’s not the America I risked my life to defend across nine deployments. And it’s not the future any of us want for our children as we head toward America’s 250th birthday.**
