Trump: War Close to Over

President Trump declared the Iran war ["very close to over"](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L2O4yAUxfGnwR2WuYDtLSi2ocu2W1o3fMQoGBCQoHn7UeYRpj86P-n__3bcMMSQHv_wcqp2f9hsjzcm4wbW1PrpSi6uncH3kJ4HLLDSRVAmj1JzK870g01WWWORmckptm0r7PvK2XQqLr2wgklh_qxecGNR7hzxzty6g0c-BfU5XASTwPgC23znXoBk0ttNuN1yIhaMrva5uvK6x2AwdWxPn6txs8nXFNXZe2mE_yWgCegxxjywnSE9ek49XK59dgR0cqMR0B-QgMZSCWgmCWibE0ZLe31dhTb8ajRUTHRgpSbm5gjoqSpbRogxtHUjYnlcGOKP338d7a3gOwAA__8dx38u) on Tuesday, telling reporters to brace for "an amazing two days" as Pakistan's army chief arrived in Tehran seeking to avert a renewed conflict. The U.S. [maritime blockade](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD1uxCAUhE9jd1j82XgLijTuNm1K6xkea7QYELDrKKePnCOknBlp9On7uq938MHHxyccqEtzq012fUM0eEKJte2YU8a6e9d8fK6c8olQSdi45pJqRtNW1lttjQVmetRMqYnP8yRYv2uws52cZAInPlMjt22bzQ3GmVLlxtvYe30dUslGzgTlatiEk3xko7NK4mxFJykELG0omF9b8AZig_p0qRgcTDr6oPfWcu3ER8eXji_neQ5xMxHPeu1Xk0qwHV98gdjxpZXXkckVyBaSeYJFUlsB30hyZE_leP2QnEqrBL9zAB_RkmIiCMGkUn3RNp8-BF8n1Un6OMCHP5L2b31vzX8DAAD__wMThGk) of Iranian ports remains fully implemented, shutting down oil exports even as both sides signal openness to further talks. Pakistan has emerged as a key diplomatic intermediary between Washington and Tehran. Iran's top negotiator, Abbas Araghchi, confirmed a fourth round of talks is scheduled. Markets rallied on Trump's remarks, with crude prices dropping on bets the Strait of Hormuz standoff could end soon. ★★★
DHS Shutdown: Day 59

The Department of Homeland Security entered its [59th day of a partial shutdown](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDHO3SAQhE-DO55gjcEpXKSh-9OmtHiwtsnDgADbyu0jcoS_29XuzHya31_rl_HBx_2XOXEpbVtdcuttosXHlFjbgTllrIffmo-fFRhIygTl05pLqhltW_ngFmed4XbAhSslYZ7lyIdjGZVU3E7CuVmZkSMowUbJQVqF9u2mwS_dkAk-AR8ZqNd73ARMfNqcEji7kQhmApb2Kpivd_DWxGbqZ0vF4sumcwjL0VquZPxJQBPQz_O8ckm3dxgt_klXiSb0TwK6tlT-EtARn0pA5xR887aPnYKAZoKA5hMBfVW6pxtLPDE2WpsPgaa4Jx93-vTlSFdFeqeGNEXqjkq3K7p-zsFE2pIzPWr-IYFLJRhTBPRQFpe73FepiGD7afx_uKF9u_t7gX8BAAD___u7lpU) Tuesday, with the House again failing to schedule a floor vote and roughly 20,000 federal workers still furloughed. Speaker Mike Johnson and Senate Majority Leader John Thune issued a joint statement [promising to fund DHS](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L9uwyAYBPCnsTdb8PHPHRi6eEvXjhaBzwEFAwISK29fpUv3bied9NPpvi_bxYQY0u3LHKhr3zeX3fY0yeJpamrdY8kFmw97D-m-AQE5ET5RsZWaW0HbNzo67awz1I6oqVISlkUyOnotFftAkBwskdQRyfAqBRUgBRNGOTkG_QYJpwIoI6DmK9s5CCp2pzgujg2cmIi1zxXL4xqDNambdt9ztTjbfIxR-95LG9jnAOsA63me88v4nN_tAGvCsw2wmtqDjfiOf1KbjvwM6Tbtj-Qmnw-MJrmpoX3U0F8TUMEFFYuafT_iWLUrZ4gxNKkGTm6HCfF3Q__3cU8NPwEAAP__nQeAtA) on "two parallel tracks": through the appropriations process and through reconciliation. No timeline was offered for either. House Republican leadership has [declined to commit](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2SrCAUhJ8GMyz-VBKCm5jNTTe0GM5BqWGABRxff8t9hE066a7uru_rsT1siCHt_-0bTe1-gwzbxyaHl62p9QNLLtiO4HtIr00wMVOmKJ-2UnMr6PrGBzDgwHI3oOHLMgutZ8mHw0iF2molOHjpmLST80pZ_vSL08BnGIK5C5nik-CSiWV8Sq_ExCcPi0INkihmI9Y-ViznMwZnU7ft5XN1OLr8HqI5ei-NyH9ErESs13WNJcfQg8t3gIg1hg_Ss4Dt2IhY70UiVqaIWPktLqe9Yru9PRdaYu6Nfp_BvSgcjbbj7JCvRDEBZUwvbOZsqAbKFWIMbV6IYvvbhvh7qP-Z4seInwAAAP__KyeDxw) to a vote date, leaving roughly 20,000 furloughed workers in limbo. A Senate reconciliation vehicle could theoretically move next week, but House passage remains an open question. ★★★
Two Members Out, Majority Thins

Reps. Eric Swalwell (D-CA) and Tony Gonzales (R-TX) both [resigned from Congress](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O3CAURp_G7hjx72ko0ky3aVNazOViXy0GBOyiydNHk0fY7pM-6ejo_PnYPzwlysdvf6FrI-6hhP3bZ8DpW-7jxFoq9pPioPy5Sy4t45oJs9dWekUYu1iDCxC8gBWd2DYr73erxHo6u3EjUESQyKM21tylkpobkAZ94HYl9wZyLYwUisvt9lRRSyNMDJvGe1CL5j5hG7eG9euZCHwevn_G0gBvUK41uXOM2hf1a5GPRT7mnLf8hIyzv_9FPmpJNAj6Ih9Q8tGwv2fD2tko-cWOkv_6hJ1hI2B9-jQxJVZiJCCf0os17HRkdlGHksMXDAbJ09VZg-yVEps1a3OhTkqJut0WzY_LU_ovOH5c9dvJfwEAAP__LU6NIg) on Monday, hours before the House Ethics Committee was expected to release reports detailing allegations of misconduct against each. Swalwell faces a Manhattan DA investigation for an alleged assault in New York; Gonzales cited his own ongoing ethics probe. Both [resignations effectively end](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2u5CAQhE-DM1t0G_9sQLCJs9l0Q6sNbRsNAwiY8WpP_-R3hJdUUCV9Kn1_H-uDnHfh-EMv1rnuq412_VAwfFEOpZ6cYuJyur268FxR4thK1cKwphxLYlNXaKy2xhKYhjVM04jzPPbQnHoClgTjwDiaftjNzPBLTSOobQO1wdw4fQOlggGhlzh1W78rHGDY7aR4tr1Qkjzn2mVO7807Q6FSee4xG-5MfDVen7WmIvrfAheBy3VdnQnh3gQuN13gIpXABe5I0bvqTBG4lIv8xd63Rwz_yXNpMxd3BKouhtbEcGQupeV_6e3LXdUzM9Uma5su570r4ySUPF7k_PeV-mN_H41fAQAA__8AWINz) the Ethics Committee's jurisdiction, though law enforcement investigations can continue independently. The dual departures tighten an already narrow House majority, with Republicans now holding just a two-seat working margin. [Special elections](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2O5CAUhE-DM1vwwD8bEGzirDfd0HqGZxs1DQjoRprTjzxHmKSSKlWVvv-P7YHOu3D-wxfpXI_NRrt9MBhqmEOpF6WYqFzuqC48N-Aw9Vz1YtxSjiWRqZvorLbGojAdaTHPEyzLJEV3aeT7DjSiXITh-Edya6XiNOJMhxzRdk7fhVyJEYTkMA-7PBSMYjzsrGixkimOnnIdMqX37p3BULE8j5gNDSa-Oq-vWlNh8i-DlcHaWhtS9K46E-8Ag9W7D_XvZLFSYbDeiwxWrhis4hYTw5mp3F5p6Bt532Ow_RnDF3oqfabiztBzvsxigqXL2qbmvHdlmpni5wud_zlTf03wo-E7AAD__0vagpc) to fill both seats are expected, with Swalwell's California 14th district scheduled for June 16.

Virginia Redistricting Vote Looms

Virginia's April 21 redistricting referendum is six days out, with early voting tilting Democratic. Both parties are [pouring money in](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LHO4yAQBOCnwR0RYLBzBcU17v5rr7Q2sNirEECwf_L6J98j_M00I30jzd-v_QsoUzn-wAt957THGvc3lIAf6GXwia02HCclpvLcjTKLVFZqt7deR8PAu56ijyGCDhN6va6Lud-XWU-nV6CUAqPvTrklzoAmwPrLoXXJQYR1In-Bympn9KzMenvMyRqnXYqrxXuchVWQsfOtY_t-ZApQGMYz1R7wFupryv5kbkPMv4XZhNl6zTlAzlcpzHbxwmzKCrPpKx6VT9mgM-GQHWig5BPlYHjikHAiRFmTfFM_qBDIjpEGdwpM5ZAdE3Ys8fuyp-5j-1DONJZVWHW8gP7vTvzjJ9_e_AsAAP__POSGnA) -- the outcome determines whether an independent commission or Democrats in Richmond draw the next decade's district lines.

NC Senate Race Shifts Left

Cook Political Report upgraded North Carolina's Senate race from toss-up to [lean Democratic,](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGO5CAQRL8GZ4ygAZsJHFzibC-90Go37TVaDBbmFs3fn-Y-YcMqlUpP78_H-oExxfz5G0-ea9vXUML6jZm4Y813O_gqF99H3FvMXysoGKWyUrv1quW-mNqqhzAHCqhp4FlP0wjej0YPx-yDV2TCRtY8HXlUfgcD2wSWHE0Bhzi_D5XVDrRRMD02s1tw2u1hsuyDEVZh4toela-_W4qEueH9tZdK_KByDmk-WrtuYX4JWAQsvfdH389X5n7DeyFgwdoiJRawvFsBSyqE6R1J3pyxsaxILHPpMjFmGfgsVLHJWl6SSrm4yjPSgZxkP7AlfglYvJEhBK-cB-me4Skt4yY39qP0T8TRYdiMxqHO4eoxpXiPk7Dq88SY_rO3Hwv_nuFfAAAA__9O6pMi) a shift that meaningfully improves the Democratic path to the majority, driven by stronger recruitment and fundraising in the state.

Blue Haul Triggers GOP Probe

ActBlue reported record Q1 fundraising of $568 million -- the largest midterm-year haul in the organization's history. House Republicans [escalated their response](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL3O3CAURJ_G7rDggn-2oEjjbtOmtDBc1mgxILi7fv3IadJ_3ZFGczSaP8_taUIM6fXbnKgr-c1lt31NsniZmhodWHLBdgRPIb034DAxrpgYt1JzK2hpE73TzjojbI9azPMEyzJJ0R_6Yfm0P_juHQJwNU0gOEeulkVKOfJHH_Qt5EqMICSHedilVzCK0btZ4eJkp7iJWGmoWD57DNYkMu3tc7U42Hz2UR9EpXXyVwdrB-t1XYPdW8Kr3XkH640drEf-NGT_NY3RUdEQJmYs7fGDzGJmNifCsxDL_uZXxXa3-6pduUKMoU1zp_jrNCH-G0A_fu2r4W8AAAD__7R1gQI), threatening contempt proceedings against ActBlue's leadership over donor-verification practices.

Thune Bypasses Filibuster for DHS
Senate Majority Leader Thune is moving a [filibuster-proof reconciliation bill](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGSrCAURL8GM6YAUZmA4CVm89INrStclBoECphx9u-33E_YvKu7z_l6LA_wwcftPxyoS3OLTXZ5QzR4Qom17ZhTxrp713x8LoKJkTJJ-bDkkmpG0xbeWW2NBW461HyaRqHU2PNu11ZKZUFanKwCYOau7isyPqoe1biytfP6KmSSD4L3TEy3tXdSDHxwdpKobE8kg4Cl3Qrm1xq8gdigPl0qBm8mHV3Qe2u5kv4fETMR8wl193FrKTZ_YL0yRMwRz0rEfI0RMUMuRMxcEjFvKVfqfPDrqzYsNJeUHF19CNS9oqXeIMXPhYmWVozQkCKU8E0jfho9EZ9d0TafPgRfx4lIth3gw--39mehby1-AgAA__9WXIqW) to fund ICE and DHS, bypassing the 60-vote threshold to end the 59-day shutdown impasse. The bill hits the Senate floor early next week. ★★★ Schumer Forces Weekly War Votes Senate Minority Leader Schumer will bring [war powers resolutions](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGu4yAURL8Gd0RwjXFSUGzjLttuad3AdYyCAQEx2r9_Sj7hlSONZo7Ov_t6Rx98fP7Fg0xp2-qSW0-MljqWWNtOOWWqu9-aj68VBGguFJfTmkuqmWxb5eCMsw6lHcjIedZwvepRDrtBcHq6OaGlJWFn4W56HDVKsk6homnw5jMolJxAjgLmy2PcFExy2tys6OpGpgQGKu1SKL8fwVuMDetrS8XSxaZjCGZvLVc2_mGwMFg61t3HZ0ux-YPqp8NgidQrg-VzxmDBXBgsUjFYHB3JFmyVn6nzLaTkeKWIjb6h8I6F59SpVF6opvBuPsXK6aTyn3ei11CMy92H4KuemRLPA334orVf-zwN_AQAAP__uqqKkg) to the floor every week, forcing Republicans to go on record about the Iran war. The strategy is designed to generate difficult votes and build midterm contrast.

★★★
Raskin's 25th Amendment Stunt

Rep. Jamie Raskin introduced [25th Amendment legislation](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDuu5CAURFeDM1uAP3gCgkmc9aQTWtfcSxs1PwHdnuWP_N4OXlIqqaRT0vn72B_gvIvPPxBIl2Z3TLh_IBq6oMTaTsopUz2dbS6-dsnl0vOpF_OeS6qZTNtFhxoNgjAdaaHUItd1GUV3arAHmtUoMdKCZh3JHIBWCI5cIcdfndM3kE9ilmLkUg3HaCc5i9mimmjFkU0cPJU2FMrvwzsDsUF92VQMDSaFzuuztVzZ-JvJjcntuq4B_rlU75XJ7eYzufGJyU3c0co75F7O7ewhUMRAsfUuZAJzfvcCsUcKyRRotSsa8-W8d3VRbOLPAM5_Pbcf6_po-T8AAP__qBt9tQ) to create a commission assessing whether Trump should be removed, citing the Iran war. Fifty Democratic co-sponsors. Zero Republican support. No path to the floor.

**My opponent, Doris Matsui, just went up on TV with her first ad buy of this race. Reports show she’s already spending over $61,000 on Sacramento airwaves.**

Before I go on, I need to ask:

[**We’re preparing to go up with ads of our own, and we’re working to match -- and even exceed -- her initial buy. Right now, we’re about $12,500 short. After 20 years in Congress, Doris Matsui has built a network of corporate PACs, lobbyists, and special interests -- including groups like AIPAC -- that can write big checks early and often.

And it’s that same network that’s shaped her record over the last two decades, while Sacramento families are still struggling to afford housing, healthcare, and basic costs.

I don’t have -- and don’t want -- that kind of backing.

As a Sacramento City Councilmember, I’ve focused on what working families are actually dealing with -- the cost of housing, food insecurity, access to healthcare -- and doing the work to move resources where they’re needed most.

That’s the kind of leadership I want to bring to Congress.

But running a campaign like mine doesn’t come with corporate checks. It depends on people showing up and chipping in what they can -- which is why I have to ask:

**[Now that this race is moving onto the airwaves, it’s critical that we reach voters directly and tell our story. | Republicans voted and passed the Working Family Tax Cuts, to give the middle class the largest tax decrease in history. Democrats voted to increase your taxes. On this Tax Day, many Americans are celebrating the impact of the One Big Beautiful Bill (the Working Families Tax Cuts), which has introduced transformative changes like no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and no tax on Social Security (via enhanced deductions for seniors). These provisions are designed to reward hard work and provide immediate relief to those who power the economy, from servers and nurses to retirees. By allowing workers to keep more of their gratuities and extra shift pay, and by protecting the fixed incomes of seniors with deductions of up to $12,000 for married couples, the bill has contributed to the largest average tax refunds on record, which have climbed over 11% this year to an average of more than $3,400.

### Key Benefits of the Legislation

* No Tax on Tips: Eligible workers can deduct up to $25,000 in tips, ensuring that the extra effort given by service workers stays in their pockets.
* No Tax on Overtime: By allowing deductions on overtime pay, the law ensures that "pulling a double" actually feels like a win for the worker rather than a gain for the IRS.
* Estate Tax Relief: The elimination (or significant expansion of exemptions) of the "death tax" removes a major hurdle for multi-generational families, making it much easier for farmers and small business owners to pass their life's work down to their children without the government taking a massive cut.
* Increased Standard Deduction: The standard deduction has been boosted to $31,500 for a family of four, shielding more initial income from taxes entirely.

> Perspective: Republicans champion these cuts based on the principle that you can spend your money better than the government can, arguing that lower taxes stimulate growth and personal independence. Conversely, many Democrats have expressed concern that these broad cuts could reduce federal revenue for social programs and have proposed raising taxes on high earners to fund public services.
With millions of Americans seeing their paychecks go further and their refunds grow, this year's filing season marks a significant shift in how people keep their hard-earned income.

Let's keep an eye on each other, and don't forget to vote NO to unfair maps. | Are You Celebrating Tax Cuts On Tax Day? | | | Republicans voted and passed the Working Family Tax Cuts, to give the middle class the largest tax decrease in history. Democrats voted to increase your taxes. On this Tax Day, many Americans are celebrating the impact of the One Big Beautiful Bill (the Working Families Tax Cuts), which has introduced transformative changes like no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and no tax on Social Security (via enhanced deductions for seniors). These provisions are designed to reward hard work and provide immediate relief to those who power the economy, from servers and nurses to retirees. By allowing workers to keep more of their gratuities and extra shift pay, and by protecting the fixed incomes of seniors with deductions of up to $12,000 for married couples, the bill has contributed to the largest average tax refunds on record, which have climbed over 11% this year to an average of more than $3,400. Key Benefits of the Legislation No Tax on Tips: Eligible workers can deduct up to $25,000 in tips, ensuring that the extra effort given by service workers stays in their pockets. No Tax on Overtime: By allowing deductions on overtime pay, the law ensures that "pulling a double" actually feels like a win for the worker rather than a gain for the IRS. Estate Tax Relief: The elimination (or significant expansion of exemptions) of the "death tax" removes a major hurdle for multi-generational families, making it much easier for farmers and small business owners to pass their life's work down to their children without the government taking a massive cut. Increased Standard Deduction: The standard deduction has been boosted to $31,500 for a family of four, shielding more initial income from taxes entirely. Perspective: Republicans champion these cuts based on the principle that you can spend your money better than the government can, arguing that lower taxes stimulate growth and personal independence. Conversely, many Democrats have expressed concern that these broad cuts could reduce federal revenue for social programs and have proposed raising taxes on high earners to fund public services. With millions of Americans seeing their paychecks go further and their refunds grow, this year's filing season marks a significant shift in how people keep their hard-earned income. body:
I’m feeling a little sentimental and wanted to share some pictures with you!!!

| | | | I’m coming to you as a Navy Veteran, Nurse Practitioner, GOP Congresswoman, but most importantly as a MOM.
I was looking through some old photos recently and wanted to share a few with you. They help tell my story, but also explain why I’m the Democrats #1 target in the upcoming midterm elections!![](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDE1X1VRLVNKLjExMDExN190MTg3MjIwNC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxNV9VUS1TSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NzIyMDQtMjA2OCJ9/bHgidD51mJxGnRdZlNOP2w)That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I’m a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children. As the granddaughter of a veteran, daughter of a veteran, spouse of a veteran, and mother of future veterans, I come from a PROUD military family.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDE1X1VRLVNKLjExMDExN190MTg3MjIwNC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxNV9VUS1TSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NzIyMDQtMjA2OCJ9/OtahYyWnOD7gKH6bJdcotA)I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - “Blossom.” I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDE1X1VRLVNKLjExMDExN190MTg3MjIwNC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxNV9VUS1TSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NzIyMDQtMjA2OCJ9/v3csMteGec82_R36Pfahlg)After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.
Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I’m not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.
So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDE1X1VRLVNKLjExMDExN190MTg3MjIwNC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxNV9VUS1TSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NzIyMDQtMjA2OCJ9/20AM4xe3PUvtl86b8XUVfg)I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.
Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.
So, I once again decided to stop complaining and actually do something about it. So I ran for Congress! [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDE1X1VRLVNKLjExMDExN190MTg3MjIwNC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxNV9VUS1TSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NzIyMDQtMjA2OCJ9/CTutg-9FNus9Gt--YxBoFQ)When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that’s what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent’s campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me. But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation. [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDE1X1VRLVNKLjExMDExN190MTg3MjIwNC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxNV9VUS1TSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NzIyMDQtMjA2OCJ9/E7s2lN4mwqCNFdJO976ErQ)And in Congress, we’ve been able to make a big impact. I’m leading the charge to lower prices, cut taxes, get better care for our veterans, support military families, and secure the border. We’re making good progress, but all our progress could be in jeopardy if we lose in the upcoming elections.
See, that same Democrat I defeated in 2022 is back for revenge. She just announced her campaign against me, and she raised over $500,000 from Democrat activists in just a few days. The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets, and they are already spending big on attack ads.[DONATE NOW
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDE1X1VRLVNKLjExMDExN190MTg3MjIwNC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxNV9VUS1TSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NzIyMDQtMjA2OCJ9/TXXr_jaK9KuI7QR1gZ4EGQ)If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?
I can’t stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!
Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.[DONATE NOW
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDE1X1VRLVNKLjExMDExN190MTg3MjIwNC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxNV9VUS1TSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4NzIyMDQtMjA2OCJ9/En2PAjDisl0afOXhqvK2og)-Jen[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America’s success! [SUPPORT JEN KIGGANS
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)| | Paid for by Kiggans for Congress

Leo–linked network that masterminded the Supreme Court’s conservative
supermajority. And now he’s being rewarded for it.

popular vote in the 2020 election?

name: Jim Jordan
subject: Asking the wrong question…
body:
This is a wake-up call we can’t ignore.
| Peter,
---
Republicans just LOST _more_ special elections – including one in Mar-a-Lago.
---
“Republicans are getting crushed in scores of state and local races, raising deep concerns about a deflated base refusing to show up to vote even in the most pro-Trump areas.” _-Axios_
---
**In response to the loss, some are accusing Republican voters of “abandoning” the party... even suggesting that you’ve become a Democrat!**
---
_But that response is dead wrong..._
---
Elected officials don’t have a “RIGHT” to serve. It’s a privilege given by voters like you.
---
The only rights I know about are **_YOUR_** _rights_ granted by God and protected by the Constitution.
---
The correct course of action is to _stop blaming voters_ , and start asking __WHY__.
---
**One stat shows that 39% of Republican voters have admitted they could sit out the midterm elections. If that happens, we’re in deep trouble.**
---
_We absolutely need to erase that 39% deficit, but that begins by going straight to the people and learning what actually motivates YOU to vote._
---
**So when you verify your voter profile, I’ve added in a special question for you to share the top reasons you’re motivated to vote** – and if you feel like none of the choices capture your views, there’s an optional open box to share your thoughts **_UNFILTERED_**.
---
_We’re not the Democrats. We don’t censor here!_
---

One stat shows that 39% of Republican voters have admitted they could sit out the midterm elections. If that happens, we’re in deep trouble. Restoring our day in court changes the incentives of agencies and secures our water, our land, and our inheritance for the next generation.

I'm writing because I'm genuinely excited about something EMILYs List built last year — and I want to make sure you've heard about it.

It's called **Friends of the List** , and when I learned how it works, I said (out loud): "_This is genius. This is the best thing I've ever heard._ "

Here's the deal, in plain English:

If you start a recurring gift of **$15/month or more** , you become a Friend of the List — and **EMILYs List will take you off ALL of their normal fundraising lists.**

No more constant donation emails or texts. Just the kind of updates you actually want: letting you know how your support is helping elect Democratic pro-choice women and what's happening in the fights that matter. | [JOIN TODAY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129540996/614693842/86887870?recurring=true&amount=15&sourceid=1058347&refcode=WUEFEP37_20260415_YNBonFOTL_PL_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWFmNGY1Ny0xNjM5LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sGFAGInyTp6AtsHe_FAfWe0OOXepOt52mZ3tqyKea3U=)

And there are plenty of other perks, too:
* Meaningful updates on the impact you're making
* Merch discounts and freebies (when you join this week, you get two free stickers mailed right to your front door!)
* Access to the EMILYs List Substack (op-eds, candidate interviews, behind-the-scenes Q&As, and more)
* A real role in building a stronger, people-powered movement for 2026 and beyond

But what I love most about this program is the respect baked into it.

Because here's the truth: we need a Democratic Party that treats its supporters like people — not ATMs. And in the year since Friends of the List launched, EMILYs List has shown there's a different path to long-term fundraising: **more respectful, more sustainable, and more effective**. No more constant donation emails or texts. Just the kind of updates you actually want: letting you know how your support is helping elect Democratic pro-choice women and what's happening in the fights that matter. | = And there are plenty of other perks, too: Meaningful updates on the impact you're making Merch discounts and freebies (when you join this week, you get two free stickers mailed right to your front door!) Access to the EMILYs List Substack (op-eds, candidate interviews, behind-the-scenes Q&As, and more) A real role in building a stronger, people-powered movement for 2026 and beyond But what I love most about this program is the respect baked into it. Because here's the truth: we need a Democratic Party that treats its supporters like people — not ATMs. And in the year since Friends of the List launched, EMILYs List has shown there's a different path to long-term fundraising: more respectful, more sustainable, and more effective. Peter, **We just got word that a Republican super PAC is now up with a _$1.2 million_ TV ad buy in the Central Valley to prop up our opponent, David Valadao.** It’s airing in our community as you read this email. This is the largest ad reservation all cycle for an incumbent Republican in the state. And the timing is notable given that Valadao is all-but guaranteed to advance through the primary. So why this massive, early spend from his corporate allies? Bottom line: they’re worried about losing his seat to us. Valadao is the most vulnerable Republican in California — and that was _before_ he caved to Trump by voting to rip health care from his own constituents. body:
More than ever, we need to restore federal protections.

Team, I worked my tail off to help pass the Reproductive Health Equity Act in the State Legislature, which guarantees ALL Oregonians the full range of reproductive options. [**A federal judge just struck it down.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129541438/614694866/1482048376?refcode=email_041526_orabortionruling&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDhiYTMyNS0xNzM5LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dyM0AmtvkfWeU3MW-c0vj1FwnxB1hmCFVfrVLoTpi9w=) Let’s be clear about a few things: First, abortion remains fully legal in Oregon today. Second, health care decisions and reproductive decisions belong to individuals. Not to politicians and not to the courts. And third, this is yet another illustration that our nation desperately needs federal legislation restoring the right to choose nationwide. And I’m determined to get it done, no matter what it takes. [**If we’re going to restore every woman’s right to choose in this country — and put a stop to these threats to Oregonians’ basic freedoms — then we need to elect a pro-choice Democratic House majority. It’s as simple as that.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129541439/614694867/1482048376?refcode=email_041526_orabortionruling&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDhiYTMyNS0xNzM5LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dyM0AmtvkfWeU3MW-c0vj1FwnxB1hmCFVfrVLoTpi9w=) _**[If you’re anything like me, you’re angry right now about this ruling. clean_body: Today is Tax Day, a reminder that when people work hard and pay their fair share, they get a system that works for them. | | | Friends, Today is Tax Day, a reminder that when people work hard and pay their fair share, they get a system that works for them. But that’s not the case right now. Working families are showing up, paying their taxes, and contributing to our economy, while too often big corporations and the wealthiest avoid paying what they owe. This isn’t fairness. Our tax system should reward those who work tirelessly every day to contribute to it, not work against them. Let’s be clear: we need to lower costs for families and invest in our communities. That means making sure corporations can’t dodge taxes, protecting critical programs like Social Security and health care, and delivering real relief to middle and working class families. I’m fighting every day to build an economy that works for everyone—not just those at the top. Best, Doris As a Member of Congress, Doris works to ensure that the voices of her district’s constituents are heard in Congress, and fights for the needs of the Sacramento region. body:

# Tax Day
---
| |
Dear friends,
As Mark Twain famously stated: **Nothing is certain, except death and taxes**. And sure enough, today is Tax Day.
But here’s what’s upsetting: much of our taxpayer money isn’t coming back to serve us and our communities. Instead, it’s going to war, to weapons, to the military-industrial complex.
**But what if our tax dollars funded us instead?**
What if we invested in:
* Healthcare for everyone
* Affordable housing
* Climate solutions that lower costs and protect our future

That’s what I’m fighting for.
**I’m running for Congress in District 2 on three simple principles: People. Peace. Planet.**
* People means healthcare, housing, and economic security
* Peace means ending endless wars and investing at home
* Planet means real climate action that benefits our communities

If you want your tax dollars to reflect your values, vote for it.
**In District 2, that means voting for Rose. Can you chip in a few dollars today to show support for the only Congressional campaign in our District that’s committed to changing how our tax dollars are spent to better represent voters?**

clean_body: Today is Tax Day. What should we get for the taxes we pay? | | | | | | | | | | | Tax Day | | Dear friends, As Mark Twain famously stated: Nothing is certain, except death and taxes. And sure enough, today is Tax Day. But here’s what’s upsetting: much of our taxpayer money isn’t coming back to serve us and our communities. Instead, it’s going to war, to weapons, to the military-industrial complex. But what if our tax dollars funded us instead? What if we invested in: Healthcare for everyone Affordable housing Climate solutions that lower costs and protect our future That’s what I’m fighting for. I’m running for Congress in District 2 on three simple principles: People. Peace. Planet. People means healthcare, housing, and economic security Peace means ending endless wars and investing at home Planet means real climate action that benefits our communities If you want your tax dollars to reflect your values, vote for it. In District 2, that means voting for Rose. Can you chip in a few dollars today to show support for the only Congressional campaign in our District that’s committed to changing how our tax dollars are spent to better represent voters? | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | With gratitude,Rose P.S. Tax Day should be about what we deserve: a government that invests in People, Peace, and Planet. More than 400,000 Arizonans, including 180,000 children, have lost their SNAP benefits since July. That's the largest decline in the entire nation, and it's happening right here in our state.

The result? An underfunded state agency overwhelmed by changes it couldn't handle, and hundreds of thousands of Arizonans left without the food assistance they depend on to survive.

The result? An underfunded state agency overwhelmed by changes it couldn't handle, and hundreds of thousands of Arizonans left without the food assistance they depend on to survive. We are one of the wealthiest nations in the history of the world. It is morally bankrupt for children in this country to go hungry. It’s obscene to rip away a program that people rely on just to cut costs and score political points. It is cruel. It is wrong. And I refuse to stay silent about it. Peter, Today is Tax Day and I want to ask you a simple question. **What are you getting for it?** Our founding fathers objected to paying into a government that did not work for them, that served the interests of the powerful and left ordinary people to fend for themselves. They considered that a fundamental betrayal of the covenant between a government and the people it is supposed to serve. **Sound familiar?** Keith Self calls himself a fiscal hawk and a champion of financial responsibility while voting to cut Medicaid, slash school lunch programs, gut veterans benefits, and strip away program after program that working families in this district depend on. He has poured billions into ICE, cheered on an unauthorized war in the Middle East that is costing a billion dollars a day with no exit strategy, and handed tax breaks to the wealthiest people in this country while the rest of us pick up the tab. The founders had words for paying into a government that works against you - they put it in the Declaration. [**Help us make Keith Self answer for every one of those votes by putting this campaign in the strongest possible position to flip this seat in November.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8wrhyxSGy2ANM_zs9dmrdG6WSKVKtzZ6aKyw5psRAjRNIcDfrEsAIo5KkWy_Hi5vMC-RHsQIHBNgRNyBhcddNY6ay8X6FudzJwJCE3vxzt4ZEmrQtJ8jDjtRiU1QulweoT9s6iZGAhCuBiP9XN9nTvoc7k2UDlJMhS4LaRRjTwpLg2KlAf70dEX8Lb9qHED6vTxqCl7OsRydaGSbKXRiuVJI9ohpIN7G1zteaOUdSART_DzAzUQLyBjtCwJ72aRDVpNvDEyyalowzf2H7l6iyKKVXyEeI4ueiOoe0prt7voKDzCa8a9daRqZJ9rFmbyXHA/4pt/7tQMb_MGSa2JIvpRdkjagg/h1/h001.ZO1QeJUGLDkBNnUjm9uyDF9Vkr1WuVG3BXqbQ7wD2C0) The truth is that hardworking Americans are being squeezed for every tax dollar while corporations are making out like kings.

That's why I've published my plan to close loopholes available to huge corporations and the super rich - a plan that James Talarico is now echoing in his campaign - and lift the burden placed on working families. Consider this Tax Day the last one where your money goes to the billionaires and oligarchs while Keith Self holds the door open for them. **Election forecasters have named TX-03 the best district for a surprise flip in Texas and we intend to make good on that.** James Talarico is running at the top of the ticket and performing with exactly the kind of suburban and Latino voter coalition that moves this district. Special election after special election across the country is showing the same Democratic overperformance that our own primary numbers already reflect. The surprise flip is sounding like less of a surprise everyday. But turns a surprise into a certainty is resources, organization, and the kind of sustained investment that takes a campaign from competitive to victorious. clean_body: | | Peter, Today is Tax Day and I want to ask you a simple question. What are you getting for it? Our founding fathers objected to paying into a government that did not work for them, that served the interests of the powerful and left ordinary people to fend for themselves. They considered that a fundamental betrayal of the covenant between a government and the people it is supposed to serve. Sound familiar? Keith Self calls himself a fiscal hawk and a champion of financial responsibility while voting to cut Medicaid, slash school lunch programs, gut veterans benefits, and strip away program after program that working families in this district depend on. He has poured billions into ICE, cheered on an unauthorized war in the Middle East that is costing a billion dollars a day with no exit strategy, and handed tax breaks to the wealthiest people in this country while the rest of us pick up the tab. The founders had words for paying into a government that works against you - they put it in the Declaration. The truth is that hardworking Americans are being squeezed for every tax dollar while corporations are making out like kings. | That's why I've published my plan to close loopholes available to huge corporations and the super rich - a plan that James Talarico is now echoing in his campaign - and lift the burden placed on working families. Consider this Tax Day the last one where your money goes to the billionaires and oligarchs while Keith Self holds the door open for them. Election forecasters have named TX-03 the best district for a surprise flip in Texas and we intend to make good on that. body:

| | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** April 15, 2026
**FLEMING RAISES $45,000 IN Q1, CONTINUES SELF-LOAN SCHEME TO PROP UP FAILING CAMPAIGN**
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Newly filed Federal Election Commission [reports](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=da71ebcce0&e=95355a072c) show that John **Fleming only raised $45,000 in total contributions** during the first quarter of 2026, a humiliating showing for a candidate who has been running for United States Senate for more than a year.
Instead of building real donor support, Fleming once again turned to his own checkbook. In the first quarter alone, he loaned his campaign another $2.5 million, bringing his total candidate loans this election to $10.655 million.
At the same time, Fleming’s campaign paid him back $1.87 million this quarter, bringing total repayments to $7.499 million for the cycle. The scheme is now obvious: Fleming writes himself a check at the end of the quarter to boost his numbers, then pays himself right back.
While Fleming is recycling his own money to keep a failing campaign afloat, Letlow and aligned entities will report approximately $8 million for the first quarter of 2026. Letlow will report more than $4.3 million directly to campaign entities, including nearly $1.9 million raised in just 70 days and a $2.4 million transfer from her congressional account, while pro-Letlow outside groups are reported to have raised $3.8 million. Letlow for Louisiana will also report more than $2.275 million cash on hand heading into the final stretch before the May 16 Republican primary.
Julia Letlow is the Trump-endorsed conservative in the May 16 Republican primary for United States Senate.

clean_body: The biggest National Memorial Day Parade yet| | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. This is a wake-up call we can’t ignore.
| Friend,
---
Republicans just LOST _more_ special elections – including one in Mar-a-Lago.

“Republicans are getting crushed in scores of state and local races, raising deep concerns about a deflated base refusing to show up to vote even in the most pro-Trump areas.” _-Axios_
---
**In response to the loss, some are accusing Republican voters of “abandoning” the party... even suggesting that you’ve become a Democrat!**
---
_But that response is dead wrong..._
---
Elected officials don’t have a “RIGHT” to serve. It’s a privilege given by voters like you.
---
The only rights I know about are **_YOUR_** _rights_ granted by God and protected by the Constitution.

The correct course of action is to _stop blaming voters_ , and start asking __WHY__.

**One stat shows that 39% of Republican voters have admitted they could sit out the midterm elections. If that happens, we’re in deep trouble.**

_We absolutely need to erase that 39% deficit, but that begins by going straight to the people and learning what actually motivates YOU to vote._

| | **Last week, FEMA announced a Major Disaster Declaration for Washington following the severe storms and flooding that hit our state in December.** This is great news for the Northwest Washington communities that were hit hard by the December floods and need federal support to recover. This month, I visited flood-affected communities, including:
* Meeting with the mayors of Nooksack, Sumas and Everson
* Visiting an SBA Disaster Assistance Center
* Touring a flood mitigation project in Ferndale that is raising homes out of harm's way
* Meeting with the Whatcom County Fire District to talk about flood recovery and mitigation

Peter, we're in the fight of a lifetime. President Trump and anti-democracy forces have driven us into a redistricting crisis — while intensifying broader attacks on democracy. **With the midterms fast approaching, Trump and his MAGA allies are doubling down on their efforts to manipulate maps and suppress the vote.** [**If you haven’t been able to give to the NDRC yet, now’s the perfect time. Your gift will go a long way to ensure that we can protect fair representation for all.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129545347/614707062/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_IfNotNow_email_20260415-NDRC-Tier1-IfNotNow_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260415-NDRC-Tier1-IfNotNow_&utm_campaign=IfNotNow&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkYTUxNTZiLTI0MzktZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2P3jAzs5vUUmnuK96-6ForCnSjNrgah1QJoennYQoFE=) Republicans see the same polls we do, and it shows. Because they think their only chance of remaining in power requires silencing the will of the people this November. In just the last month, they’ve aggressively tried to:
* **Take over our elections with the anti-voter “SAVE America Act,”** which would make casting a ballot much harder for millions of Americans.
* **Pass copycat versions of the SAVE Act at the state level** that could create extra barriers to voting access in Florida, South Dakota, and Utah.
* **Restrict voting by mail** stemming from Trump’s executive order directing the Department of Homeland Security to create a "state citizenship list."
* **Spread misinformation to fool voters** into voting against Virginia’s critical ballot initiative that would level the playing field in the redistricting crisis.

It’s clear: President Trump and his MAGA allies will stop at nothing to hold on to power, and that includes undermining democracy and voting rights. **That’s why the NDRC is doing everything to fight back.** [**Donate today to strengthen our fight to defend representative democracy and voting rights across the country.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129545348/614707063/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_IfNotNow_email_20260415-NDRC-Tier1-IfNotNow_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260415-NDRC-Tier1-IfNotNow_&utm_campaign=IfNotNow&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkYTUxNTZiLTI0MzktZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2P3jAzs5vUUmnuK96-6ForCnSjNrgah1QJoennYQoFE=) Thank you for rising to the occasion, National Democratic Redistricting Committee | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129545349/614707064/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_IfNotNow_email_20260415-NDRC-Tier1-IfNotNow_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260415-NDRC-Tier1-IfNotNow_&utm_campaign=IfNotNow&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkYTUxNTZiLTI0MzktZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2P3jAzs5vUUmnuK96-6ForCnSjNrgah1QJoennYQoFE=)

subject: Allow me to introduce you to my friend and future colleague, Rebecca Cooke!

body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter!
I wanted to take a moment to introduce my friend and future colleague, Rebecca Cooke [https://cookeforwisconsin.com/] . Rebecca is a small business owner who grew up on a dairy farm, and is running for Congress in Wisconsin’s Third District.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/images/people/kelly-morrison_rebecca-cooke_web.jpg]
Peter, Democrats just need to flip a small handful of seats across the country to win back the House this November, and Rebecca’s seat is one of the most flippable. She is currently ahead in the polls, and leading with Independents by 5 points !
Last October, our incredible team of interns – as well as most of my entire family – took a day trip to Wisconsin’s Third District to door knock and get out the vote for Rebecca. Voters were so fired up about her, and I got to see for myself what a hard worker Rebecca is. She brings a fresh energy to this work that resonates with Wisconsinites and beyond. The excitement on the doors for her was palpable, and I know that the momentum is even stronger this year.
This energy reflects something much bigger that is happening across the country: Americans are rejecting the chaos, the cruelty and the corruption of this administration. To provide a check on this runaway administration, Democrats must win the House this November.
I am all in to do whatever it takes to support frontline candidates like Rebecca, and we need your support.
Can you split a donation between our campaigns to support our efforts in flipping WI-03? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kellyandrebecca2026]
Thank you so much for your support, Peter.
With gratitude and resolve,
Kelly Morrison
P.S: Team Kelly will be mobilizing our interns and volunteers to door knock again in WI-03 this cycle. Please stay tuned for more information!
